title_en: 200 hospitals will achieve mutual recognition of test results.
body_en:
Continuously optimizing medical services and making it convenient for the public to seek medical treatment is a key livelihood project. On June 24th, a reporter from the Beijing Youth Daily learned from the Municipal Health Commission that the city continues to carry out mutual recognition of laboratory tests and examinations. By the end of 2024, 140 secondary and above medical institutions in the city will achieve online sharing and mutual recognition of 181 medical test results and 300 medical imaging examination results. By the end of 2025, the number of hospitals will increase by 60, reaching 200, covering 97% of the outpatient volume of secondary and above medical institutions in the city, benefiting more residents.
Over 600,000 mutual recognitions of tests have been completed this year
Yesterday, outside the clinic of Wang Chuanjuan, the director of the Neurology Center at Beijing Temple of Heaven Hospital, many patients lined up in an orderly manner, some even holding test results from other hospitals, ready to show the doctor for reference during the consultation. Wang Chuanjuan told the Beijing Youth Daily reporter, "For items like head CT scans, MRIs, and blood tests, as long as the recent results meet the requirements, we will recognize them to reduce the patient's running around. Unless the results cannot be used to determine the condition, we will not recommend the patient to redo them."
Li Rui, the director of the Information Management and Data Center at Beijing Temple of Heaven Hospital, stated that since August last year, the hospital has achieved online sharing and mutual recognition of 181 medical test results and 300 medical imaging examination results, which undoubtedly helps save patients' medical expenses and allows doctors to access data in a timely manner. "Currently, within the scope of mutual recognition, when patients visit Temple of Heaven Hospital, during the registration process, the reports of tests and examinations conducted in other medical institutions within 90 days are already synchronized, and the doctor can directly view them when consulting. At the same time, when doctors prescribe tests, the system will accurately match and automatically prompt whether there are duplicate test items, helping doctors make decisions more scientifically."
Since the beginning of this year, the city has completed over 600,000 mutual recognitions of tests, saving nearly 10 million yuan in medical expenses for patients; completed 15,000 mutual recognitions of examinations, saving over 6 million yuan. The relevant person in charge of the Municipal Health Commission stated that behind these data not only reflects the efficient use of medical resources but also effectively reduces the burden on patients seeking medical treatment. Hospitals can focus more on the diagnosis and treatment of difficult diseases, promote the transformation of medical services from "repetitive and inefficient" to "precise and efficient," further promoting the convenience and intensification of medical services in Beijing.
225 institutions can use the 114 platform for medical insurance payments
As a commonly used medical registration platform for the general public, the city's unified appointment registration platform (referred to as the "114 platform") has accompanied residents for over a decade. The 114 platform has built a full-process service closed-loop covering pre-diagnosis, diagnosis, and post-diagnosis around the core process of patient medical treatment. Before diagnosis, appointments can be made through various methods such as the "Jing Tong" WeChat platform, Alipay platform, Baidu platform, as well as the "Beijing 114 Appointment Registration" WeChat public account, and 010-114 phone appointment, covering nearly 300 secondary and above medical institutions in the city. During diagnosis, patients can view real-time queue progress online to arrange their time reasonably, bidding farewell to "anxious waiting"; the payment end can use mobile medical insurance payment to directly pay for registration fees, medical expenses, and medication expenses from the medical insurance personal account, eliminating the hassle of repeatedly queuing at the window. Currently, the waiting queue function covers 45 medical institutions in the city, and medical insurance mobile payment covers 225 medical institutions in the city.
In addition, after diagnosis, patients can query test reports and medical images through the 114 platform. Test report queries cover 172 medical institutions, and medical image queries cover 231 medical institutions, allowing reports such as laboratory tests, X-rays, and CT scans to be pushed to the mobile phone in real-time, eliminating the need for patients to make a special trip to the hospital to collect the reports.
36 new functions have been launched based on user experience suggestions
It is understood that the 114 platform is also continuously optimized and improved to enhance the public's medical experience. For example, actively organizing "User Experience Officer" activities, since the first activity in July 2023, regular activities have been held every month, with a total of 23 sessions conducted, valuable opinions and suggestions have been collected through the "User Experience Officer." Based on the suggestions made by the experience officers, 36 new functions have been launched, such as waiting list appointment registration, queue number inquiry, vaccine appointment, hospital and department collection, one-click re-registration, etc., which have been highly praised by users and have formed a group of loyal "fans" experience officers.
To combat electronic scalpers, the platform has launched a special operation to ensure the fairness of source allocation. Specifically, based on the characteristics of behaviors such as rapid booking, frequent cancellations, and frequent changes of patients, electronic scalpers are profiled, and a shared database of electronic scalpers has been established, recording information from 36,000 related accounts. Based on this, different measures are taken against electronic scalpers, such as banning accounts and delaying locking numbers, and those with serious offenses are jointly cracked down by the public security department, with 76 scalpers arrested since last year.
To care for the elderly population, the 114 platform has specially launched the "Elderly Care Version," with large fonts, simplified processes, and over 200 dedicated phone lines to provide one-on-one guidance for the elderly and special groups. By Jiang Ruojing, a reporter for this newspaper
· Extension ·
The city officially implements the "Standard for Hospice Care Services in Medical Institutions"
Hospice care will fully respect the rights of patients and their families to be informed
Beijing Youth Daily (Reporter Wang Wei) In the final chapter of life, hospice care is the last lighthouse guarding dignity and warmth. The Beijing Youth Daily reporter learned yesterday from the Municipal Market Supervision Bureau that after two years of hard work, the city has officially implemented the "Standard for Hospice Care Services in Medical Institutions," leading the way in providing a "Beijing plan" for hospice care services in medical institutions nationwide.
As a mega-city, Beijing currently has a population of over 5.14 million people over 60 years old, accounting for 23.5%, entering a moderately aged society, where people's pursuit of quality of life extends from survival to the dignity protection at the end of life. In 2023, the city was included in the national hospice care pilot, with nearly a hundred medical institutions opening hospice care departments and over 1,100 beds establishing a three-tier service network. However, issues such as inconsistent service standards and non-standard operating procedures urgently need to be addressed.
The Beijing Youth Daily reporter noted that the "Standard" organized and implemented by the Municipal Health Commission is a full-chain standard specification from "hard thresholds" to "soft services." In terms of the qualifications of institutions that citizens are concerned about, it clearly requires medical institutions to have a practice license with end-of-life care diagnosis and treatment subjects to ensure service professionalism; the talent team adopts a "core + supplementary" model, with practicing medical staff as the core, supplemented by rehabilitation physicians, psychiatrists, medical social workers, and other professional forces. The hardware facilities are also detailed, ranging from 5 square meters/bed inpatient space to privacy protection with curtains, from basic nursing equipment to intelligent monitoring systems, ensuring a comprehensive and comfortable patient experience. The service process covers outpatient consultation, admission assessment, personalized plan formulation, comprehensive symptom intervention, and the entire process.
In the service process, fully respecting the wishes and informed rights of patients and their families is a highlight of the "Standard." Whether it is the formulation of service plans or the implementation of service content, communication and interaction with patients and their families are emphasized, allowing them to participate deeply in hospice care services, which helps improve patient and family satisfaction with services, enabling patients to feel their value and respect in the final stage of life, providing psychological comfort to family members. In addition, the innovative integration of suitable traditional Chinese medicine techniques, meditation therapy, and other characteristic services has also formed a "Beijing-style" hospice care plan combining Chinese and Western medicine. These innovative measures provide replicable and scalable practical examples for the standardized construction of hospice care nationwide.

title_en: Why are internet giants all eyeing "stablecoins"?
body_en: Recently, Ant Group disclosed that its two independent subsidiaries, Ant Technology and Ant International, are preparing to apply for a stablecoin license in Hong Kong; prior to this, companies such as JD Coin Chain Technology and Circle Coin Technology have already participated in the Hong Kong "stablecoin issuer sandbox." In addition, Xiaomi's subsidiary, Tiansheng Bank, also announced a stablecoin partnership with JD Coin Chain Technology... As the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region's "Stablecoin Regulations" are about to take effect, major domestic internet companies are "rushing in" to accelerate the layout of stablecoins. Stablecoin is a type of cryptocurrency anchored to real assets, whose value is usually pegged to a legal currency, commodity, or other asset. Unlike the price fluctuations of Bitcoin, stablecoin prices are relatively stable, giving them certain monetary attributes in the digital currency field. As of now, the global issuance scale of stablecoins has exceeded $240 billion. Countries and regions such as the United States, European Union, United Kingdom, Japan, and Singapore have all experimented with using stablecoins as a means of payment. In recent years, the Hong Kong SAR government has actively embraced virtual asset innovation. In July 2024, the Hong Kong Monetary Authority announced the first batch of 3 stablecoin issuer sandbox participants, with JD Coin Chain Technology, Circle Coin Technology, and Standard Chartered Bank being the first "trailblazers." In May of this year, the Hong Kong Legislative Council passed the "Stablecoin Regulations Bill," which will come into effect on August 1. JD Coin Chain Technology CEO Liu Peng revealed that the first phase of issuance will tentatively involve stablecoins anchored to the Hong Kong dollar and the US dollar, with specific details adjusted based on regulatory and market demand. JD stablecoin has now entered the second phase of sandbox testing, offering mobile and PC applications to retail and institutional users, with testing scenarios mainly including cross-border payments, investment transactions, and retail payments. Recently, Ant Group has also actively followed suit. It is understood that the group's Ant Financial has initiated the application for a Hong Kong stablecoin license, has designated Hong Kong as the company's global headquarters, and has already completed regulatory sandbox trials in Hong Kong; Ant International has also revealed that it will submit a license application as soon as the "Stablecoin Regulations" come into effect and relevant channels open. The "eagerness" of major internet companies for stablecoin licenses mainly stems from the inadequacy of the existing cross-border payment system to adapt to the development of the digital economy era. Recently, at the 2025 Lujiazui Forum, Pan Gongsheng, Governor of the People's Bank of China, also pointed out that traditional cross-border payment methods and emerging digital technologies have discrepancies, with issues such as low efficiency, high costs, and poor universality urgently needing improvement. Zhang Ming, Deputy Director of the Institute of World Economics and Politics at the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences and Researcher at the National Global Strategy Think Tank of the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences, pointed out that stablecoins have now evolved into a transaction medium connecting virtual assets with real assets, making it very convenient for payments and exchanges between various currencies in the real world. "When Ant International's trillion-dollar fund flow partially shifts to the stablecoin track, and when the global sales business within the JD ecosystem replaces multi-day waiting with settlement in seconds, this transformation will penetrate the surface of the financial system and reshape the underlying logic of global business flow." Zhang Ming said. "I hope to apply for stablecoin licenses in major currency countries around the world, through which we can achieve exchanges between global enterprises, reduce global cross-border payment costs by 90%, and increase efficiency to within 10 seconds." JD founder Liu Qiangdong said. Source: China Electronics News, Electronic Information Industry Network
sentiment_reason: Two subsidiaries of Ant Group are applying for stablecoin licenses in Hong Kong, which is expected to reduce cross-border payment costs and improve settlement efficiency.

title_en: Innovate and seek change, slim down and keep fit, reshape advantages - Guangdong mainstream media sounds the charge of systematic change.
body_en:
Southern Daily reporter Ding Jianting
Guangdong is a pioneer in reform and a media stronghold. How to promote systematic reform of mainstream media and shape a new mainstream public opinion landscape has attracted much attention.
On June 24, Southern Newspaper Media Group (Southern Daily), Yangcheng Evening News Group (Yangcheng Evening News), Guangdong Radio and Television Station, and Southern Finance and Economics All-Media Group each launched their own systematic reform implementation plans, marking the mainstream media in Guangdong sounding the charge of systematic reform.
Faced with profound changes in public opinion ecology, media landscape, and communication methods, Guangdong media has been continuously promoting integrated transformation in recent years, continuously strengthening Internet thinking, accelerating the construction of a full-media communication system, and achieving positive results. However, with the continuous development of the information society, new media and new applications are increasingly becoming the main channels and platforms for information dissemination, posing a growing impact on mainstream media. To cope with the impact and reshape advantages, we must seek motivation from reform and vitality from innovation. This is the inevitable question concerning the rise and fall, as well as the survival of mainstream media.
The essence of media is "medium," connecting everything through the "medium." Institutions, processes, and organizations all fall under the category of "body," and the value of the "body" lies in supporting the "medium." Mainstream media should further strengthen the attributes of the "medium," promote the "body" to better serve the "medium," expand the scope of connections, enhance the ability to connect, and improve the effectiveness of connections, achieving a new elevation of media value in the new rise of influence.
Transformation does not mean changing industries, and sticking to the original does not mean sticking to the old. In the new round of reform, Guangdong media will focus on their main responsibilities and industries, adapt to new communication methods and user needs, concentrate on building new media main platforms, and make information dissemination more precise and efficient.
Adhering to content as the foundation, highlighting a sense of quality. Southern Newspaper Media Group will implement the "Content Productivity Enhancement Plan," with Southern Daily focusing on improving the quality of front-page news, in-depth reporting, and the quality of the city's "Observation" section. Southern Magazine will focus on party building and theoretical propaganda, Southern Net will focus on government news, Southern Rural Newspaper will focus on rural revitalization reporting, Southern Weekend will enhance the content of "Southern Weekend Double Quality (Southern Weekend temperament, Southern Weekend quality)," and Southern Metropolis Daily will strengthen in-depth reporting. Guangdong Education Magazine will focus on promoting ideological and political education. Yangcheng Evening News Group will implement a new round of newspaper redesign, highlighting the refinement of content, launching the "Teahouse Edition," and upgrading cultural brand columns such as "Flower Land Literature List" and "Lingnan Lecture Hall." Guangdong Radio and Television Station will implement a product quality improvement project, upgrading the two major political news programs "Guangdong News Network" and "Evening News," improving the quality of people's livelihood news reporting, and focusing on creating high-quality Lingnan film and television cultural products. Southern Finance and Economics All-Media Group will establish a 24-hour financial news release mechanism, strengthen professional economic interpretation capabilities in 21st-century economic reporting, improve macroeconomic policy interpretation reporting, strengthen economic investigation reporting, create a platform for observing China's urban economy, and build a high-quality corporate reporting research system.
Optimizing media layout, building strong main platforms. Southern Newspaper Media Group will vigorously build a full-media communication matrix led by Southern Daily, Southern+ client, and South client, integrating internal and external publicity, and strengthening the construction of the Guangdong communication main platform with the Southern+ client. Nandu News client and N Video client will merge into the "Nandu N Video" client, focusing on creating several 50 million-level, 10 million-level, and 50 million-level third-party platform accounts, amplifying the mainstream public opinion voice, and striving to build a good trend of "crowding stars around the moon." Yangcheng Evening News Group will focus on building the Yangcheng Pai client, implementing a comprehensive redesign of the Yangcheng Pai, shutting down the Xin Kuai Bao client, "Yangcheng Sports" newspaper, Qiuguang Net, and strengthening the Yangcheng Evening News Weibo and "Yangcheng Evening News · Yangcheng Pai" Douyin accounts. Guangdong Radio and Television Station will upgrade the Touch News client to the "Yue TV" client, shut down three channels and three frequencies with low target audience, viewership, and weak market competitiveness, focus on building a core head matrix led by five 10 million-level accounts, and incubate 50 million-level accounts, promoting the upgrade of waist accounts towards vertical and professional directions. Southern Finance and Economics All-Media Group will redesign 21 Finance client, upgrade Guangdong Economic TV client to "Economic Video" client, establish two 10 million-level large accounts such as 21st-century economic reporting Weibo and stock market broadcast Qinting FM.
Building a brand for comments, enhancing guidance capabilities. Southern Newspaper Media Group will implement the "Comment Brand Building Plan," establish a team of "30 full-time + 100 part-time" regular commentators, strengthen the construction of the "Visual Pioneer Team," and focus on creating programs such as "Yuehai Listening to the Wind," "Dingdong Visual Review," "Yang Aiyang Quick Review," "Head Soup Commentary," and "Ark Commentary," to establish a solid "Southern Commentary Heights." Yangcheng Evening News Group will establish a Comment Committee, establish a chief commentator system, build a comment product system, and focus on creating programs such as "Yang Wan Quick Review," "Yang Wan V Review," "Street Talk Lane Discussion," and "Yue Pai Comment." Guangdong Radio and Television Station will cultivate the first batch of 10 characteristic comment studios, based on programs such as "Yue Political Observation," "Xiaoqiang Quick Review," "News Super Wide Angle," and "Xiaolong New Talk," to build a short video comment matrix. Southern Finance and Economics All-Media Group will strengthen programs such as "21 Editorial," "Southern Finance Quick Review," "Economic Morning Watch," and "Southern Finance V Quick Review," to build a fast, deep, accurate, and active financial commentary matrix, vigorously cultivate commentary internet celebrities.
Where users are, communication is there. In the new round of reform, Guangdong media will lead resource allocation with Internet thinking, drive content production and communication with enhanced user service, and promote the main force to fully enter the Internet main battlefield.
User precision, seizing the niche track. By accurately positioning target users, Southern Newspaper Media Group will focus on creating 20 new media IPs such as "Yue Lun Yue Ming," "Southern Reading+," "Talking about 'Political and Economic' Matters," and "Industrial Spicy Hot Pot," insisting on a "one IP, one strategy" approach. Yangcheng Evening News Group will focus on user segmentation reform, promote the renewal of the "Huadi" IP, and create agricultural, cultural, tourism, and educational integration IPs, as well as people's livelihood news IPs. Guangdong Radio and Television Station will deepen the "short video + live broadcast" main track, strengthen and optimize financial, people's livelihood, medical, education, elderly care, cultural tourism, sports, and gourmet products. Southern Finance and Economics All-Media Group will target economic decision-makers and researchers to create programs such as "China Observation," "Economic Political Voice," and "Economic Numbers," targeting entrepreneurs and capital market participants to strengthen programs such as "21st Century Business Review" and "Trading Frontline."
Differentiating positioning to avoid internal competition. Based on the differentiated user profiles of each media, Southern Daily, Southern Magazine, Southern Net, and Southern+ client will highlight the positioning of party newspapers, party journals, party websites, and party clients respectively. Southern Rural Newspaper will focus on the "three rural" areas, Southern Weekend will create knowledge products that combine ideology, artistry, and practicality, Southern Metropolis Daily will build a new type of urban media, and Guangdong Education Magazine will create a central platform for ideological and political education resources in Guangdong. Yangcheng Evening News will highlight the characteristics of Lingnan culture, strengthen cultural newspapers, and the Yangcheng Pai client will become the "first end of Lingnan culture." Guangdong Radio and Television Station will leverage its advantages in audio and video, striving to make the Yue TV client the "first end of Guangdong video." Southern Finance and Economics All-Media Group will focus on financial reporting, integrating professional economic depth in 21st-century economic reporting, Guangdong Economic TV's video expression genes, and investment media information dissemination speed, striving to build a first-class national financial media and establish the "first end of national finance."
Promote video communication and optimize visual expression. To strengthen connections with users, especially young users, Southern Newspaper Media Group will implement the "Diverse Video Quality Production Plan" and the "Visual Expression Optimization Plan," enhancing the entire video production chain, creating an intelligent video image asset library, and optimizing the visual expression of newspaper, magazine, website, and client layouts. Yangcheng Evening News Group will establish a video business cluster, build a video workshop, achieve mass production of videos, strengthen news visualization, content videoization, and live broadcasting normalization, establish a group creative design department, establish a unified visual system for the group, and create visual brand logos. Guangdong Radio and Television Station will establish a visual studio, unify the entire station's visual presentation system, and optimize the client interface. Southern Finance and Economics All-Media Group will launch a full-terminal aesthetic upgrade, reconstruct the client's visual presentation, strengthen the Southern Finance visual style, and create a unique Southern Finance IP aesthetic image.
Localization of services, deep cultivation of local resources. Southern Newspaper Media Group will implement the "Direct Audience Plan," carry out localized service expansion actions, use local reporter stations (branches) as the fulcrum, link with city and county integrated media centers, and comprehensively expand services in Guangdong and deepen capabilities in the Bay Area. Yangcheng Evening News Group will root itself in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, radiate to the east, west, and north of Guangdong, and the Yangcheng Pai client will open vertical channels for cities, districts, streets, and specific areas to form a localized service system. Guangdong Radio and Television Station will leverage the advantages of local channel localization communication, focusing on Cantonese, and integrating products into people's lives. Southern Finance and Economics All-Media Group will deepen its presence in the Bay Area, with the 21 Finance client opening a "Greater Bay Area" channel and various city-specific Southern Finance accounts, focusing on regional economic reporting and people's livelihood economic reporting, strengthening life service brands such as "Lingnan Great Doctor" and "Guangdong First Lesson," and building a product system with financial characteristics.
The full-media communication system is supported by advanced technology. In the new round of reform, Guangdong media actively explores new technologies and applications, expands open cooperation, drives media transformation with advanced technology, and reconstructs the technical foundation for integrated development.
Adhere to advanced and practical, strengthen technological empowerment. Technological development is advancing rapidly, and the media does not seek the coolest, only the most practical. Southern Newspaper Media Group will implement the "Technology Innovation Empowerment Plan," strengthen the "Southern Smart Media Cloud" technical foundation, accelerate the creation of a "media+" large model and mainstream value corpus, build the Southern AI intelligence body, fully leverage the role of "One Cloud" in providing technical support to mainstream media at all levels in the province, and promote the construction of the provincial "Media Integration and Digital Creativity" key laboratory and the provincial "Media Reform and Innovation" social science key laboratory. Yangcheng Evening News Group will establish a technology business cluster, enhance technology research and development capabilities, and access the Lingnan cultural large model. Guangdong Radio and Television Station will promote the intelligent upgrade of the entire chain of content production and communication, using technologies such as 5G+4K/8K+AI to transform production and broadcasting methods, achieve AI empowerment across all businesses and processes. Southern Finance and Economics All-Media Group will establish a data-driven product technology ecosystem, develop the Southern Finance AI intelligence body and Southern Finance corpus, and realize "all data business, all business data."
Strengthen external cooperation and promote collaborative innovation. Media reform should make good use of external forces such as high-tech companies, research institutions, commercial platforms, and self-media. Southern Newspaper Media Group will build a media computing resource center based on Huawei Cloud, Tencent Cloud, and Alibaba Cloud, establish a provincial smart media development community, carry out content open production actions, cultivate a diverse "innovation rainforest." Yangcheng Evening News Group will fully access AI products from major Internet companies, explore cross-border touchpoints such as "film + games" and "culture + trendy play," and launch the "Hundred Masters Settlement Plan." Guangdong Radio and Television Station will jointly establish a key laboratory for ultra-high-definition technology innovation and application with Huawei and other units, and a smart media innovation laboratory with Tencent Cloud. Southern Finance and Economics All-Media Group will combine independent innovation with open innovation, introduce advanced information technologies represented by artificial intelligence, and establish the Southern Finance and Economics Technology Laboratory.
Link political resources and expand scenario applications. The media plays an important role in social governance. Southern Newspaper Media Group will build the "Yuezhengtong" online aggregation platform for government-citizen interaction, optimize the Green and Beautiful Guangdong public service platform, deepen content interconnection, service interconnection, and operation interaction with "Yue Series" platforms and provincial departments. Yangcheng Evening News Group will revive the "Five Rams Cup" National Chess Championship and the "Eight Scenic Spots of Yangcheng" selection activities, explore applications in smart cars, smart wearables, smart homes, and other scenarios. Guangdong Radio and Television Station will deepen cooperation with the government and enterprises, create a one-stop urban service entrance, and promote media service in social governance. Southern Finance and Economics All-Media Group will launch the "User Partner Program," jointly build a news client content ecosystem with individual users, build a financial service terminal product ecosystem, data ecosystem, and technology ecosystem with institutional users.
Mechanism reform is the key to the systematic reform of mainstream media, and talent competition is at the core of media competition. In the new round of reform, Guangdong media will comprehensively promote changes in organizational structure, management processes, operation models, talent development, etc., focusing on building a system and mechanism suitable for the full-media era, setting up a "fast lane" for talent growth, and cultivating a group of "article experts," "video experts," and composite talents skilled in data analysis and product operations.
Optimize internal architecture, make it more flat. Southern Newspaper Media Group will implement the "Integration Innovation Plan," consolidate and enhance the integrated mechanism of content production, integrated operation, technical support, and overall management, explore a flat management model across media, departments, and lines, and establish the first batch of 15 integrated media studios such as education, health, and fashion. Yangcheng Evening News Group will establish seven major business clusters for strategy and collection, video, regional, distribution, operation, service, and technology, systematically promote the construction and operation of the first batch of 14 integrated media studios such as "Xiaoyang Paike" and "Shanhai Plan." Guangdong Radio and Television Station will optimize the organizational structure, establish a comprehensive unified command and coordination mechanism for integrated production and communication across the entire station, and establish a mechanism for integrated production and broadcasting work of "content production + multi-channel distribution and broadcasting." Southern Finance and Economics All-Media Group will streamline the group headquarters, promote resource sinking, establish a three-level efficient operation structure of "group-media-product studio," strengthen "learning economy," "Fengyun Guangdong Business," and other 29 product studios.
Improve the evaluation system, make it more scientific. Southern Newspaper Media Group will optimize the quality, traffic, and quantity evaluation mechanism, highlight the results-oriented approach, and establish a multidimensional quantifiable indicator system. Yangcheng Evening News Group will reconstruct the full-media evaluation and incentive system, adjust the salary ratio, develop a new media assessment system, and increase the weight of traffic assessment. Guangdong Radio and Television Station will establish a diversified evaluation system, optimize the evaluation mechanism for excellent new media, and enhance the quality of the new media award evaluation. Southern Finance and Economics All-Media Group will explore the establishment of an agreement-based salary mechanism, set targeted assessment indicators and corresponding "salary packages," focusing on news internet celebrities, learning from the MCN commercialization model, and exploring multi-level salary models such as "cooperative profit sharing" and "equity incentive."
Expand business models, make them more diversified. Southern Newspaper Media Group will establish an integrated business mechanism, implement plans such as "media + park," "media + agriculture, culture, tourism, commerce," "media + education," and "media + exhibition." Yangcheng Evening News Group will deepen the integrated reform of operations, create a digital creative industry gathering place in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, and strive to make the Lingnan Digital Creative Building a "vertical" cultural and creative industry park. Guangdong Radio and Television Station will implement an industrial operation model transformation project, focus on "media +" vertical business operations, and enhance self-replenishing capabilities. Southern Finance and Economics All-Media Group will explore financial media business monetization models, strengthen brand monetization, consolidate content monetization, explore traffic monetization, implement "media + data," deepen "news + government service business."
Innovate talent cultivation, make it more full-media. Southern Newspaper Media Group will implement the "Full-Media Talent Foundation Plan," optimize and enhance the "Southern Famous Journalist Training Project," innovate in the selection, training, use, and incentive of full-media talents, allowing young people to take on major responsibilities and enabling capable individuals to shine. Yangcheng Evening News Group will implement the "Elite Talent Plan," establish a system of professional technical ranks such as chief reporters, chief editors, and chief commentators, open up new promotion channels for outstanding talents beyond administrative promotion. Guangdong Radio and Television Station will cultivate full-media talents in different categories, train new media light cavalry, create personal IP accounts, and cultivate new artistic and literary creation forces. Southern Finance and Economics All-Media Group will establish a platform for selecting and training young talents based on products, publicly select chief product officers, program hosts, incubate a group of news internet celebrities, and significantly increase the proportion of full-media and product-oriented professional talents.
Time and tide wait for no man, the fields and seas change in an instant. Promoting systematic reform is a major task assigned to mainstream media in the new era and a profound self-revolution. Rooted in the fertile soil of reform and opening up, Guangdong media must remember its original mission, dare to explore and innovate, take the lead in promoting systematic reform, set an example, and make greater contributions to consolidating and strengthening mainstream ideological public opinion. title_en: Can Tencent's digital therapy break through the difficulties of commercialization and landing in the race against cognitive decline?
body_en:
Recently, Tencent Cloud announced on its official WeChat account that Tencent's independently developed cognitive function training software, "Tencent Brain Power Exercise," has been granted a medical device registration certificate by the Guangdong Provincial Drug Administration and is about to enter the clinical application phase to help patients with mild cognitive impairment effectively improve their cognitive abilities. It is reported that this is Tencent's first digital therapeutic software, and obtaining the medical device registration certificate means that the software has been officially recognized for use in serious medical scenarios.

"Alzheimer's disease signals can appear 15-20 years in advance. According to authoritative research from The Lancet, as many as 40% or more of Alzheimer's disease cases can be reversed and delayed in the golden window period of intervention such as MCI (mild cognitive impairment) and preclinical stages." A senior industry insider pointed out to 21st Century Business Herald that currently, digital therapeutics in the field are still in a relatively early stage of "scenario building" from a business model perspective.

"The main challenge lies in how to get the payers to foot the bill (such as insurance, C-end, hospitals, etc.). Currently, there hasn't been a company that has excelled in terms of a good business model." The above-mentioned person added, for example, the sustainability and profit margin of Brain Dynamic Aurora in the hospital end, if solely relying on policies to strengthen the needle, is quite challenging. Looking at the entire industry, the cost of market education is still very high, and in terms of application scenarios, basically everyone is still in the exploration stage.

According to data from the Drug Administration website, there are more than 40 companies in China focusing on the cognitive digital therapy market, and as of October 2024, a total of 47 "cognitive digital therapy" software products have been approved by the National Medical Products Administration. According to statistics by approval province, Hunan Province has a total of 32 approved products, leading the country by a wide margin. In terms of capital market performance in this field, only Brain Dynamic Aurora successfully listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange earlier this year.

Cognitive digital therapy is an innovative application of digital therapy in the field of cognitive impairment diagnosis and treatment, specifically targeting cognitive impairment. Cognitive digital therapy is driven by software programs, providing evidence-based digital diagnostic and therapeutic measures for patients with cognitive impairment, including digital cognitive assessment, prevention, treatment, and management.

According to Tencent Cloud's announcement, "Tencent Brain Power Exercise" transforms traditional cognitive rehabilitation into a "brain fitness center" that can be accessed on mobile phones. Through four life-oriented modules, following the principle of "gamified cognitive training + evidence-based medicine," it is designed in the form of mini-games. After a prescription is issued by a doctor, patients with mild cognitive impairment can undergo 45 minutes of training per day according to the treatment course.

Trial data shows that subjects in the experimental group who completed the full training showed significant improvement in the Loewenstein Occupational Therapy Cognitive Assessment (LOTCA) and Montreal Cognitive Assessment (MoCA) scores compared to the initial stage, with a significantly higher improvement rate than the control group, indicating that using "Tencent Brain Power Exercise" for cognitive training can significantly improve cognitive abilities.

According to the "Chinese Expert Consensus on Cognitive Digital Therapy (2023)," mild cognitive impairment (MCI) is the pre-dementia stage, characterized by memory or other cognitive function impairments without significant impact on daily living abilities, not meeting the criteria for dementia. China has a large number of cognitive impairment patients, with approximately 38.77 million MCI patients among adults aged 60 and above, with a prevalence rate of up to 15.5%, and approximately 15.07 million dementia patients, with a prevalence rate of about 6%.

The huge patient population is driving the rapid expansion of the cognitive digital therapy market. It is reported that more than 20 related products have been approved for intervention and treatment of mild cognitive impairment. In 2023, the market size of the Chinese cognitive impairment digital therapy market reached 268.6 million yuan, and it is expected to increase to 1.0467 billion yuan and 8.9274 billion yuan by 2025 and 2030, respectively, with a compound annual growth rate of 97.4% and 53.5%.

However, behind the rapid development of the industry, many challenges urgently need to be addressed. In terms of regulation, the "Chinese Expert Consensus on Cognitive Digital Therapy (2023)" points out that on one hand, clinical experts have differing opinions on the clinical use of digital therapy products (prescription/non-prescription), which largely depends on the product positioning of the companies. Therefore, ensuring the appropriate application of digital therapy products in the right population, reducing risks, and optimizing the allocation of medical resources are major challenges.

On the other hand, the regulatory system for medical devices focuses more on product risk management than efficacy regulation; in addition, digital therapy products pose risks related to patient privacy protection and human factors engineering compared to traditional medical devices. Regulatory authorities should promptly issue guidelines for digital therapy registration review to guide relevant companies in the best practices for designing, manufacturing, and quality of digital therapy products to ensure public safety.

Commercialization also presents significant challenges. Looking at the first company in China to develop medical-grade digital therapeutic products for cognitive impairment, Brain Dynamic Aurora's core product, the "Brain Function Information Management Platform Software System," has been commercialized for eight indications of four major types of cognitive impairment. According to Frost & Sullivan data, based on 2023 revenue, Brain Dynamic Aurora holds 25.0% and 91.6% market share in the Chinese cognitive impairment digital therapy market and the Chinese medical-grade cognitive impairment digital therapy market, respectively.

However, in 2024, Brain Dynamic Aurora still faces the dilemma of increasing revenue without increasing profits, achieving operating income of 122 million yuan, an 82.01% year-on-year increase, but incurring a loss of 198 million yuan within the year, although the loss decreased by 44.78% year-on-year, the profitability issue remains prominent. In addition, its CEO and Chief Research Officer Wang Xiaoyi resigned from relevant positions due to worsening depression, which may add uncertainty to the company's future development and has sparked widespread industry attention to the prospects of digital therapy companies.

"In recent years, tech giants such as Tencent, Alibaba, and ByteDance have accelerated their entry into the medical field, but mature commercial models still need to be broken." The industry insider admitted, "Cognitive digital therapy is a small piece of Tencent's layout in the medical field, but it is also a smart attempt combining Tencent's gaming, technology, and other resources."

In the view of this person, the unique advantage of tech giants lies in leveraging brand influence and economies of scale to directly establish cooperation with hospital decision-makers, breaking through traditional industry barriers with a "top-down" promotion model, showing higher resource integration efficiency compared to other digital therapy companies in the industry, but the specific execution results are closely related to their internal governance efficiency and strategic determination.

Mild cognitive impairment is an intermediate stage between normal cognition and AD (Alzheimer's disease) dementia, with a high likelihood of progressing to AD dementia. Data shows that Alzheimer's disease patients take an average of 8-10 years to progress from mild to severe, while transitioning from mild cognitive impairment to mild dementia generally takes 2-6 years. This period is the "golden window period" for treating Alzheimer's disease, and timely intervention can significantly delay disease progression and maximize the retention of patients' cognitive function.

However, there is a widespread cognitive bias towards Alzheimer's disease in China, with phenomena such as concealing the condition, neglecting treatment by family members, and simplifying cognitive decline as "natural aging" being common. Related data shows that the consultation rate for patients with mild dementia in China is only 14%, and for severe dementia, it is only 34%, with 49% of cases misdiagnosed as normal aging, leading to a severe situation of "low awareness, low consultation rate, and low diagnosis rate." This cognitive gap causes many patients to miss the opportunity for early intervention, further exacerbating the burden of the disease.

Currently, the number of dementia patients in China, mainly AD, has reached 15 million, and the huge patient base has created an urgent need for diagnosis and treatment. In terms of market size, the global Alzheimer's disease drug market was 23 billion yuan in 2020, and is expected to grow to 25.7 billion yuan by 2026, with a compound annual growth rate of 1.5%, highlighting the strong market demand for innovative therapies.

For a long time, due to the complex pathogenesis, Alzheimer's disease has been referred to as the "undying cancer," and the clinical field has always faced the dilemma of "lack of doctors and shortage of drugs." In recent years, many breakthroughs have been made in the development of innovative drugs. In 2024 alone, Leenka (Luncanezumab) and Remejineida (Donanuzumab Injection) under Weichai have been approved by the National Medical Products Administration for the treatment of mild cognitive impairment and mild dementia caused by Alzheimer's disease, ushering in the era of "etiological treatment" for AD.

Despite the continuous emergence of innovative drugs, there is still a significant gap between market performance and the huge demand. Public data shows that Weichai has repeatedly lowered its sales expectations for Luncanezumab. In the 2024 fiscal year, the sales forecast was lowered from 56.5 billion yen (approximately 376 million US dollars) to 42.5 billion yen (approximately 283 million US dollars), with the US sales forecast reduced from 43.5 billion yen (approximately 289 million US dollars) to 26.5 billion yen (approximately 176 million US dollars).

According to Weichai's 2024 fiscal year Q3 performance report disclosed in February this year, from April 1, 2024, to December 31, 2024, global revenue for Luncanezumab reached 29.6 billion yen (approximately 197 million US dollars), a year-on-year increase of over 2000%. Weichai expects the drug's revenue for the 2024 fiscal year to reach the target of 42.5 billion yen.

The reasons for Weichai's downward revision of sales expectations include delays in market promotion in the United States and lessons learned from the launch in various regions, as well as scenario analysis based on competitive dynamics, epidemiological data, and brand awareness (BBM) penetration rate, while considering downside risks.

Despite the less-than-ideal market expectations of the pioneers, facing a large patient population, global research and development pipelines are still advancing. At the end of 2024, BioArctic reached a 1.35 billion US dollar cooperation agreement with Bristol-Myers Squibb (BMS) to jointly develop antibodies targeting Pyroglutamate-modified Aβ (PyroGlu-Aβ) for the treatment of cognitive impairment and other symptoms in Alzheimer's disease.

In addition, in May of this year, Sanofi acquired Vigil Neuroscience for 470 million US dollars to accelerate the development of its oral small molecule TREM2 agonist project, including the upcoming Phase 2 clinical trial for VG-3927, a potential treatment for Alzheimer's disease. According to the terms of the agreement, if VG-3927 achieves commercialization within a specific period, Vigil will receive additional payments, making the total transaction amount up to approximately 600 million US dollars.

In recent years, with the rapid development of diagnostic technology and pathological research, the field of Alzheimer's disease treatment has seen a new dawn. However, in the industry's view, establishing a complete Alzheimer's disease ecosystem to improve early diagnosis and treatment levels is still a long way off. In order to meet the growing clinical demand as soon as possible and serve the needs of the elderly patients as early as possible, it requires joint efforts to strengthen the research and development, innovation, and promotion of diagnostic technology and innovative drugs.

body_en:
Feng Qian, Yang Qisong, Tian Binchen, Tian Xinchuan, Tian Yangjun, Ge Xi, Hongmao Mining and Trading Co., Ltd. in Fuquan City, Guizhou, Junyuan Automobile Sales and Service Co., Ltd. in Fuquan City, Guizhou: This court has accepted the case of Guizhou Fuquan Rural Commercial Bank Co., Ltd. suing you for financial loan contract disputes, which has been concluded. Now, according to the law, we announce the delivery of the (2025) Qian 2702 Min Chu 890 civil judgment and the Notice of Effective Legal Document for voluntary compliance. title_en: Shenzhen Huimin Bao will stop accepting insurance applications at the end of June.
body_en:
Shenzhen Special Zone News (Reporter Cheng Zan) "Shenzhen Huimin Bao" has launched a one-stop settlement service since its first launch in 2023. Insured individuals can enjoy "reimbursement upon discharge", greatly reducing the pressure of advance payment, and turning the process of medical reimbursement from "running around" to "no running at all".

The conditions for participating in Shenzhen Huimin Bao are relaxed, with no restrictions on age, occupation, or health status. As long as you have Shenzhen medical insurance, you can participate. This year, residents with Shenzhen household registration have also been included in the coverage, with a premium of 88 yuan for a maximum coverage of 4 million yuan. It is reported that the enrollment channel for Shenzhen Huimin Bao in 2025 will close at 24:00 on June 30. There is less than a week left until the enrollment deadline, and missing it will not be able to be made up.

In addition, as long as the insured individuals seek treatment at a total of more than 9,600 designated medical institutions in Shenzhen and hospitals connected to the Guangdong provincial network settlement platform, when they are discharged, the system will automatically deduct the reimbursement portion from Shenzhen medical insurance and "Shenzhen Huimin Bao". Patients only need to pay the amount they are responsible for, effectively reducing the problems of insured individuals needing to advance payment, taking a long time, and requiring a lot of documentation.

Currently, insured individuals can make insurance payments through various convenient channels, such as following the official designated insurance platform "Shenzhen Huimin Bao" WeChat official account, or through the "Shenzhen Medical Insurance" and "Weibao" WeChat official accounts, "Alipay", "Yue Sheng Shi" APP and mini programs, or by visiting offline service windows for consultation and processing.

title_en: The duration of using AR glasses in the future may exceed that of mobile phones.
body_en:
Sichuan Daily All-Media Reporter Yin Mengqi Chen Bihong from Hangzhou
【Company Profile】
Rokid Technology
As a unicorn company in the AR industry, Rokid Technology has already launched multiple AR glasses. Earlier this year, the head of Rokid Technology took the stage wearing AR glasses and said, "My speech is right in my glasses, and I turn the pages using the ring on my hand," sparking responses from netizens asking where to buy them.
On June 17, Rokid Technology, one of the domestic "AR Four Dragons" in Hangzhou, announced that it had become the first in the world to enable payment functionality on smart glasses.
Empowered by AI large models, AR glasses can now achieve intelligent Q&A, real-time translation, speech prompts, real-time navigation, and other functions. Some industry insiders even predict that AR glasses may replace smartphones as the "next generation of intelligent terminals."
During the "6.18" period this year, the number of AR glasses users increased by 70%, and this niche consumer electronics product is rapidly moving towards the mass consumer market. The AR glasses industry, long considered to be "all talk and no action," seems to have reached a turning point in development. Questions arise: Why are AR glasses popular this year? Will AR glasses replace smartphones? How far can AR glasses go?
On June 19, Sichuan Daily All-Media reporters in Hangzhou conducted an exclusive interview with Rokid Technology's co-founder and CEO Xiang Wenjie, delving into the latest developments in the AR glasses industry on-site.
Why are AR glasses popular this year?
Reporter: Why have AR glasses become popular this year?
Xiang Wenjie: There are mainly two reasons: first, AR glasses have become lighter. For consumer-grade AR glasses to sell well, the first consideration is light weight, good user experience, affordability, and stylish appearance. Starting in 2024, more and more manufacturers began to focus on the lightweight, aesthetics, cost-effectiveness, and long battery life of products, which further lowered the user threshold and drove the development of the entire industry.
Another key point is the rapid development of AI large models, which has enabled AR glasses to enhance their multimodal interaction capabilities in terms of voice and vision, leading to a wider range of applications. In the AI era, in our view, AR glasses are the best carrier for AI.
Reporter: Why are AR glasses the best carrier for AI?
Xiang Wenjie: Firstly, the best carrier for AI must be a wearable device. In the coming years, as large models gradually penetrate various industries such as consumer, culture and tourism, education, healthcare, and industry, each industry's large models will need a terminal to carry them. In a world where everything can be AI, the phone is not the most suitable carrier because we cannot interact with AI all the time by holding a phone. However, wearable devices can be worn on us anytime and anywhere, providing real-time feedback.
Secondly, this wearable device should be AR glasses. AR glasses have display functions, cameras, and various sensors, allowing for a more diverse form of interaction between AI large models and humans.
Just as the mobile internet gave rise to smartphones, the vigorous development of AI will also give rise to the next generation of more adaptable mobile terminals, which are AR glasses.
Reporter: What is the trend of evolution for AR glasses?
Xiang Wenjie: First is lightness and style. The latest AR glasses released by the company weigh only 49 grams, and they will become even lighter in the future. After more than 10 years of exploration, we have found that the core demand of users for consumer-grade AR glasses is comfortable wearing, stylish appearance, and the practicality and playability of AI functions. In terms of technological evolution, our products are moving towards a larger field of view, longer battery life, and stronger AI functions. The trend of evolution for AR glasses is to integrate AI and AR into a lightweight pair of glasses.
Will AR glasses replace smartphones?
Reporter: Some people believe that in the AI era, AR glasses will gradually replace smartphones. What is your opinion?
Xiang Wenjie: In the next 2-3 years, 90% of our time using mobile terminals will still be spent on smartphones, but the remaining 10% may be spent on AR glasses. Based on this, in another 2-3 years, the usage time of glasses may increase to 50%. In a few more years, 70% of daily interactions may be completed through AR glasses.
AR glasses will not completely replace smartphones, just as smartphones have not completely replaced computers today. However, just as we now spend more time using smartphones than computers, in the future, the time spent using AR glasses will also exceed that of smartphones. AR glasses may not replace smartphones, but they will definitely change them. In the near future, the phone will also become something that does not need to be taken out all the time.
Reporter: You were the first to implement the payment function on smart glasses globally, what was the consideration behind this decision?
Xiang Wenjie: By introducing the most frequently used function on mobile phones into AR glasses first, it is easier for everyone to feel the difference between using AR glasses and smartphones. For example, with the "Look and Pay" function of Alipay built into Rokid Glasses, users can pay directly in the glasses when busy or unable to operate the phone, without having to take out the phone from their pocket and scan the code. This comparison can make everyone clearly feel the convenience of AR glasses.
When will AR glasses transition from novelty to necessity?
Reporter: AR glasses have become popular on social media, when will the transition from novelty to necessity be achieved?
Xiang Wenjie: The first batch of users are definitely attracted by the new concept of AI+ AR glasses and the new functions such as real-time translation, real-time navigation, music listening on the go, and instant phone calls. This is normal. Based on this, more applications for AR glasses will be developed, and people will become increasingly dependent on them.
At the current stage of development in the AR glasses market, it is similar to the crucial growth period of smartphones from 2007 to 2010. Just as the mobile internet reshaped the smartphone market, with the rapid iteration of AI large models, more and more applications that can be developed on AR glasses will drive the crucial breakthrough from "usable" to "everyone wants to use." It is expected that in the next 3-5 years, AR glasses will have their "iPhone moment" and the popularity rate will greatly increase.
Reporter: The AR glasses market has not yet reached its explosive period, but this track is already very crowded. How do you view this phenomenon?
Xiang Wenjie: It is normal because the entire AR glasses market cannot be dominated by a single company. Market development goes through such a process: from initially a few scattered companies to developing into 100 companies, then falling back to 10 companies, and finally possibly only a few leading companies.
Currently, the AR glasses market is in the stage of development with 100 companies, and in the future, it will take 3-5 years for the market to gradually reduce the 100 companies to 20, 10, or even 5.
Reporter: What are the key market development milestones to watch for?
Xiang Wenjie: There are three key milestones in the development of the AR glasses market: shipment volume of 1 million units, shipment volume of 10 million units, and shipment volume of 100 million units.
When in the stage of 1 million units shipped, it means that the main users of smart glasses are those "alpha" consumers who embody the product concept, use the product, and ultimately recommend the product to others. They will initiate relevant discussions on social media, bringing smart glasses into the public eye.
This year, global shipments will continue to grow and exceed 10 million units, at which point smart glasses can truly "break out." At that time, users will no longer be just tech enthusiasts or early adopters, but there will be more users. 10 million units is a milestone in the development of the smart glasses market.
The next step will be to aim for the goal of 100 million units shipped globally, reaching this level will mean that smart glasses will have the same market position as smartphones today.
A bit more news
A pair of "Made in Sichuan" smart glasses
Facilitating communication between police and foreign tourists
In the crowded Tianfu Square in Chengdu, patrolling police officer Wu Han used a pair of smart glasses to help a confused foreign tourist with directions in just 30 seconds.
Wu Han explained that these smart glasses can not only connect to a mobile phone for real-time translation but can also directly match two pairs of glasses. "With each of us wearing a pair, we can speak directly in our own languages, making communication effortless."
These glasses from Sichuan Yimuke Technology Co., Ltd. use diffractive waveguide imaging technology and incorporate domestic large models such as DeepSeek and Beanbag, currently supporting 40 languages and 90 accents. Liu Yu, the company's offline market brand manager, said, "Our products continue to iterate and upgrade, with various functions such as photography, games, and office applications. They have been exported to 19 countries and regions, including Japan and Russia, and will accelerate the expansion of the international market this year."
Yang Longsheng, CEO of Sichuan Yimuke Technology Co., Ltd., stated that at the upcoming Chengdu World Games, Yimuke Technology plans to explore the cultural and tourism applications of smart glasses, helping international friends experience Chengdu's culture and cuisine deeply through translation and other functions, showcasing the unique charm of the city.
With the gradual maturation of artificial intelligence technology, the development momentum of smart glasses in China is becoming increasingly strong. International Data Corporation predicts that the global smart glasses market will ship 12.8 million units in 2025, a 26% year-on-year increase, with the Chinese smart glasses market shipping 2.75 million units, a 107% year-on-year increase.
(According to Xinhua News Agency, Chengdu, June 23)

title_en: "The Adventures of Qing Shan"
body_en:
"Qingshan" is a village located in Huanghu Town, Yuhang District, Hangzhou City. Ten years ago, Qingshan Village seemed "as immovable as a green mountain" to outsiders. While the surrounding areas were developing rapidly, Qingshan Village faced anxiety about its development due to insufficient prominence in terms of location, transportation, unique resources, and comparative advantages.

At that time, villagers could hardly imagine that one day, the water source of Qingshan Village would be selected as a "Potential Case of OECMs in China" and announced at the 16th Conference of the Parties to the United Nations Convention on Biological Diversity; the Qingshan Village Water Fund Ecological Compensation Promoting Rural Green Development case would be selected as a typical case of ecological protection compensation by the Ministry of Ecology and Environment, and would represent Zhejiang Province at the 10th Ecological Protection Compensation Theory and Practice Innovation Exchange and On-site Observation Meeting jointly organized by the National Development and Reform Commission and the Asian Development Bank.

Recently, the "West Lake Think Tank" Ecological Civilization Practice Station was launched in Qingshan Village. After conducting on-site research, several experts and scholars expressed that Qingshan Village is a vivid epitome of Zhejiang's practice of the concept that "green waters and green mountains are golden and silver mountains," interpreting its profound connotations through practical actions.

This once unknown village, through the combined efforts of the Party and government support, resource endowment, social participation, market drive, and united front assistance, successively overcame the three "barriers" of environment, industry, and governance, paving the way for a more universal path to rural revitalization.

First Barrier: Environmental Improvement
Establishing a diversified ecological protection compensation mechanism
Improving the environment was the first "barrier" that Qingshan Village had to overcome. The Longwu Reservoir in Qingshan Village is an important water source for Qingshan Village and Cibi Village in Huanghu Town, with approximately 1600 acres of bamboo forests planted around it. In the 1980s, with the development of the bamboo processing industry, villagers used large amounts of fertilizers and herbicides to achieve higher economic benefits, affecting the safety of drinking water.

For rural areas, a development approach that destroys the ecology and pollutes the environment will not go far; protecting green waters and green mountains through ecological compensation and ecological construction fund arrangements is also difficult to sustain. How to change from "I should protect" to "I want to protect," making wallets fuller and the environment more beautiful?

The turning point came in 2015 when a social organization entered the village to lead a new trend. The first rural water source protection project in China was looking for a pilot area for small watershed governance. Zhang Haijiang, the project leader, recalled that a large group of young volunteers came to Qingshan Village, forming the "Green Waters and Green Mountains" volunteer service team, dedicating themselves to the cause of water resource protection and environmental improvement.

With the support of the Alibaba Public Welfare Foundation and Wanxiang Trust, the project established the first water fund in China. This was not a traditional financial product but a special fund focused on the protection, management, and sustainable use of water resources, helping Qingshan Village establish a diversified ecological protection compensation mechanism.

This water fund not only centralized the management of forest land through property rights trusts, allowing villagers to receive ecological compensation each year not less than the previous income from bamboo operations but also collaborated with the Coca-Cola Foundation to create field micro-wetland systems in Qingshan Creek and resilient small watersheds, and cooperated with the China Rural Development Research Institute of Zhejiang University to carry out rural zero-carbon smart village construction, making the dividends of environmental improvement more substantial and tangible.

With efforts from various parties, in just three years, the water quality of the Longwu Reservoir improved from its original Class IV to stable compliance with Class I water standards, and the biodiversity of the water source area also significantly increased. Currently, there are over 200 species of wild plants, over 200 species of arthropods, over 100 species of birds, as well as various amphibians, reptiles, and mammals nesting and breeding in the area.

A more profound impact is the change in mindset. Encouraged by the "beneficiary pays" mechanism, villagers' awareness of ecological environmental protection has significantly increased, gradually changing their original production and lifestyle. Many villagers have transitioned from being "bamboo cutters" to "bamboo watchers": "In the past, we thought that protecting the environment was the government's responsibility, but now we know that protecting the environment is actually protecting our 'wallets.'"

"The sustainability of ecological compensation depends on the dynamic balance of government, market, and society," according to Zhang Xiumei, Deputy Director and Associate Researcher of the Public Policy Institute of Zhejiang Academy of Social Sciences. To activate the capital attributes of ecological resources, Qingshan Village directly addresses the core issue of the sustainability of ecological compensation, namely how to make protective behavior competitive in the market.

In the future, with the construction of a unified national market and the advancement of the "dual carbon" goals, the "market-based blood-making" model represented by Qingshan Village may become a universal formula for breaking the dual opposition between ecological protection and economic development. Zhang Xiumei said, "The key is to coordinate the relationship between government and the market, and establish an effective model of ecological compensation with multiple governance and benefits."

Second Barrier: Industrial Development
Promoting natural education and artistic rural construction
Improving the environment was just the beginning. For rural areas like Qingshan Village, how to develop industries to turn green waters and green mountains into golden and silver mountains faster is the more challenging second "barrier."

Qingshan Village's answer is to respect local genes, stimulate endogenous power, and integrate art with life naturally. After the improvement of the Longwu Reservoir water quality, its high-quality ecological foundation became a natural classroom for the development of natural education. Seizing the opportunity, Qingshan Village introduced social organizations such as the Qingshan Nature School, conducting courses on water source protection, biodiversity, low-carbon living, etc., attracting a large number of tourists to participate.

In just 2024, Qingshan Village added six boutique tourist routes, attracting over 180,000 visitors throughout the year. Social organizations such as the Alibaba Public Welfare Foundation, Wanxiang Trust, Rong Design Library, and Smile Tomorrow Library have grown and flourished here, not only bringing popularity but also increasing villagers' awareness of the value of ecology and further enhancing their environmental protection consciousness.

Artistic rural construction is another shining point of Qingshan Village. The art here is not the lofty art of palaces but a practical aesthetics deeply rooted in the soil and serving life. The Rong Design Library in the village is a representative work of artistic rural construction. The venue is renovated using local materials, blending seamlessly with the village environment. The library focuses on researching traditional Chinese materials and craftsmanship, becoming a cultural hub connecting tradition with modernity, rural areas with urban areas.

"We pay more attention to what hasn't changed in Qingshan Village." Zhang Lei, a partner at Rong Design Library and a designer who has been rooted in Qingshan Village for a long time, emphasized that the bottom-up authenticity, Qingshan Village's own aesthetic standards, and the mutual respect between old and new villagers are the fundamentals they adhere to.

He said, concepts such as "beauty in utility," "minimal intervention," and "reuse of local materials" have become the public guidelines for artistic rural construction in Qingshan Village. During the Dragon Boat Festival this year, with the assistance of a team from Nanjing Arts Institute, old and new villagers sewed a "patchwork dragon" from old clothes, which was both practical and beautiful.

To improve the integrated handicraft industry chain of production, study, research, and sales, Qingshan Village also built an Art Start Shared Wealth Square in the core area of the village. Operated by Qiangcun Company, it allows villagers to participate in production and profit from it right at their doorstep.

In addition, Qingshan Village customizes talent policies to continuously enhance the compatibility between talents and rural areas. Wang Kewei, a professional manager in Qingshan Village, explained that the local talent policy does not solely focus on the duration of social security contributions but also includes factors such as contribution, education, and connection with the village. Ultimately, the evaluation system is handed over to villagers for review, ensuring that only young people who genuinely love and are willing to live in the village long-term remain after the "big waves wash away the sand."

Rather than seeking short-term popularity, the focus is on building an ecological environment where a young community that loves rural life and identifies with rural values can "live in, integrate into, and develop." This community cohesion based on shared values and interests has become the key soft power for retaining talents and stimulating industrial vitality in Qingshan Village.

After conducting on-site research at Qingshan Nature School, Rong Design Library, Art Start Shared Wealth Square, etc., Du Yuwei, Deputy Director and Researcher of the Social Policy Research Institute of Jiangsu Academy of Social Sciences, was deeply impressed. He believes that the Qingshan model has formed a unique "future rural" development model, reshaping a new pattern of integrated urban-rural development, which is a vivid practice of humanistic economics in Zhejiang.

Third Barrier: Governance
Creating a rural public welfare model for "New Good Hangzhou"
With environmental optimization and industrial prosperity achieved, how to build a modern rural governance system that matches them, can ensure the coexistence and prosperity of multiple subjects, and can stimulate continuous endogenous power becomes the third "barrier" that Qingshan Village must overcome.

The traditional top-down, government-led governance model is unable to adapt to the complex situation of new villagers influx, emergence of new formats, and diverse new demands. How to solve this problem?

Yuhang District has a tradition of "matters for the people to discuss together." Under the guidance of the United Front Work Department of Yuhang District Committee, the new and old villagers of Qingshan Village established the Qingshan Tongxin Hui. This is the first sub-association of a village-level social organization for new social strata in Hangzhou, bringing together over 100 natural conservation workers, natural education instructors, designers, public welfare workers, cultural and tourism practitioners, etc.

Through a member contact and visit mechanism, they understand the ideological status and difficulties of members, helping new villagers to stay. They also recommend new villagers to serve as environmental consultants and aesthetic consultants in the village, grasp the overall aesthetics and ecological bottom line of rural construction, and promote the harmonious development of the ecological environment and industry.

The Qingshan Tongxin Hui also regularly convenes grassroots democratic consultation meetings with the People's Congress of Huanghu Town and the Village Committee of Qingshan Village, allowing new and old villagers to engage in face-to-face consultations on public affairs such as rural construction, grassroots governance, cultural public welfare, and industrial introduction, practicing full-process people's democracy. Vice President of Qingshan Tongxin Hui, Zheng Yu, still remembers the incident of water charges—

After the improvement of the Longwu Reservoir water quality, the Yuhang Water Company laid a water pipe network in the village and started charging water fees according to the corresponding standards. "Villagers used to fetch water for free from the reservoir, so charging fees inevitably caused dissatisfaction," Zheng Yu said. However, through negotiation, solutions such as tiered water prices and door-to-door water delivery services were implemented.

This year marks the end of the "14th Five-Year Plan" and is a crucial year for the construction of a demonstration area for common prosperity through high-quality development in the province. How to explore social governance experiences that match the connotation and path of common prosperity?

Hangzhou is promoting the construction of the "New Good Hangzhou" brand, mobilizing, guiding, and supporting new social strata to actively participate in social governance in the form of public welfare and charity, contributing to high-quality development. This points the way for optimizing governance in Qingshan Village.

Lin Hong, the Party Secretary of Qingshan Village, mentioned that the village will collaborate with the Alibaba Public Welfare Foundation to promote the construction of Alibaba Fliggy Shared Wealth Homestays, establishing Alibaba Public Welfare 3-hour destination. At the same time, in collaboration with the Alibaba Public Welfare Foundation, Wanxiang Trust, and the Nature Conservancy, the water fund 2.0 version will be upgraded, making the participation more diverse, the governance scope broader, and the operation mechanism more perfect.

It is worth mentioning that Huanghu Town is building a united front demonstration area with Qingshan Village as the core, organizing various activities for new social strata, democratic parties, etc., uniting and mobilizing all forces to assist in rural construction.

Li Baozhi, Director and Associate Researcher of the Talent Revitalization and Subject Development Research Office of Zhejiang Academy of Agricultural Sciences, believes that the core of rural revitalization is people. "The influx of new villagers into rural areas brings funds, technology, and ideas, but it may also disrupt the original social structure and interest pattern. Balancing the relationship between new and old villagers is the key to whether rural revitalization can be sustainable."

Qingshan Village is exploring new paths, through building a mechanism of co-governance, empowerment, cooperation in developing cultural and creative products, establishing a deliberative platform, etc., allowing new and old villagers to benefit from value creation, making the future of rural areas more imaginative.
