title_en: Huaian Bureau focuses on the rotation of samples for the investigation of batch, retail, accommodation, and catering restrictions.
body_en: This year, the Huainan Municipal Bureau of Statistics has conscientiously carried out the rotation of sample units for wholesale and retail businesses, accommodation and catering businesses below the quota. The Bureau has clearly defined the number of quarterly sample replacements and the standards for replacing samples that have been closed, cancelled, or suspended, verifying nearly 200 national samples and promptly replacing invalid samples to ensure the effectiveness of quarterly samples. They have held training sessions for the statistical business of sampling surveys below the quota, providing training on the statistical system below the quota, the scope of major statistical indicators, data reporting processes and timelines, refining statistical methods, system standards, and explaining indicator calibers, emphasizing the reporting requirements and key areas for economic indicators that are prone to underreporting or misreporting. They have strengthened the audit of reported sample data, ensuring immediate verification upon reporting, screening and verifying abnormal data changes daily, requiring enterprises and individual businesses to provide timely data support materials such as WeChat, Alipay, cash register systems, and tax certificates, conducting detailed audits, comparisons, and retention, and promptly making corrections when problems are found.

title_en: "Super long version of '618', reflecting which new consumer trends"
body_en:
Xinhua News Agency reporters Wang Yuxiao, Gong Liankang, and Li Xiaoting
The "618" shopping festival has an extended "standby" period, allowing "shopaholic-style consumption" to return to rational shopping; emerging niche markets such as trendy toys and cute pets are on the rise, with more vertical tracks emerging as new blue oceans; AI accelerates the transformation of the entire consumer industry chain, helping the industry move from "smart" to "new" ... This year's "618" reflects new trends in the consumption field.
Consumers are becoming more rational
"618" is getting longer and longer, which is a common feeling among many consumers in recent years.
In mid-May this year, platforms such as JD.com, Taobao, and Douyin started the "618" pre-sale promotion activities. It was learned that some platform promotion activities will continue until June 20, with a total duration of more than one month, setting a record for the longest time for "618".
Saying goodbye to complex "math problems," platform subsidy rules are also becoming simpler and more direct. In addition to the discounts such as "each person can receive over 6180 yuan in subsidies per day," JD.com has further increased the subsidy intensity for "618"; Tmall has canceled discounts that require complex calculations such as "spend a certain amount to get a discount," and only offers "official discounts" combined with various coupons; Douyin's e-commerce has invested billions in consumer vouchers to subsidize popular products, with each user able to receive up to 2280 yuan...
"This year's major promotional activities have a long duration, allowing us to slowly choose the things we really need, avoiding many impulsive purchases and not having to rack our brains to meet the requirements for discounts. I feel that '618' has become more refreshing and relaxed." Ms. Zhao, a consumer from Zhengzhou, Henan, said.
Focusing on creating diverse consumption scenes and experiences, offline businesses have also seized the opportunity of "618" to carry out a series of consumer promotion activities.
Customized AI photos, trying on glasses to experience AI translation, and other interactive activities attract people to queue up for check-ins; in the e-sports experience area, a variety of top-notch computer equipment makes e-sports enthusiasts feel satisfied; immersive real-life model rooms and whole-house customization services provide customers with a "one-stop" solution for home appliances and home decoration... At the recently unveiled JD MALL Shuangjing store in Beijing, a variety of integrated formats bring people a unique consumption experience.
"We have launched multiple discounts such as 'JD subsidies + brand subsidies + bank subsidies,' and through setting up immersive experience zones and introducing first-store trendy products, we allow consumers to enjoy more personalized and diversified goods and services offline." Chen Rui, deputy store manager of JD MALL Shuangjing store in Beijing, said.
Li Mingtao, an expert consultant on the National E-commerce Demonstration City Creation Working Committee, analyzed that this year's "618," the flow distribution mechanism of various platforms has shifted from "the one with the lowest price wins" to "the one with the best wins," and offline supermarkets are paying more attention to the sense of experience and scene creation. This is a reflection of consumers' shift from being "price-sensitive" to pursuing quality and rational consumption. Starting from demand orientation, major promotional activities can effectively activate consumption momentum.
"Shopping carts" reflect new trends in consumption
As an important annual consumption promotion node, "618" is undoubtedly an important indicator of new trends in the consumer market.
The rise of niche markets such as trendy toys and pets—
Labubu has sparked a "crazy unboxing" frenzy on social platforms, with online and offline products in high demand; the trend of "raising pets like raising children" has led to a large consumption of pet products... This "618," more niche subcategories are heating up, opening up new space to activate consumption.
"This year's '618,' multiple merchants in the toy and trendy toy field on Taobao and Tmall have sales exceeding one hundred million yuan, with nearly 800 single products exceeding one million yuan in sales. The overseas orders for 'valley-like' products have achieved triple-digit growth year-on-year, with the vast majority of transactions being derivatives of domestic IP." The head of the Taobao trendy toy industry told reporters.
Service consumption becomes a new engine—
"I took my child to Guizhou during the Dragon Boat Festival holiday and also booked a set of parent-child travel photography services online during the '618' promotion. The experience was very good," said Song Qian, a resident of Shenzhen.
"From the hot ice and snow economy to the rise of the silver-haired economy, service consumption is increasingly becoming a new engine driving consumption growth," said Zou Yunhan, deputy director of the Economic Forecasting Department of the National Information Center's Macroeconomic Research Office. Actively expanding service consumption scenarios and increasing the supply of high-quality services will better meet the growing consumer demand in areas such as elderly care, childcare, and entertainment.
"Instant retail" accelerates entry—
This year's "618," major platforms are accelerating the layout of instant retail formats, with Meituan Flash Purchase joining hands with millions of offline stores under well-known catering and retail brands to launch major promotional activities, and Taobao Flash Purchase also linking more offline entities during "618" to further increase subsidies.
"Users are increasingly pursuing 'instant satisfaction,' and instant retail is gradually extending to multiple fields such as maternity and baby products, 3C products, beauty, and clothing. From May 28 to June 1 alone, more than 800 brand merchants and retailers on Meituan Flash Purchase doubled their turnover year-on-year, with mobile phones, small home appliances, and liquor being very popular during '618'." The person in charge of Meituan Flash Purchase said.
AI helps businesses to "smartly" increase efficiency
"By choosing clothing, models, and scenes, we can use AI to generate various styles of real-person short videos with just one click, helping us quickly complete the product video matrix during the major promotion period and achieve visual upgrades," said a person in charge of Yunshang Wuhan International Fashion Center.
This person told reporters that the traditional clothing industry has a fast pace of new arrivals, and the production cost of graphic and video content is high. AI video tools greatly improve the efficiency of traditional video production, allowing companies to devote more energy to product design and marketing.
"AI is not only a production tool but also an amplifier of market insights," said Chang Ningxixi, co-founder of the oral care brand Canban. By intelligently analyzing user behavior data, it can help brands discover potential market demands and provide more precise decision-making references for product development.
JD Cloud has opened free AI marketing products to merchants, serving more than 13,000 brand merchants with JD Digital People; Taobao has launched the Business Manager "Tusheng Video" series of tools, generating over 1.5 million video materials for merchants in just over a month... This year's "618," AI is accelerating its integration into e-commerce formats, helping more platform merchants to "smartly" increase efficiency.
This year's "618," some consumers received a "surprise voice message" when receiving express delivery—"Grandma, my girlfriend and I wish you a happy Dragon Boat Festival. When we settle down, please come to Shenzhen to visit" "The college entrance examination is coming soon, remember that health comes first and exams come second. Brother will always be your support"... 
"We recently launched the 'surprise call' feature, with AI outbound calls providing technical support. Consumers can choose to record a voice message or let the 'AI versatile voice' generated by JD use their own voice. When the recipient receives the express delivery, they can also receive this voice message," said a person in charge of JD.
Chen Lifen, a researcher at the Market Economy Research Institute of the Development Research Center of the State Council, said that artificial intelligence is accelerating its integration into various industries, becoming an important force in activating consumer potential and driving industrial upgrading. With the gradual enrichment of technology iteration and landing scenarios, the combination of artificial intelligence and the consumer field is developing towards personalization and diversification, and is expected to activate more consumption increments in the future.
(Xinhua News Agency, Beijing, June 18)
sentiment_reason: New trends in the 618 event reflect the influence of e-commerce platforms like Taobao.

title_en:
Farewell to Zero-Sum "War of Attrition," E-commerce Platforms Shake Hands to Expand Global Markets Together

"618" New Observations:
body_en:
By Our Reporter Zhang Min
And Intern Reporter Liang Aonan
As an important annual event for promoting consumption, "618" is undoubtedly a key window for observing new trends in the consumer market. With the introduction of measures to curb "involutionary" competition, this year's "618" sees the e-commerce industry united under the banner of "anti-involution."

Signals from major e-commerce platforms like JD.com, Tmall, Meituan, and Douyin indicate that users are bidding farewell to complex promotional calculations, the merchant ecosystem is continuously being repaired, and platforms are breaking down payment and logistics barriers. The development logic of the e-commerce industry is being reshaped: moving away from zero-sum "attrition wars" and establishing a new ecosystem of symbiotic evolution. E-commerce platforms are reshaping the consumer market landscape with a return to value, and the path of adjustment and optimization has already begun.

User Experience Upgrade:
No More Complex Calculations Needed

Looking back at last year's "618," StarChart data shows that the cumulative sales of comprehensive e-commerce platforms and live-streaming platforms declined by nearly 7% year-on-year, marking the first-ever negative growth in history. When "trick marketing" piled high with complex rules reached its efficiency ceiling, consumers grew tired of the convoluted discount information.

This year's "618" promotion, however, has escaped the quagmire of "routine involution." Consumers no longer need to rack their brains over full discounts and stacking coupons (by using different types or sources of coupons to get larger discounts). Platforms are launching direct "instant discounts" strategies, signaling a fundamental shift in promotional logic.

On June 18th, this reporter opened the Tmall App and found that banners for "618 instant discounts starting from 85% off" and "618 flash sales" were very prominent on the homepage. Taking a fully automatic coffee machine priced at 1,999 yuan as an example, its product detail page clearly showed that after using official instant discounts, official subsidies, and store coupons, an additional 9% off coupon from an 88VIP account could be stacked. When this reporter clicked to checkout, the system automatically applied all coupons, and the final payment price displayed was 648.80 yuan. The entire shopping process was simple and convenient, requiring no complex calculations.

"Consumers simply don't buy into complex promotional activities," Mr. Cheng, an operations manager at an e-commerce platform, admitted to a reporter from Securities Daily. "Previously, we only focused on GMV and user growth. Now, we are more concerned with user retention rates and product repurchase rates, as these are the true indicators of capability."

The simplification of gameplay has led to a significant improvement in transaction efficiency. On the first day of this year's "618," nearly 800 brands on Meituan Flash Purchase saw their transaction volume double year-on-year. On Tmall's "618," 43 brands exceeded 100 million yuan in transaction volume within the first hour of sales, and 13,000 brands doubled their transaction volume. During the first hour of JD.com's "618," transaction volume, order volume, and the number of users placing orders all increased by over 200% year-on-year.

The consumer market is presenting a new landscape of rationality and diversity. As Hong Yong, an expert at the China Forum for Digital-Real Integration 50, stated, abandoning complex gameplay not only enhances the consumer experience but also aligns with consumers' focus on product quality, value for money, and services.

Commercial Ecosystem Optimization:
Reducing the Burden and Increasing Efficiency for Merchants

From the merchants' perspective, they are shifting from "survival of the fittest" to "support and symbiosis," and the imbalanced commercial ecosystem is being reshaped. Major e-commerce platforms are prioritizing platform governance and improving the business environment for merchants, with ecosystem construction and service quality upgrades taking center stage.

The "2024 E-commerce Platform 'Refund Only' Investigation Report" indicates that among the survey samples, 25% of users use the "refund only" service to "snatch up deals."

In March of this year, Luo Wen, Director of the State Administration for Market Regulation, introduced at the first "Ministers' Corridor" of the 14th National People's Congress, Third Session, that efforts will be made this year to optimize regulatory methods and means to vigorously promote the healthy development of the platform economy. To address the prominent issue of platforms abusing "refund only" rules, leading to merchants losing both goods and money, platforms will be urged to clarify the scope and specific circumstances for the application of these rules. Furthermore, regarding prominent issues such as platforms implementing "automatic price following" and "lowest price on the entire network" rules, platforms will be urged to standardize promotional activities.

On the eve of "618," mainstream e-commerce platforms comprehensively canceled the "refund only" policy. Requests for "refund without returning goods" after consumers receive their orders will be handled by merchants themselves.

"Macro policies have created significant opportunities for the development of the e-commerce industry. By decoupling 'refund only,' upgrading shipping insurance, and moving away from low-price involution, we can effectively address long-standing problems in the e-commerce industry and bring about a positive and stable business environment," stated Chu Duan, Vice President of Alibaba Group Holding Limited (hereinafter referred to as "Alibaba") and President of the Taobao Platform Business Unit.

Intensive "real money and silver" burden-reduction actions have also been implemented. Taobao and Tmall have launched 12 sets of merchant-benefiting measures to comprehensively improve the business environment. JD.com has broken through traffic barriers with "zero commission entry" and strengthened merchant competitiveness with "10 billion subsidies." Douyin E-commerce has significantly lowered the deposit threshold and launched a "0 yuan trial operation for all categories."

A healthy ecosystem where consumers dare to buy, merchants dare to sell, and platforms dare to innovate is accelerating its formation in the crucible of "618."

Platform "Dismantling Walls and Breaking Barriers":
From Closed Internal Strife to Open Traffic Attraction

This year's "618" sees major e-commerce platforms proactively dismantling the walls of traffic blockade, payment fragmentation, and logistics isolation, embarking on a path of win-win cooperation.

Payment and logistics, two business areas once considered core barriers by e-commerce, have now become breakthroughs for platform cooperation. In this year's "618" promotion, consumers can experience using WeChat Pay to purchase Taobao items, and JD Logistics delivering goods for Tmall merchants.

Wu Jia, Vice President of Alibaba and President of the Taotian User Platform Business Unit, stated that since integrating WeChat Pay, the usage frequency of young users and users in lower-tier markets on Taobao has also increased.

Data from commercial intelligence data service provider QuestMobile shows that in May of this year, the scale of overlapping users between Taobao and WeChat increased by 6.7% year-on-year, reaching 875 million. The scale of overlapping users between JD.com and Alipay increased by 20.4% year-on-year, reaching 581 million.

Furthermore, a grand alliance has been formed among major e-commerce platforms, with new cooperative relationships constantly emerging. On the eve of "618," Taobao and Tmall collaborated with Xiaohongshu to create the "Red Cat Plan," integrating the entire journey from "seed planting" to purchasing. JD.com has also integrated Xiaohongshu's direct link functionality and partnered with the regional retail leader Pang Donglai to strengthen its fulfillment capabilities through its physical network.

"Before, if I saw something I wanted to buy on Xiaohongshu, I had to take a screenshot and then search for it on e-commerce platforms to buy it. This year for '618,' I can jump directly between platforms, and the shopping experience is becoming increasingly seamless," said Ms. Yu, a consumer, to this reporter.

Guo Tao, Deputy Director of the China E-commerce Expert Service Center, stated that in a market with maturing growth and limited incremental opportunities, e-commerce platforms are beginning to embrace "traffic giants." This is essentially a desire to win allies and expand more traffic sources, further driving the commercial scale of the e-commerce ecosystem.

Incremental Market Development:
Global Gold Mining is Now the Time

With domestic traffic reaching its peak, "going global" has become the inevitable choice for e-commerce platforms seeking new growth.

In 2024, China's cross-border e-commerce imports and exports reached 2.63 trillion yuan, a year-on-year increase of 10.8%. The potential of cross-border e-commerce in "selling globally" is being further unleashed, and its advantage in "buying globally" continues to be leveraged.

The global network of infrastructure is accelerating the pace of "going global." Since April, downloads of DHgate, Taobao, and Alibaba.com on the US App Store have surged.

"Going global" has become an important strategy for e-commerce platforms to help merchants achieve new growth. It is understood that the number of merchants participating in Tmall's 2025 "618" overseas event has exceeded one million.

Hang Xin, head of Tmall Taobao's overseas growth plan, told a reporter from Securities Daily that "going global" not only expands new markets for merchants but also drives explosive growth in some industries. Among them, cross-border transaction volumes in 11 categories on the Taobao platform, including beauty and skincare, sports shoes, and milk powder, have doubled year-on-year.

On June 17th, Liu Qiangdong, founder of JD.com, stated: "I hope that one day I can hand over all domestic business to the CEO as soon as possible, and I will devote myself full-time to international business."

An insider from Alibaba International Station told reporters that the platform is currently holding a major promotion for the US market in June. This promotion will not only allow Chinese foreign trade merchants to enjoy overseas traffic support and receive foreign orders but will also benefit more "beginner merchants" interested in foreign trade business through promotional policies.

"For Chinese enterprises to achieve high-quality global development, they must enhance their brand power to extend their product capabilities and elevate their value. We have good products and strong manufacturing capabilities, but we still lack the ability to 'tell' and 'spread' these advantages. Brands need not only to 'do well' but also to 'speak well'," said Wu Yulin, Senior Business Development Director of The Trade Desk China, a digital advertising technology company, to reporters.

The essence of this "going global" wave is value reconstruction. E-commerce platforms will use cross-border infrastructure as their vessel, and merchants will use product innovation as their oars, jointly sailing towards the deep waters of brand building, where "doing well is as important as speaking loudly."

As Zhuang Shuai, a retail e-commerce industry expert and visiting consultant for the China Chain Store & Franchise Association, put it, the main theme for e-commerce platforms in 2025 will be "anti-involution" and a return to value. The evolutionary story of China's e-commerce ecosystem has turned a new page.
sentiment_reason: New trends in the 618 event reflect the influence of e-commerce platforms like Taobao.

title_en: iQiyi takes the initiative to lay out, while Youku and Tencent are cautious and watchful.
body_en:
For VR movies, mainland mainstream video platforms iQiyi, Youku, and Tencent Video have different reactions. Public information shows that iQiyi was involved the earliest, producing more than 20 VR video contents in 2017, including "City of No Owner" and "Hot Blood Street Dance Troupe VR," which were linked to popular TV dramas. An industry insider revealed anonymously that due to the low penetration rate of headsets in the consumer market and weak willingness to pay from users, iQiyi's VR department had undergone large-scale layoffs and shifted towards offline scenarios.
In 2023, iQiyi launched the "Wind Rising in Luoyang" VR immersive theater in Shanghai, developed based on the popular TV series IP of the same name, integrating live performance and VR immersive interactive technology, making it the world's first VR immersive cross-dimensional interactive entertainment project. To date, iQiyi's self-developed "Wind Rising in Luoyang," "Tang Dynasty Strange Tales: Journey to the West," and "Canglan Jue" series of immersive theater projects have been completed in over 40 stores nationwide, covering more than 20 cities, and established the world's first iQiyi theme park in Yangzhou, combining IP to create an XR large space experience area, aiming to open this year.
The industry insider said, "Mainland video platforms are all imitating the 'Disney + Netflix' dual-track model: Netflix focuses on high-quality original content as its core competitiveness, while Disney achieves value maximization through the full industry chain development such as theme parks; mainland platforms want to create hit content (following the Netflix path) while also aspiring to develop IP deeply like Disney (such as building a Chinese version of a theme park). iQiyi is actively laying out offline physical experiences, trying to transform film and television IP into Disney-style physical entertainment projects, achieving a 'content + experience' business closed loop." The industry insider mentioned that Disney and Universal Studios have provided successful models for the combination of "IP + VR," with projects like Disney's "Rise of the Resistance" and Universal Studios' "Forbidden Journey of Harry Potter" proving that VR technology's application in offline theme parks is relatively mature. These projects rely on strong IP (such as Disney's classic characters, movie scenes) and sophisticated interactive design to transform VR technology into highly engaging entertainment products, becoming industry benchmarks.
He added, "I believe the short-term opportunity for VR lies in the combination of offline scenarios and strong IP, for example, developing offline VR parks using strong IPs like 'Nezha,' restoring movie scenes through headsets + roller coasters, and designing NPC interactions, which may break through bottlenecks. This model draws on Disney's IP operation logic, transforming VR into an 'IP monetization tool.'"
Film and television platforms need to deeply develop IP commercial value
The industry insider said, "Current film and television platforms face a core dilemma: the vast majority of TV series and movies struggle to be profitable through traditional broadcasting models. A series usually only has a one-month period of popularity, and relying solely on subscription and advertising revenue cannot cover the high production costs. This forces platforms to deeply develop the commercial value of IP, such as launching blind box peripherals (similar to the Pop Mart model), developing fan economies, and other diversified monetization channels. iQiyi's choice to build offline parks is an extension of this commercial logic—expanding profit points through ticket sales."
"Unlike Tencent Video and Youku, iQiyi, as an independently listed company, faces more severe profit pressure. Tencent Video and Youku are backed by Tencent and Alibaba Group, while iQiyi needs to be directly accountable to shareholders. Film and television content itself has a high degree of uncertainty, with numerous examples proving that even with large investments and famous directors, a hit product is not guaranteed. This content risk is directly reflected in financial performance, forcing platforms to find a second growth curve (such as offline entertainment) to balance business risks and demonstrate sustainable profitability to shareholders. Film and television platforms may need to restructure their business models—from 'content providers' to 'IP operators,' reducing reliance on single content through the full industry chain development, which may be the strategic essence of iQiyi's layout of offline ecology."
The industry insider pointed out that Tencent Video and Whale Entertainment are also laying out IP. "Whale Entertainment's core IP layout is 'Ali Fish,' which controls the authorization resources of top IPs globally, providing authorization support for the development of blind boxes, toys, and other derivative products, and relying on Youku and Damai Entertainment's two core platforms to achieve all-round development of IP: producing online content such as TV series and variety shows through Youku, and carrying out offline businesses such as movie production, live performances, and OST concerts through Damai Entertainment. This 'one fish, multiple meals' model has formed an entertainment consumption ecosystem covering online and offline scenarios, maximizing the value of IP."
"In general, I believe the industry is currently in a game of cautious observation and policy-driven development. Compared to iQiyi, Tencent Video, Whale Entertainment, and other platforms are adopting conservative strategies, taking a cautious attitude towards VR movies, with their focus still on content production and the full industry chain development of IP, such as TV series, offline performances, and derivative products." He said, "The core of cultural consumption products such as film and television variety shows is always 'content quality.' Only when the content is of high quality and recognized by users will other forms of media extension be considered. Classic content has the vitality to transcend cycles, and the industry has shifted from the past model of burning money for expansion to focusing on deepening content, confirming the logic of 'quality content driving long-term value.' He revealed that compared to directly laying out VR movies, Whale Entertainment now tends to serve content production through virtual shooting technology, perhaps stemming from the platform's doubts about the commercial logic of VR movies—whether users are willing to pay for immersive content outside of cinemas still needs time to verify."

title_en: Police issue urgent warning about summer flight ticket refund and change fraud.
body_en:
This newspaper (Reporter Sun Ying) The summer tourist season is approaching, and scammers are targeting tourists and students with airline tickets again. The "refund and change" fraud is on the rise. The Beijing police issued an emergency warning yesterday to beware of the "refund and change" scam. Scammers first let the victim log in to Alipay or other legitimate platforms to process the refund, in order to gain the victim's trust, and then guide the victim to log in to a fake website or app to complete the scam.

Recently, Mr. Wang, a resident, purchased a plane ticket in preparation for a trip. The day before departure, he suddenly received a call from a stranger, who claimed that the plane Mr. Wang was about to board could not take off due to landing gear damage, and offered to handle the refund or change for him.

Without verifying the situation, Mr. Wang followed the instructions to log in to the Alipay interface for the payment operation, filled in the Civil Aviation Administration Alipay account, refund amount, and reason for refund, and clicked to confirm the payment. However, the Alipay interface prompted "the other party is an enterprise account, unable to create a payment."

Although the refund failed on the legitimate platform, after this series of operations, Mr. Wang became deeply convinced of the refund matter, not knowing that the real trap was just beginning.

The other party claimed that Mr. Wang's failure to open a corporate account caused the refund to fail, and step by step guided Mr. Wang to visit a fake Civil Aviation Administration website, download an app called "Timely Service," input his bank account and password, and open a so-called corporate account. During this process, the other party claimed that the account needed to be verified before the refund, and asked Mr. Wang to transfer 440,000 yuan and 260,000 yuan to the account. After the transfers were completed, Mr. Wang did not receive the promised refund.

Anti-fraud police detailed the scam tactics of this "refund and change" fraud. First, scammers usually contact the victim by phone the day before the plane takes off, falsely claiming that the flight has been canceled due to unforeseen circumstances, and promising compensation and rebooking services. Then, scammers instruct the victim to log in to a legitimate payment platform for a refund, making the victim believe it is true. When the refund fails, they guide the victim to log in to a fake website or unofficial app, and then trick the victim into transferring money to complete the scam.

The police remind the public that when purchasing or changing airline tickets, it is important to do so through legitimate channels and not to trust any low-priced tickets or refund/change information from unofficial platforms. If receiving notifications of flight cancellations, delays, or changes, do not click on links directly or call the phone number provided in the notification. Verify with the official channels of the airline first. For any ticket refunds or changes, there is no need to transfer money to the other party first, and do not provide bank account numbers or passwords to strangers or on unofficial websites or platforms.

title_en: Chinese brands are accelerating their rise by upgrading quality through "trade-in" programs. Online and offline interactions are both active, reflecting a new landscape of e-commerce consumption in China during the "618" shopping festival.
body_en:
Reporter Sun Qiru
The annual "618" e-commerce promotion has begun, with the rise of emotional interest-based new consumer trends, Chinese brands accelerating their rise, "trade-in for new" leading quality upgrades, and online and offline interactions in all fields... The highlights of the "618" promotion have become a powerful booster for unleashing consumer potential and driving industrial upgrades.
"Supplementing and enhancing" boosts quality consumption upgrades
Following last year's purchase of many household appliances during "Double 11," Ms. Yao placed another order during "618" for a domestic smartphone priced at over 6000 yuan and an ultra-thin refrigerator. "With platform subsidies and national subsidies, the price is really affordable."
Many platforms started their "618" promotions a month ago. This year, many platforms have simplified their promotional strategies by eliminating complex methods such as full reductions and stacking coupons, instead opting for direct discounts to facilitate transactions, making it easier for consumers to shop. At the same time, with the addition of national subsidies, many products have very attractive prices during the "618" period, further stimulating people's enthusiasm for consumption.
Mr. Sun, who loves travel and photography and is approaching retirement age, recently purchased a DJI drone, saving 900 yuan with just the national subsidy, and over a thousand yuan with platform subsidies.
With the dual benefits of national subsidies and e-commerce promotions, the enthusiasm for quality upgrades in consumption continues to rise. A responsible person from JD Retail revealed yesterday that this year's "618" platform unprecedented subsidy intensity and multiple subsidy stacking have driven explosive sales in multiple categories, with sales of mobile communications, household appliances, and food and seasoning increasing by 88%, 161%, and 138% respectively compared to the previous year. Among them, the sales volume of smartphones in the 4000 to 6000 yuan price range increased by 50% year-on-year, AI notebooks increased by 151% year-on-year, and sales of 100-inch TVs increased by 260% year-on-year.
The rise of emotional interest-based new consumer trends
"Many people don't understand why such a small hardware item can be sold for hundreds or even thousands of yuan. Being able to play with it anytime, anywhere is very interesting," said white-collar worker Mr. Liu, showing the two fingertip gyroscopes he just bought during "618."
From fingertip gyroscopes to push cards and titanium fans, some metal gadgets known as EDC (Everyday Carry) are gradually entering the urban male vision of pursuing a refined lifestyle and stress relief from being niche geek toys. According to Taobao, the transaction volume of EDC toys on the platform has exceeded 150 million yuan, with consumers ranging in age from 18 to 60, and a rapid increase in young consumers aged 18 to 24. As of June 12, six merchants in the Taobao toy trend industry had sales exceeding 100 million yuan, nearly a hundred merchants exceeding tens of millions of yuan, 16 single products exceeding tens of millions of yuan, and over 2400 Taobao toy stores achieving triple-digit year-on-year growth, leading to explosive growth in the entire industry.
The Labubu craze that has swept the world from China in the past year also staged a "reverse cargo" during "618." On June 18, the special live broadcast of Pinduoduo Mart on AliExpress went live, attracting 240,000 people from countries such as the UK, Canada, Australia, and New Zealand to the live broadcast room, with more than 10 popular IP products including Labubu being instantly sold out as soon as they were listed.
Derivative products of copyrighted works such as comics, animations, games, idols, and special effects are driving the rapid growth of the "Guizi" economy. The person in charge of the Taobao toy industry told reporters that during this year's "618," the number of overseas orders for "Guizi" products increased by triple digits year-on-year, and it is particularly gratifying that the vast majority of transactions came from derivative products of domestic IPs.
The bustling instant retail track
Not only is online sales hot, but this year's "618" has achieved full-channel linkage between online and offline, driving growth in orders for physical stores.
"Since the food delivery market has new players, I have been drinking unlimited 5.9 yuan coffee for the past two weeks. If the takeaway doesn't arrive on time, the platform even gives it for free," said freelancer Mr. Yang.
According to JD data, during "618," the platform's instant retail business achieved explosive growth. The person in charge of JD's food delivery service introduced at the "618" media open day that although the food delivery business was officially launched in March this year, the daily order volume has exceeded 25 million, with over 1.5 million high-quality dining establishments joining, and the number of full-time delivery riders exceeding 120,000, showing strong growth momentum. At the same time, JD's food delivery service has also generated significant synergies with existing retail businesses, with over 400,000 new registered PLUS members driven by the food delivery business in April alone, and the food delivery repurchase rate of PLUS members being twice that of non-members.
Li Mingtao, an expert from the National E-commerce Demonstration City Expert Committee, stated that the "618" e-commerce promotion, from simplified rules to the introduction of instant retail, reflects the platforms' grasp of changes in consumer demand. Consumers have higher requirements for product quality, cost-effectiveness, and experiential value, and only by starting from demand orientation can the promotion effectively stimulate consumer enthusiasm.
sentiment_reason: New trends in the 618 event reflect the influence of e-commerce platforms like Taobao.

title_en: The highest three years of zero commission, JD enters the wine and travel industry, and once again stages a "Three Kingdoms Kill" with Alibaba and Meituan.
body_en:
On June 18th, JD Travel released an open letter to all hotel operators, officially entering the hotel and travel industry. JD stated that in recent years, the tourism market has been thriving, giving rise to more diverse demands. JD hopes to provide supply chain services to the hotel industry through new channels, optimize supply chain costs, and promote the healthy and sustainable development of the hotel industry.
Compared to the food delivery industry, the competition in the hotel and travel market is more intense, adding a sense of tension to the industry with JD's move.
JD's Entry
Similar to entering the food delivery industry, JD first showed "sincerity" to merchants. JD proposed that hotel merchants participating in the "JD Hotel PLUS Membership Program" would enjoy up to three years of 0 commission.
JD stated that its advantage lies in having over 800 million high-spending users nationwide, deep cooperation with over 30,000 large enterprises and over 8 million small and medium-sized enterprise customers nationwide. JD users and partners highly overlap with the main customer base of four-star or higher hotels. At the same time, JD is the platform of the first camp in domestic local life traffic, and the high-frequency consumption of massive users has also given rise to more consumption demands such as travel.
At a sharing session on June 17th, JD's founder, Liu Qiangdong, discussed entering the hotel and travel business, stating that the goal is to reduce the costs of these industries by 1/3 through the supply chain and provide a new channel for hotel catering.
Regarding JD's launch of the hotel and travel business, analysts believe it is related to JD's previous accumulations.
Chen Liteng, a digital life analyst at the E-commerce Research Center of NetEase, told Yicai that JD's hotel and travel business is currently in the investment period, optimizing the entrance and integrating resources in parallel. JD launched flight booking in 2011, established the JD Travel channel in 2014, and accumulated supply chain resources through investments in Tuniu and strategic cooperation with Ctrip. The current move can be seen as a strategic upgrade of existing businesses rather than starting from scratch.
Why does JD aim at hotel and travel for innovation? In terms of profit, the profit of the hotel and travel business is higher than that of the food delivery business. Before Meituan adjusted its financial report disclosure method in the second quarter of 2022, the financial report showed that the hotel and travel business was the most profitable business for Meituan. In the first quarter of 2022, Meituan's revenue from catering and food delivery business was 24.2 billion yuan, with an operating profit of 1.6 billion yuan. The revenue from the hotel and travel business in the first quarter was 7.6 billion yuan, with an operating profit of 3.5 billion yuan, a year-on-year increase of 26.4% to 35 billion yuan, and an operating profit margin of 45.6%. Although the revenue of the hotel and travel business is only one-third of the revenue from catering and food delivery, it contributes more than twice the profit.
Ctrip's financial report for the first quarter of this year showed revenue of 13.8 billion yuan and a net profit of 4.3 billion yuan, with an adjusted EBITDA profit margin of 31%.
At the same time, looking at the development path of Douyin Local Life, which is also a latecomer in the hotel and travel industry, there is still room for growth in the current market. In addition, after entering the hotel and travel business, the platform can also drive group buying for catering, tickets, photography, and other in-store services, with even greater potential. For example, the "2025 May Day Consumption Data Report" released by Douyin Local Life shows that offline in-store consumption during the May Day holiday was strong, with orders for accommodation, family meals, and Douyin group purchases increasing by over 70%, and hotel and scenic spot package group purchase orders increasing by 116%. The in-store verification volume of chain clothing store group purchases increased by 462%.
Regarding JD's entry into hotel and travel, Chen Liteng believes that JD's core advantage lies in its mature supply chain management system. According to public information, JD plans to replicate its industrial supply chain experience in the hotel and travel industry, compressing hotel operating costs through direct procurement. In addition, relying on the precipitation of JD's retail business and the breakthrough of the food delivery business, its hotel and travel sector has a natural flow entry. Data for the first quarter of 2025 shows that JD's daily food delivery orders reached 25 million, with high-net-worth males accounting for 72% of the over 30 million users in the PLUS membership system, which is highly compatible with corporate travel demand. If airport VIP lounges and hotel benefits are integrated into the membership ecosystem, it can leverage the B-side market.
Intense Market Competition
Compared to the food delivery business, the current competition in the hotel and travel industry is more intense, with major platforms each having their own advantages.
Chen Liteng believes that the leading platform Ctrip has been deeply cultivating the hotel and travel industry for 20 years, with its core competitiveness lying in high-star hotel resources, a well-established business travel service chain, and leading AI technology applications, and is shifting its focus to the global market. In addition, Tongcheng Travel has obvious advantages in the sinking market. Meituan, through the "Local Life + Hotel and Travel" closed-loop, has a high penetration rate of homestays and chain hotels; Fliggy relies on the Alibaba ecosystem and has advantages in resource acquisition and user traffic. Mafengwo mainly provides destination strategies and services, while Qunar's strengths lie in flight price comparison and booking. In addition, social platforms such as Douyin and Xiaohongshu are accelerating their entry into hotel and travel content marketing.
This also means that JD will face fierce challenges. Considering JD's mention of reducing supply chain costs, a new round of "price wars" in the local life field may also emerge. In 2023, Douyin and Kuaishou aggressively entered the local life field, with Douyin announcing in October of that year that it would invest 500 million yuan over the next year to encourage and support influencers to explore stores and facilitate transactions between businesses and influencers. Later, Meituan countered by reducing commissions and launching live streaming.
In the OTA market, years ago, there were price wars among various companies, and in the end, through acquisitions, Ctrip "eliminated opponents," with eLong and Qunar both falling under the Ctrip umbrella. With the "extinguishing" of Lvmama, there are still active players in the market such as Tongcheng Travel, Tuniu, Mafengwo, and Fliggy, with Meituan also focusing on the hotel and travel business.
In the OTA field, JD still faces its old rivals Alibaba and Meituan, who are fiercely competing in the food delivery market.
Zhao Huanyan, a senior economist and veteran tourism industry analyst, believes that behind Fliggy is Alibaba. With JD's "invasion" of the hotel and travel market, along with Meituan, the competition in the entire online travel market has become more intense, especially since Alibaba, JD, and Meituan are internet e-commerce companies that do not only focus on the hotel and travel business, thus having a large user base with many highly sticky users. However, Ctrip, Tongcheng Travel, Tuniu, and others have higher levels of expertise in various aspects of hotels, attractions, and travel services, and have a deeper market presence. Therefore, who will have the advantage in the tourism market will depend on the specific services provided to tourists in the future, and which platform consumers are more willing to pay on.
sentiment_reason: Alibaba is participating in the competition but has no clear emotional preference.

title_en: Some regions cancel "national subsidy"? There is no hot spot for consumer goods to be replaced with old ones.
body_en:
During the "618" period, online and offline promotional activities continued for several days, and consumers' enthusiasm for trading in old items for new ones remained high. However, there were discussions on social media about some regions temporarily unable to apply for the "national subsidy." In response to these hot topics, reporters conducted interviews in various locations.

Since the end of May, discussions about Chongqing, Jiangsu, Hubei, and other regions temporarily unable to receive the "national subsidy" have attracted attention on social media. When reporters checked the Yunshanfu App's Chongqing consumer goods trade-in page, an announcement mentioned that the subsidy funds for 27 small categories of green smart home appliances and home improvement kitchen and bathroom "renewal" had been used up.

Recently, when logging into the national subsidy section on Taobao, reporters also saw a notice on the Jiangsu page stating, "Jiangsu national subsidy activity is being upgraded, and you will not be able to receive it during the upgrade." The Hubei page on the JD national subsidy section also had reminders such as "Hubei smart home national subsidy activity is being upgraded."

Based on these statements, some netizens began to speculate whether the "national subsidy" in some areas would be stopped. Through interviews with relevant departments and officials in various locations, reporters learned that there is no situation of canceling the "national subsidy."

Reporters contacted the Market Operation and Consumer Promotion Department of the Jiangsu Provincial Department of Commerce and learned that the consumer goods trade-in policy in Jiangsu has not been suspended. Jiangsu's previous announcement clearly stated the regulations for the management of the consumer goods trade-in funds, which includes the implementation of quota management for the "national subsidy."

At the end of May, the Chongqing Municipal Commerce Commission replied in its "Public Mailbox" section on its official website that the city is actively expanding the implementation of the consumer goods trade-in subsidy policy, and the enthusiasm of the citizens is high. The first phase of subsidy funds is about to be used up. Currently, relevant departments are drafting the second phase of the trade-in subsidy policy.

The Hubei Provincial Department of Commerce explicitly told reporters that the Hubei national subsidy activity will run throughout the year 2025, until December 31. "Currently, daily quotas are issued for home appliances and digital 3C products, and it is first-come, first-served," said Dong Wei, a staff member of the circulation department of the Hubei Provincial Department of Commerce.

Industry insiders stated that some regions have temporarily improved the pace of implementing the "national subsidy" policy. In fact, the consumer goods trade-in work will continue throughout the year, and consumers will have the opportunity to apply for the "national subsidy" every month and every week. Recently, some companies, platforms, and self-media have taken advantage of the situation to create panic and consumers should be particularly careful in discerning. In fact, apart from the few regions mentioned above, most provinces' national subsidy activities are progressing normally.

The consumer goods trade-in policy is an important policy promoted at the national level. Why is the usage of the "national subsidy" different in various regions after its implementation?

Through research, reporters found that based on the national subsidy rules, each region has a certain degree of autonomy to determine the "small details" of the implementation of the national subsidy, such as how to apply for and use the subsidy.

He Daixin, director and researcher of the Financial Research Office of the Financial Strategy Research Institute of the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences, believes that the progress of policy implementation in some regions is related to the local consumption structure and consumer enthusiasm. "This also indicates that the market demand for the 'national subsidy' is strong, and the policy has stimulated consumption vitality."

Since the beginning of this year, the consumer goods trade-in policy has been "strengthened" and "expanded," not only adding new categories such as mobile phones, tablets, dishwashers, but also doubling the scale of the long-term special national bonds arranged, from 150 billion yuan last year to 300 billion yuan this year.

This 300 billion yuan of long-term special national bonds, combined with local matching and self-arranged funds, constitute the source of the "national subsidy."

Reporters learned that this 300 billion yuan is distributed to local governments in "chunks." When distributing, factors such as the permanent population, regional GDP, the number of cars and household appliances, the 2024 consumer goods trade-in policy, and the execution of funds are considered, and the funds are distributed to regions where the consumer goods trade-in work has been more effective by 2024.

This year, the central government has arranged a total of 300 billion yuan in long-term special national bonds to support the consumer goods trade-in, and this amount is fixed. In order to allow local governments to use central funds reasonably, orderly, and sustainably, the 300 billion yuan in central funds is distributed in batches.

According to relevant ministries, a total of 162 billion yuan in central funds has been allocated in two batches in January and April this year to support local consumer goods trade-in work in the first and second quarters. The remaining 138 billion yuan in central funds will be distributed in an orderly manner in the third and fourth quarters, and local governments will also provide sufficient local funds accordingly. The "national subsidy" will continue to benefit a large number of consumers.

The consumer goods trade-in policy has a long and complex chain of implementation. In an interview at the "China Economic Roundtable" launched in early June, Ding Lin, Deputy Director of the Comprehensive Department of the National Development and Reform Commission, mentioned in a series of policy measures to expand domestic demand that the distribution of funds for the consumer goods trade-in will be accelerated.

Through research, reporters found that many regions are actively optimizing and improving policy processes, focusing on reducing the pressure on participating companies to advance subsidy funds, innovating work measures, and enhancing consumers' experience and sense of gain.

Several experts and scholars have stated that since its implementation last year, the consumer goods trade-in policy has become an important focus for promoting consumption and expanding domestic demand.

In Hubei, as of June 11, the total sales volume of 3C digital products, household appliances, kitchen and bathroom products, and electric bicycles traded in for new ones in the province this year reached 33.5815 million units, cumulatively driving total sales of 41.483 billion yuan; in Liaoning, the number of consumers participating in the consumer goods trade-in activities in the province has reached 2 million, directly driving consumption of over 15 billion yuan... From the implementation in various regions, the policy progress is positive, and the effects are continuously emerging.

Data from the Ministry of Commerce shows that as of May 31, the five major categories of consumer goods traded in for new ones in 2025 have driven total sales of 1.1 trillion yuan, with approximately 175 million subsidies distributed directly to consumers.

"From the practices in various regions, the policy not only significantly boosts the sales of related consumer goods but also actively promotes the upgrading of related consumer goods structure and the transformation and upgrading of related industrial chains," said Yao Dongmin, a professor at the Central University of Finance and Economics and Deputy Director of the China Financial Development Collaborative Innovation Center. With the subsequent distribution of funds and continuous optimization of the system, the consumer goods trade-in policy is expected to continue to play a positive role and benefit more people.

Xinhua News Agency, Beijing, June 18th.

title_en: Deeply develop the consumer scene ecosystem to create new support points for consumption growth.
