title_en: Quanzhou Zhonglian | Helping "Jinpin Going Global" Weitou - Kinmen Maritime Silk Road Cross-border · Jin Yun Route Maiden Voyage
body_en: At 18:30 on June 7th, the "Yixin" ship, loaded with ten containers, slowly set sail from Weitou Port in Jinjiang to Kinmen Port, marking the official opening of the "Jinpin Out to Sea" Weitou-Kinmen Maritime Silk Road. Quanzhou Zhonglian, with its accurate and efficient tallying services, provided solid guarantees for the rapid customs clearance of goods. Weitou Port in Jinjiang, as the closest port on the mainland to Kinmen, actively integrates into the "Maritime Silk Road Economic Belt" due to its unique geographical advantage. The journey on this route only takes 2 hours, significantly shortening the logistics time for goods entering Taiwan from platforms like Alibaba, and effectively reducing costs, providing a convenient channel for enterprises to expand overseas markets through "Jinpin Out to Sea." To ensure the smooth progress of tallying operations, Quanzhou Zhonglian conducted detailed communication and coordination with the port, shipowners, and agents in advance, and organized pre-operation meetings to carefully develop a detailed tallying operation plan. During the operation, the staff meticulously checked each container number and seal number according to the export manifest provided by the agent, strictly controlling the operation standards, safety quality, and data accuracy to ensure the entire operation process is precise and error-free. In the future, Quanzhou Zhonglian will continue to deepen service innovation, continuously improve the professional level of tallying operations, provide more solid guarantees for the prosperity and development of cross-strait trade, and help cross-strait economic and trade cooperation reach new heights. Source | Zhonglian Tallying, China Inspection and Testing.
sentiment_reason: Logistics times for goods entering Taiwan on platforms like Alibaba have been reduced, increasing efficiency and lowering costs.

title_en: High-frequency data in May reflects the economy improving towards the "new" direction.
body_en: In May, the offline consumption heat index increased by 25.7% year-on-year, the online retail sales of household appliances increased by 31.0% year-on-year, the amount of winning bids in national projects increased by 21.5% year-on-year, and the production heat index of industrial parks increased by 21.2% year-on-year... The reporter of "Economic Reference News" learned on June 12 from the Big Data Development Department of the National Information Center that multiple high-frequency data show that in May this year, China's consumption, investment, industrial production, and other fields have seen a surge in "heat," reflecting a positive trend in the economy towards the "new" and strong vitality. The data shows that in May, various high-frequency consumption indicators in China showed an upward trend, with overall consumption showing a steady improvement. In terms of offline consumption, the offline consumption heat index constructed by the National Information Center based on sample business district foot traffic data increased by 25.7% year-on-year in May. Online consumption vitality is also steadily increasing. The life service consumption heat index constructed by the National Information Center based on user consumption order data from life service e-commerce platforms increased by 14.6% year-on-year in May, with leisure and entertainment, accommodation, catering, and tourism industries increasing by 28.8%, 12.1%, 10.8%, and 2.3% respectively. "The rise in consumption market heat is inseparable from the continuous effectiveness of various consumption-promoting policies," said Yang Daoling, Director of the Big Data Analysis Department of the Big Data Development Department of the National Development and Reform Commission National Information Center. On the one hand, a series of convenient policies have driven the popularity of "traveling in China" to new highs. Data from the National Immigration Administration shows that during the "May Day" period this year, the number of foreign nationals entering and exiting the country was 1.115 million, an increase of 43.1% compared to the same period last year; Alipay data shows that in the first three days of the "May Day" holiday, the consumption amount of inbound tourists using Alipay increased by 180% year-on-year. Holiday consumption has led to a continuous increase in the number of inbound tourists in many places. As of May 27, the total number of inbound and outbound personnel at Beijing ports exceeded 8 million, an increase of 22.1% year-on-year; as of May 29, the number of inbound and outbound personnel at Shenzhen Airport ports has exceeded 2.6 million this year, an increase of 31.1% year-on-year. On the other hand, the enthusiasm for "trading in old for new" remains unabated, and household appliance consumption maintains a relatively high growth rate. Monitoring data from the National Information Center on the online retail sales of major household appliance categories show that the online retail sales of related household appliances increased by 31.0% year-on-year in May, with a growth rate 8.7 percentage points higher than the previous month, continuing the strong growth momentum since the beginning of this year. At the same time, government investment continues to increase, with data showing that the year-on-year growth rate of the amount of winning bids for projects in May continues to expand. "Since the beginning of this year, fiscal policies have been continuously strengthened to provide more solid financial support for various major projects," said Yang Daoling. Monitoring and analysis of bidding data by the National Information Center show that the amount of winning bids for national projects increased by 21.5% year-on-year in May, an increase of 9.2 percentage points from the previous month. The fields of medical and health, municipal facilities, energy and chemical industry, and transportation engineering have shown faster growth rates, indicating that various projects are further accelerating their implementation and matching with fund allocation. From the production side, the heat of industrial production in May remained high, and enterprises showed strong vitality in developing towards the "new." The industrial park production heat index of the National Information Center shows that this index increased by 21.2% year-on-year in May, an increase of 0.3 percentage points from the previous month, maintaining high production vitality. Among them, the heat of traditional industries starting production has generally increased. The industrial production heat index constructed based on the starting rate of 31 industrial products increased by 1.0 percentage points year-on-year and by 1.4 percentage points month-on-month, with the starting heat index of major product categories such as textiles, chemicals, steel, and plastics increasing by 1.9, 1.5, 1.1, and 1.1 percentage points respectively. The data also shows that the innovation vitality of enterprises continues to burst forth. The entrepreneurial vitality index of start-up enterprises of the National Information Center shows that this index increased by 39.4% year-on-year in May, an increase of 14.3 percentage points from the previous month. The entrepreneurial vitality index of technology innovation enterprises increased by 28.9% year-on-year in May, an increase of 6.9 percentage points from the previous month. "This indicates that start-up enterprises and technology innovation enterprises are showing strong development momentum, and their innovation vitality continues to be unleashed," said Yang Daoling.

title_en: Is there an abnormal sign for your express delivery?
body_en:
The annual "618" shopping season is approaching, and major e-commerce platforms have started their mid-year promotions, igniting consumers' shopping enthusiasm. However, unscrupulous individuals have taken advantage of this opportunity to set up various traps, such as second-hand platform scams, "free gift" scams, fake SMS messages from "couriers," and e-commerce customer service "refund claims," among others. Many consumers have unfortunately fallen victim to these scams. We remind consumers to remain vigilant while enjoying the shopping frenzy, recognize various scam tactics, and safeguard their "wallets."

Second-hand platform scam: Scanning to pay = losing money and goods
Xiao Zhang met a seller on a second-hand trading platform when purchasing a phone. The seller claimed that the platform fees were high and asked Xiao Zhang to add their WeChat. Subsequently, the seller sent a QR code for Alipay to Xiao Zhang, requesting a payment of 1980 yuan. Xiao Zhang complied. Several days later, when Xiao Zhang did not receive any shipping information, he contacted the seller again. The seller falsely claimed that due to company reasons, they could not ship the item and would provide a full refund to Xiao Zhang. However, there was a limit on the refund, and Xiao Zhang needed to add 2000 yuan to complete the refund process. Xiao Zhang, although suspicious, added the 20 yuan. Unexpectedly, the seller requested Xiao Zhang to pay an additional 100 yuan, promising a refund of 2500 yuan, with 400 yuan as compensation. At this point, Xiao Zhang realized something was wrong and immediately reported it to the police.

Police remind that when purchasing goods online, please conduct transactions through official e-commerce platforms to avoid using unverified third-party websites or applications, and avoid private transactions outside the platform under various pretexts.

"Free gift" scam: Scanning to receive gifts turns out to be a brushing scam
Recently, Ms. Wang received a parcel from an unknown courier, which contained a business activity card. Out of curiosity, Wang scanned the QR code on the card and added an account named "Activity Officer." Wang clicked on the link sent by the person, downloaded an app, and was told that registering as a member on the app would entitle her to a box of milk. Ten minutes later, a delivery person knocked on the door and delivered a box of milk to Wang. Believing it to be true, Wang informed the "Activity Officer" that she had received the milk. Subsequently, the person added Wang to a group chat, where the administrator announced a lottery activity. Wang participated and won a refrigerator and a rice cooker, with the administrator promising delivery in three days.

Later, the administrator posted rebate tasks in the group. Wang paid 4999 yuan by scanning a QR code but did not receive the rebate. When Wang contacted the administrator, they claimed that another order needed to be made to receive the rebate, with the task amounting to 30,000 yuan. Following the instructions, Wang placed cash in a cardboard box and left it by the right rear wheel of a van at a designated location. Shortly after, Wang received a warning call from the anti-fraud center, realizing she had fallen for a scam.

Police advise that online brushing is illegal, and any part-time brushing that requires upfront payment for tasks such as "doing tasks," "reviews," or "voting" is a scam. Any request to send cash, gold, or purchase large amounts of supermarket gift cards to strangers is a scam!

"Courier" fatal text message: Screen sharing = sharing wallet
Not long ago, Ms. Chen received a text message from someone claiming to be a courier. Chen contacted the person through the phone number provided in the message, and they informed her that they had activated a Douyin membership. If not deactivated, it would deduct 800 yuan monthly. Chen asked for help to deactivate the membership and was instructed to download a video conferencing software for screen sharing. The person remotely operated Chen's phone under the guise of helping her disable the bank card's no-password payment function. Subsequently, Chen's phone frequently blacked out and became unusable. After being alerted by family members, she realized she had been scammed, losing 5000 yuan.

Police remind that when receiving an unknown courier pick-up notification, do not easily believe the content of the notification. Verify the information first. When receiving calls or messages claiming that failure to close services like "live membership," "e-commerce membership," or "million-dollar guarantee" will result in "deductions" or "automatic renewals," be cautious and do not easily believe. Any request from a stranger to enable screen sharing on your phone could be a scam!

E-commerce customer service "refund claims": Claims are fake, theft is real
Recently, Ms. Zhao received a call from someone claiming to be a customer service representative from a courier company, stating that her package was lost, and the company would provide triple compensation. The "claims officer" said that the "WeChat million insurance" compensation needed to be transferred to Zhao's bank account and guided her to click on a website link to apply. After following the instructions, Zhao opened a page with the words "Tencent Micro Insurance" and was asked to download a conference software called "Office Assistant." Following the instructions, Zhao entered her name, ID number, phone number, and other information. Subsequently, the person claimed that to close the insurance and avoid a 20,000 yuan deduction, Zhao needed to provide a phone SMS verification code. Zhao ultimately lost 14,000 yuan.

Police recently exposed the tactics of these scams. Firstly, scammers capitalize on the recent "618" hot topic, using real orders to lower the victim's guard. They obtain online shopping information through illegal channels and use phrases like "abnormal delivery receipt" and "damaged compensation" to target the recipient's attention. During this process, scammers send out "phishing" messages or directly make phone calls to complete the "drainage." After successful "drainage," scammers use short videos, adding WeChat, grabbing red envelopes, etc., to publish false part-time job information such as likes and brushing orders. Once the victim contacts them, scammers induce them to download brushing apps or log in to brushing websites, contact customer service, and distribute tasks. After gaining the victim's trust through small profits, they persuade them to undertake larger tasks with higher commissions. Once the victim invests a large sum of money, scammers induce them to provide crucial information for the scam.

Police advise that when receiving calls or messages claiming that a package is lost, damaged, or there are quality issues, please verify the authenticity through official channels of the courier company or e-commerce platform. Do not click on links or scan QR codes sent by strangers, and do not share your screen to protect your personal privacy information. (Source: Beijing Daily Client, etc.)

title_en: "Fingertip gold mining" achieves a hundred billion industry.
body_en:
Convenient to wear, affordable, versatile in style, and fashionable, as a reusable nail accessory, handcrafted nail art has quickly become popular, growing in just a few years into a new industry with an annual output value exceeding 10 billion yuan. Behind this success is a small town in northern Jiangsu Province - Donghai County in Lianyungang City, which has entered the public eye, with 70% of handcrafted nail art products in China coming from here. With a wearable nail industry chain with an annual output value of over 8 billion yuan, products are sold to more than 30 countries and regions. How does the small Donghai County allow global consumers to share in the feast on their fingertips? Recently, reporters visited the area to find out.

With the updating and upgrading of mass consumption concepts, handcrafted nail art has become a new choice for nail art, winning the favor of consumers at home and abroad. Behind the rise of the handcrafted nail art industry, a set of data is attention-grabbing: by 2024, the total output of handcrafted nail art in Donghai exceeded 150 million pairs, with an annual output value of over 8 billion yuan, and through cross-border e-commerce, approximately 80 million pairs of original handcrafted nail art products are sold globally.

Why did handcrafted nail art flourish and "explode" in Donghai? After the rapid expansion of the industry, how will Donghai shine the spotlight on handcrafted nail art and further promote the standardized development of the industry?

Entering Donghai County's Yigao Road is like stepping into a nail art world. Nearly 50 handcrafted nail art shops line this road of less than 800 meters, with accessories in various colors on the nail pieces, from gradients, nude colors to cat eyes, and French styles, dazzling the eyes; live streaming hosts shuttle back and forth, and customers flock to make purchases.

Li Zhifu, the head of Donghai Yihemei Makeup Co., Ltd., was the first person on Yigao Road to "eat the crab." Since opening the first store in 2020, Li Zhifu's stores have rapidly expanded to 18, with 85 production points set up in 19 townships and streets in Donghai, employing over 2,000 workers.

"The rise of the handcrafted nail art industry in Donghai is closely related to the crystal industry." Li Zhifu, who comes from a background in crystal production and sales, told reporters, "A few years ago, crystal salesmen in Donghai found that orders for crystal offcuts from Yiwu suddenly surged. After investigation, it was discovered that these broken crystals were mainly embedded in a type of accessory called 'handcrafted nail art'." Yiwu's handcrafted nail art is mass-produced on production lines, with low costs, but because of the embedded crystals, the selling price is several times higher. Some crystal salesmen in Donghai thus paid attention to this industry.

Li Xuan, the chairman of Donghai Daxuan E-commerce Co., Ltd., was also one of the earliest entrepreneurs to enter the handcrafted nail art industry in Donghai. "In 2019, when crystal products in the form of nail art first appeared in the Donghai market, Donghai people with keen market senses discovered the business opportunities." Li Xuan said, "Instead of working for Yiwu merchants, it's better to roll up our sleeves and do it ourselves, carving out a new territory in a new field."

"Compared to Yiwu's machine-produced nail art, Donghai had to take a different path to have a higher chance of success." Li Xuan said that at the beginning of the venture, he led his team to conduct research in Shanghai, Guangzhou, Zhejiang, and other places, ultimately focusing on the field of handcrafted nail art that could personalize patterns and add delicate decorations.

One leads, and thousands follow. In this way, handcrafted nail art developed in small family workshops in Donghai. In early 2023, a statistical report from the Alibaba platform showed that 70% of handcrafted nail art products were shipped from Donghai. By this time, the handcrafted nail art industry was blooming in Donghai.

To understand the industry better, at the end of 2023, the Donghai County Committee and County Government conducted a deep investigation into the handcrafted nail art industry. "From the initial production and supply of nail art decorations, the Donghai handcrafted nail art industry has developed into a full industry chain covering 'raw material production - product design - production - sales,' with about 300 companies and businesses, nearly 50,000 employees. Handcrafted nail art is becoming the second business card of Donghai after crystals." Li Zheng, the secretary-general of the Donghai County Handcrafted Nail Art Industry Association, said that the scale of the handcrafted nail art industry in Donghai is still in a period of rapid expansion, and long-term development is still in a period of overlapping opportunities.

Going global

In 2019, the handcrafted nail art industry in Donghai County started, and by 2024, its annual output had exceeded 150 million pairs. What factors have driven this industry to rise rapidly in the small county of Donghai?

"Donghai people are hardworking and innovative, and the crystal business is booming, with developed logistics, and live streamers everywhere, they have a sensitivity to new trends in online platforms, so they were the first to discover the potential of handcrafted nail art." In Li Zheng's view, the fundamental core is that Donghai people dare to think and dare to strive, with e-commerce advantages being the key support, and government services being an important guarantee.

On a busy weekday morning, Wang Ting is busiest. After dropping her child off at school, she rushes to work at the Donghai Yihemei Makeup Co., Ltd. production base. "We are paid by piecework here, although the work is flexible, we still have to make the most of our time to earn more." Wang Ting said while polishing the nail pieces in her hands. Making a pair of regular handcrafted nail art takes about 15 minutes, and she works about 8 hours a day, earning over 6,000 yuan a month.

Entering the Yihemei Makeup production workshop, over 40 nail artists sit at long tables working on nail art pieces, with nail pieces, nail glue, decorations, and UV lamps placed on the side. From polishing the nail pieces to completing the nail art with nail polish, curing, painting patterns, adding rhinestones, filling gaps, baking for reinforcement, and sealing, the entire process is seamless.

Li Zhifu explained that the company has nearly a hundred production bases in Donghai County, employing over 2,000 "treasure moms" for local employment, with a maximum daily output of over 50,000 pairs of handcrafted nail art.

"Sisters, the nail art I have on my nails is handcrafted nail art, made entirely by hand, if you need it, you can click on the shopping cart to place an order..." At 9 a.m. outside the Yihemei Makeup store on Yigao Road, "90s" e-commerce anchor Xu Jing from Linyi, Shandong, had already been live streaming for an hour. "Many consumers watch live streams on their way to work, so I moved the live stream to the store in the morning, and sales have increased significantly." With the advantage of direct supply from the production site of Donghai handcrafted nail art, Xu Jing came here to do live streaming at the end of last year and now has a stable customer base and good income. In Xu Jing's view, handcrafted nail art breaks the tedious process of traditional nail art and is a more affordable, convenient, and trendy alternative product, gradually gaining popularity with the rise of the "she economy," showing great potential for further development.

"In Donghai, there are over 50,000 e-commerce professionals, and the developed e-commerce platform resources and a large team of live streamers are the foundation for the rapid rise of the handcrafted nail art industry." Li Zheng said.

Opening the Xiaohongshu online platform, searching for handcrafted nail art, the topic has reached 4.9 billion reads, with over 3.08 million notes. Many netizens commented that handcrafted nail art has become one of the easiest fashion items to attract female consumers.

Shining

The wave of handcrafted nail art rising in Donghai has attracted more and more businesses and enterprises to participate. Due to the low entry barriers, after experiencing the "rapid growth" stage of winning with low prices, the handcrafted nail art industry will also face the transformation from a blue ocean market to a red ocean market. In response, some practitioners in Donghai have begun to explore the path of high-end, branding, and customization development.

Jiangsu Tuduo Nail Art Co., Ltd., founded just over a year ago, has quickly grown into a leading force in the high-end handcrafted nail art industry in Donghai. "We incorporate Eastern aesthetics into handcrafted nail art design, using techniques such as cloisonné and relief, through cross-border cooperation and other business models, to bring more creativity to life and build a brand." Han Qiuchen, the company's chairman, said the company is using nail art as a carrier to promote traditional Chinese culture to the world.

Entering the production workshop of Tuduo Nail Art Company, young designer He Liyao is busy drawing nail art. "Traditional culture can also be very fashionable, our task is to cleverly design and carefully draw, to bring cultural relics and cultural imagery to consumers' hands, adding a unique charm and appeal to handcrafted nail art." He Liyao said.

The national style handcrafted nail art pieces designed by He Liyao are based on a single-color pink base, using magic mirror powder and matte sealing layers to create a silk fabric texture, while adding rhinestones and carved flower combinations to the satin embossed pattern, fully displaying the artistic conception of Eastern aesthetics.

Entering Hall 3 of Donghai Crystal City, over 30 handcrafted nail art brand stores are lined up, with the flagship store of the "Tuduo" brand established by Jiangsu Tuduo Nail Art Co., Ltd., exuding an artistic atmosphere. "These nail art pieces are from the blue and white porcelain series, using three-dimensional relief craftsmanship." The company's general manager Fan Kaiqi enthusiastically introduced over 180 meticulously crafted handcrafted "limited edition" nail art pieces, "even though each piece is priced at over 300 yuan, they are still popular with consumers, with production orders already scheduled until the end of July."

Li Xuan leads the team to deeply integrate intangible cultural heritage skills with modern aesthetics, opening up a new cultural path on a nail piece less than 1 millimeter thick. By 2024, the company's cross-border e-commerce sales accounted for over 40%, with products being exported overseas. "We are studying how to tell Chinese stories and spread Chinese culture on this small piece of nail art." Li Xuan said the company insists on driving technology research and development and cross-border cooperation, continuously researching new materials and techniques, fusing modern nail art with traditional skills, making the product a walking cultural business card.

In Donghai County, as the handcrafted nail art market gradually matures, driving the industry towards standardized and branded development is imperative. "We will focus on improving the policy system, creating aggregation platforms, and cultivating large-scale enterprises, promoting the integration of industry brands, standards, and management, integrating tourism, crystal, and e-commerce, further enhancing the development level of the handcrafted nail art industry." Zhao Hua, director of the Donghai County Bureau of Commerce, said.

Going global

At 4:30 a.m., on the north side of Binhe South Road in Donghai County, Jiangsu Jingyi Supply Chain Co., Ltd.'s three-story live streaming base is still brightly lit. 15 cross-border e-commerce live streaming rooms are full, with anchors introducing various Donghai handcrafted nail art styles in fluent foreign languages from midnight to early morning. Workers are busy sorting, packaging, and the piled-up parcels are waiting to be shipped worldwide. This is a cross-border e-commerce company established in 2022, with cross-border nail art business launched less than a year ago, and the sales of custom handcrafted nail art are close to nearly $10,000 per day.

"We specifically researched that the overseas market has a huge demand for personalized nail art products and a strong interest in Chinese traditional culture, providing new ideas for the development of the nail art business." Chen Zhi, the chairman of the company, said that when the company started developing handcrafted nail art business, it promoted Donghai handcrafted nail art in the overseas market by integrating culture, meticulous design, and customization.

In front of the dazzling display of handcrafted nail art at the Jingyi company, "95s" anchor Zhang Leilei shuttles back and forth with her phone, vividly explaining the cultural significance behind each piece to overseas fans. On the live stream screen, classical, modern, and a fusion of Chinese and Western nail art pieces shine brightly. "Nail artists and inheritors of intangible cultural heritage condense traditional techniques such as cloisonné, paper cutting, relief, and inlaying into the space of a nail, wearing a pair of handcrafted nail art is like engraving China's long history and culture on your fingertips." Zhang Leilei said that overseas consumers prefer exquisitely designed nail art pieces rich in cultural connotations, and live streamers need to use the live stream room as a bridge to convey the essence of Chinese excellent traditional culture to the world.

Suzhou embroidery nail art pieces reproduce the ink painting of Jiangnan, Dunhuang elements of flying apsaras recreate the charm of mural paintings, and the condensed Sanxingdui bronze patterns evoke mysterious thoughts... Handcrafted nail art becoming popular overseas started with aesthetics, rooted in culture. "Handcrafted nail art using 'Along the River During the Qingming Festival' as the creative element sells for $2,000, and a set of nail art pieces inspired by 'The Riverside Scene at Qingming Festival' is priced at over $3,000, and they are still selling well." Li Zheng said that intangible cultural heritage allows Chinese elements to bloom in a small space, becoming a new carrier for cultural globalization. High-end handcrafted nail art has long surpassed mere decorative functions, becoming wearable symbols of Chinese culture.

To help small and medium-sized enterprises in Donghai County's cross-border e-commerce "go global," Donghai County has opened a dedicated line for direct international communication exports, established two provincial-level cross-border e-commerce industrial parks, one provincial-level public overseas warehouse, and supported cross-border e-commerce operators through third-party platforms. "Donghai has also established a cross-border e-commerce trading center, focusing on solving 10 key issues for cross-border e-commerce operators, such as product supply chain, cross-border logistics, and export customs clearance, to establish a complete trade channel for handcrafted nail art going global." Li Zheng said.

Setting sail again

Leveraging its deep roots in the crystal industry, Donghai County has seized the opportunity of handcrafted nail art, with this year's total sales expected to exceed 15 billion yuan, developing into a global manufacturing center for handcrafted nail art, becoming the second industry flagship after crystals. "The thriving scene in the industry is inspiring, however, the handcrafted nail art industry has low entry barriers, and for the industry to achieve sustainable development, it must address its shortcomings." Zhao Hua said that the handcrafted nail art industry in Donghai is facing challenges such as low premium pricing, scattered industry layout, and insufficient brand influence.

"In 2023, the county committee and county government conducted a comprehensive investigation into the handcrafted nail art industry in Donghai, laying out a forward-looking plan for the high-quality development of the industry." Zhao Hua said that in response to the current situation of industry enterprises being small and scattered, Donghai, together with over a hundred companies, jointly established the Handcrafted Nail Art Industry Association and issued the country's first "Group Standard for Handcrafted Nail Art"; released the "Three-Year Development Plan Action Plan for the Handcrafted Nail Art Industry in Donghai County (2024-2026)," guiding the industry towards standardized and orderly development.

Entering the Donghai High-tech Zone, a modern standard factory area covering 60,000 square meters comes into view. This is a beauty industry base opened by Donghai County specifically for the handcrafted nail art industry. Jiangsu Jiaolong New Materials Co., Ltd. is located here, specializing in producing basic nail pieces, an important link in completing the handcrafted nail art industry chain.

Entering the workshop, over 10 injection molding machines and spray machines developed independently by the company are busy running, with mechanical arms accurately taking acrylic nail plates out of the injection molding machine and sending them to the assembly platform. The lightweight white nail base, like snowflakes, floats into the storage box. "The company started from a small workshop of a dozen people, and with the guidance and support of industrial policies, gradually developed into a large-scale enterprise with a daily output of up to 90,000 pairs and an annual output value exceeding tens of millions of yuan." Zhu Jin, the company's deputy general manager, told reporters, "In the past, the base nails were mainly purchased from outside, with high prices. With government support, we have reduced the cost of base nails by 50% by developing our own spray equipment. While reducing costs and increasing efficiency, we also actively share the latest research and development equipment with local peers, driving over ten similar companies to grow together, forming a nail base production chain in Donghai."

Visiting the Donghai High-tech Industrial Development Zone, some companies are climbing up the industry chain, while others are accelerating the extension and supplementation of the chain, forming a complete industry chain covering nail polish, nail pieces, design, and sales, creating an industrial agglomeration effect here. Donghai County has set a development target for 2025: attracting over 20 supporting production companies for accessories, consumables, packaging, nurturing over 4 large-scale industrial enterprises, over 30 wholesale and retail enterprises, and creating a global hub for the nail art industry.

"To more effectively lead and promote the high-quality development of the nail art industry, Donghai closely focuses on the talent needs of the industry chain, carefully implements key talent attraction and training plans, further strengthens cooperation and exchanges with universities and secondary vocational schools, aiming to cultivate a group of professionals with professional skills to fully meet the talent needs of the industry chain." Zhao Hua said.

According to the planning of the Donghai County Handcrafted Nail Art Industry Association, it is expected that by 2026, the annual output of handcrafted nail art in Donghai County will exceed 500 million pairs, with sales reaching 30 billion yuan.

title_en: Seize the opportunity/Ant Group plans to apply for stablecoin concept stocks are sought after
body_en:
Image: Ant Group has initiated the application for a Hong Kong stablecoin license and has already had multiple rounds of communication with regulators. 
With the passage of the Stablecoin Bill by the Hong Kong Legislative Council, the United States Senate is about to vote on stablecoin-related bills, causing stablecoins to once again be highly sought after in the market. Ant Group International has also joined the stablecoin battle. Ant Group International stated that they plan to submit their license application as soon as the relevant channels open after the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region's Stablecoin Bill takes effect on August 1. The current global stablecoin market size exceeds $230 billion, with experts estimating it will reach tens of trillions of dollars in the coming years. Stimulated by the news, Yunfeng Financial (00376) saw its stock price soar by 54%, while Bright Smart Securities (01428) rose by 11%. - Ta Kung Pao reporter Liu Kuanghao
Stablecoins are seen as the next generation of cross-border payment technology, offering both speed and convenience compared to traditional cross-border payments, as well as a highly competitive fee rate. Coupled with its decentralized characteristics, the market for stablecoins has expanded rapidly in recent years. Currently, there are approximately 232 stablecoins globally, and according to CoinMarketCap data, the total market value of stablecoins worldwide exceeds $230 billion (approximately HK$1.8 trillion), with USDT (Tether) and USDC accounting for a total market value of $214 billion, representing about 90%. As a mainstream stablecoin, USDT had a market value of approximately $153.1 billion as of the end of May this year, a 36-fold increase from the end of 2019.
The global scale of stablecoins is expected to reach tens of trillions of dollars. 
Regarding the future prospects of stablecoins, US Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen stated that stablecoins pegged to the US dollar could reach $20 trillion or more, while Ripple CEO Brad Garlinghouse believes that the overall stablecoin market size will increase to tens of trillions of dollars in the coming years.
While stablecoins are rapidly gaining popularity, Hong Kong has also been quick to catch up. The Hong Kong Monetary Authority launched a stablecoin issuer sandbox arrangement in March 2024, providing issuers interested in issuing stablecoins in Hong Kong with the opportunity to pilot the issuance of stablecoins. Currently, sandbox participants include JD Coin Chain Technology (Hong Kong), Circle Coin Innovation Technology, and institutions led by Standard Chartered Bank (Hong Kong). In addition, the Hong Kong Legislative Council recently passed stablecoin legislation in May and it officially took effect on August 1.
Although only a few institutions can participate in the sandbox pilot, many onlookers are eagerly waiting for the opportunity to join the stablecoin issuer series. According to foreign reports yesterday, Ant Group International intends to apply for a stablecoin license immediately after the stablecoin takes effect in Hong Kong.
In response, Ant Group International stated that they are accelerating investments in global financial asset management, expanding cooperation, and applying AI, blockchain, and stablecoin innovations on a large scale. The company will submit their license application as soon as the Stablecoin Bill takes effect on August 1 and the relevant channels open.
Media quoted Ant Group's Vice President and Ant Group's Blockchain Business Head Bian Zhuoqun as revealing that Ant Group has initiated the application for a Hong Kong stablecoin license and has already had multiple rounds of communication with regulators. It is reported that the Hong Kong Monetary Authority launched the Ensemble project sandbox last year and announced four main use cases for tokenization technology, with Ant Group's subsidiary assisting in building the sandbox's "tokenized asset platform."
Yunfeng Financial stock price surged by up to 98%
The Special Administrative Region government's Stablecoin Bill stipulates that any stablecoin claiming to be anchored to the Hong Kong dollar, regardless of the issuing entity's location, must apply for a license from the Hong Kong Monetary Authority and meet requirements such as reserve asset segregation, redemption guarantees, and anti-money laundering compliance. Licensed institutions must ensure that stablecoins are backed 1:1 by reserve assets, and are prohibited from paying interest to users to prevent stablecoins from evolving into quasi-deposit products. In addition, the legislation sets a minimum paid-up capital threshold of HK$25 million and explicitly prohibits unlicensed institutions from selling stablecoins to retail investors.
Hong Kong stocks were stimulated by the news yesterday, with some stablecoin concept stocks skyrocketing against the market trend. Among them, Yunfeng Financial's stock price surged by up to 98%, closing at 54.2% higher at HK$2.73. Bright Smart Securities, which was recently announced to be invested in by Ant Group, saw its stock price rise by 11.8% to HK$8.3. As for Grand Holdings (00165), which holds shares in stablecoins Circle (US: CRCL), its stock price rose by 3.4% to HK$5.68. Even Digit (02598) saw its stock price rise by 5.5% to HK$9.47.
sentiment_reason: Ant Group has launched its Hong Kong stablecoin license application, and the news has caused the share prices of related companies to surge.

title_en: Ant International plans to apply for a stablecoin license in Hong Kong for cross-border payments and financial management services. The estimated annual transaction volume is $150 billion.
body_en:
According to foreign media reports, Ant International will submit a stablecoin issuance license application to the Hong Kong Monetary Authority as soon as the "Stablecoin Regulations" take effect on August 1. The license will be used for cross-border payments and global financial asset management business, becoming the first company to express intention to apply after the regulations take effect. It is expected that the annual scale of relevant stablecoin transactions could exceed $150 billion. At the same time, the company plans to apply for stablecoin-related licenses in Luxembourg and Singapore. Ant International responded to inquiries from Hong Kong Wen Wei Po, stating that they welcome the Hong Kong Legislative Council's passage of the "Stablecoin Regulations Bill" and will submit the application as soon as the regulations take effect on August 1, hoping to contribute more to Hong Kong's future as an international financial center. ● Hong Kong Wen Wei Po reporter Li Zitian

Ant International stated that it is accelerating investments in global financial asset management, expanding partnerships, and applying its AI, blockchain, and stablecoin innovations to real and reliable large-scale applications. According to data, Ant International's total annual fund processing volume exceeded $1 trillion in 2024. Ant previously stated that by 2024, over one-third of the fund processing volume will be handled through the Whale platform using blockchain technology. Based on this calculation, by 2024, Ant International globally manages over $300 billion in funds using blockchain technology. If half of this can be implemented in stablecoin applications, the scale of stablecoin transactions in its existing business could exceed $150 billion.

"Stablecoin Regulations" officially take effect in August
The Hong Kong Legislative Council officially passed the "Stablecoin Regulations Bill" last month, marking a milestone in Hong Kong's global virtual asset regulatory practice. Since the bill was published and read for the first time in December 2024, Hong Kong regulatory authorities have efficiently and steadily progressed the legislative process, and after the passage of the "Stablecoin Regulations," laid the legal foundation for establishing a leading stablecoin regulatory framework globally.

Partnering with Deutsche Bank to pave the way for applications
Subsequently, on May 30, 2025, the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region Government officially published the "Stablecoin Regulations" in the Gazette. Hong Kong has officially established a licensing system for fiat-backed stablecoin issuers, becoming the first jurisdiction in Asia to establish a comprehensive regulatory system for "fiat-pegged stablecoins." With the implementation of the regulations, Hong Kong's development in the digital finance field will enter a new stage, opening up new compliance channels for mainland users and institutions to participate in stablecoin-related businesses in Hong Kong. Ant International is the first financial technology company with global large-scale fund management experience to express its intention to apply.

Ant International has also been paving the way for stablecoin applications. The company recently signed a memorandum of understanding (MOU) with Deutsche Bank in Munich, Germany, to establish a strategic partnership. Deutsche Bank will collaborate with Ant International's Scene Finance Department to launch a series of innovative solutions in global financial asset management and cross-border payments, including tokenized deposits, stablecoins, and AI-based Time Sequence Transformer (TST) forex models, to help Ant International and its clients reduce forex-related costs and risks.

At the time, Ant International mentioned that the two parties will further study the application of stablecoins in global payments, including providing real-time cross-border financial asset management, reserve management, and fund transfer services for Ant International's physical entities. Ant International also pointed out that Deutsche Bank will collaborate with top global banks and institutions to integrate its secure distributed ledger technology (DLT) with Ant's real-time financial asset management platform "Whale" to achieve real-time fund allocation within Ant International's entities, thereby enhancing the efficiency and transparency of global financial asset management.

According to data, Ant Group started with Alipay and has made internationalization a core development strategy in recent years. Ant International focuses on serving enterprises and institutions in cross-border financial business and building a cross-border payment cooperation network. In 2024, Ant Group reorganized, and Ant International independently developed a new business structure. Its main businesses include cross-border wallet payments and digital solutions (Alipay+), cross-border corporate account services (WorldFirst), global merchant payment services (Antom), and Scene Finance services (EmFi). Ant International has always considered Hong Kong a key focus in its global layout. In 2024, the Chairman of Ant Group, who now also serves as the Chairman of Ant International, Jack Ma, stated during Hong Kong Fintech Week that Hong Kong is an outstanding digital technology center and a leading financial center, hoping that Ant can contribute to establishing Hong Kong as a global leader in tokenization and Web3 fintech.
sentiment_reason: Ant Group will immediately submit an application for a stablecoin issuance license after the Stablecoin Ordinance comes into effect, becoming the first company to express its intention to apply after the regulations take effect.

title_en: Mutual benefit and win-win.
body_en:
"The tickets to Africa are really in high demand, as it is full of opportunities!" Ma Bijun, deputy general manager of Hunan Erkang Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd., has been busy preparing to open a pharmaceutical factory in Tanzania later this year. He often shuttles between China and Africa, marveling at the large number of passengers on flights. In his view, the high demand for flight tickets is a true reflection of the increasing heat of economic and trade exchanges between China and Africa.
According to statistics, since the Guangzhou-Changsha-Nairobi route of China Southern Airlines opened in 2019, it has carried a total of 227,000 passengers and currently maintains stable operation with three flights per week. To meet the passenger demand during the peak tourist season, China Southern Airlines plans to increase direct flights from Nairobi to Guangzhou in the upcoming summer.
The momentum of bilateral economic and trade cooperation between China and Africa is strong, with the scope continuously expanding. In just three days, coffee beans from Kenya can take a direct flight to Changsha, bringing their unique flavor to the African coffee trading center in the Gaoqiao Market in Hunan. As an "old friend" in the agricultural sector, African coffee products are entering China at an accelerated pace. In the first quarter of this year, China's imports of African coffee increased by 70.4% year-on-year.
At the African coffee trading center in the Gaoqiao Market in Changsha, a coffee shop operated by Xiaoka Zhu Coffee Co., Ltd. carefully crafts more than 30 drinks from coffee beans from various African countries such as Ethiopia and Kenya.
"Nowadays, we communicate directly with African coffee plantation owners through online trading platforms, simplifying the transaction process and reducing overall costs," said Jing Jianhua, the person in charge of Xiaoka Zhu Coffee Co., Ltd. He mentioned that the coffee market has been very good in recent years, with the company's import of coffee beans from Africa increasing by 30% year-on-year last year.
Apart from the "old friends," there are also "new faces," with a touch of green transforming China-Africa economic and trade exchanges. As Africa continues to promote green transformation, by 2023, China's exports of new energy vehicles, lithium batteries, and photovoltaic products to Africa have increased significantly by 291%, 109%, and 57% respectively.
Last year, Sulehat from Senegal established a new energy ride-hailing company in Dakar. "Seeing new energy vehicles running all over the streets in China, I also hope to see a similar scene in my country," he said. He believes that introducing new energy vehicles can not only provide employment opportunities and reduce operating costs but also be more environmentally friendly.
Sulehat has been living and doing business in Yiwu for more than 20 years. Since purchasing hardware products in Yiwu for the first time, he has discovered the cost-effective "Made in China" and witnessed the increasingly frequent economic and trade exchanges between China and Africa.
Walking into the exhibition hall of the trading company for Africa established by Sulehat in Yiwu, African merchants come in a continuous stream, with hundreds of products displayed on the booths, including new energy products such as solar photovoltaic panels and solar street lights, as well as hardware, daily necessities, household appliances, etc. Initially sending out two to three containers to Africa in the first year, now it has exceeded 4,000, and Sulehat is full of confidence in the future development, saying, "This number will continue to grow."
The "new trend" of the Chinese e-commerce model has also reached the African continent. As a blue ocean of e-commerce economy, the African market has shown great vitality and potential. "Online live streaming has attracted many customers to us, and I can instantly understand their various needs," said Nancy Kariuki, a host on Kilimall, the leading e-commerce platform in East Africa. She told reporters that the natural flow of viewers during live streaming exceeds 10,000 people per day, which is quite considerable locally.
Kariuki showed the homepage of Kilimall to reporters, with a wide range of products from 3C digital products to shoes, hats, and clothing, making it overwhelming. "E-commerce has not only changed the way people used to shop but also brought job opportunities to the locals." It is understood that since entering Africa in 2014, the platform has registered over 10 million online users. While promoting the Chinese e-commerce model, the platform also strives to achieve localized operations, creating tens of thousands of job opportunities for Africa.
In addition, Chinese e-commerce companies such as Alibaba, Xinyun, and Pinduoduo have also entered the African market, building "digital bridges" connecting China and Africa.
With the continuous warming of China-Africa economic and trade cooperation, the trade cake is getting bigger. Data released by the General Administration of Customs of China in early June showed that in the first five months of this year, China's imports and exports to African countries reached 963.21 billion yuan, an increase of 12.4% year-on-year, reaching a historical high for the same period. Looking ahead, China-Africa economic and trade exchanges will continue to unleash new vitality, allowing people from both sides to share the dividends of development.
(Xinhua News Agency, Changsha/Nairobi, June 12, reporters Zhou Haojin, Wang Yue, Liu Fangzhou)

title_en: 2025 China Internet Civilization Conference | In the digital age, how can internet companies practice social responsibility?
body_en: On June 11th, the 2025 China Internet Civilization Conference Internet Enterprise Social Responsibility Sub-forum was held in Hefei, Anhui. The forum was divided into three chapters, with representatives from dozens of top companies such as Tencent, Weibo, Pinduoduo, and ByteDance gathering to discuss the practical paths of corporate social responsibility in the digital age. Niu Yibing, Deputy Director of the Cyberspace Administration of China and President of the China Internet Social Organizations Association, expressed in his speech that he looks forward to internet companies playing a leading role in the construction of a strong internet country, promoting technological innovation and industrial transformation, promoting the development of the digital economy, optimizing social public services, and further promoting the construction of corporate social responsibility for internet companies. Internet companies, as the dual driving force of the digital economy and internet civilization construction, are releasing innovative vitality through technological empowerment, strengthening the industry foundation through responsibility, and building a multi-dimensional support for the construction of a strong internet country. Dong Yuhui served as the speaker for the first chapter "Promoting Positive Energy on the Internet," combining his own experience of transitioning from a teacher to a host to share the practices of the "Walking with Hui" team in promoting intangible cultural heritage and helping farmers through live broadcasts. Zhu Dianjun, Chief Editor and Vice President of Public Policy of Tencent, and Chen Lina, Vice President of Government Media Affairs and Chief Editor of Weibo, shared how internet companies fulfill their social responsibilities and promote social civilization construction in the internet age. Former women's national football goalkeeper Zhao Lina, as the speaker for the second chapter "Internet Integrity," shared the experience of the "Star Project" raising funds through the internet to build playgrounds for 110 rural schools, and stated that "internet integrity construction plays an increasingly important role in promoting the legalization of cyberspace and promoting the development of industry self-discipline norms." Ding Jian, Vice President of Alibaba Group and CEO of Xianyu, analyzed the trust logic behind the idle economy; Zhu Zheng, Chief Development Officer and Senior Vice President of Pinduoduo Group, proposed "Integrity is a survival issue," investing billions to support merchants in transformation and creating a "system + technology + co-governance" protection network; Wang Wei, Vice President of iFlytek and General Manager of Hearing Technology, demonstrated AI anti-fraud systems, AI voice public welfare programs, and other examples rooted in the company's values, using artificial intelligence to build a better world. Musician Hu Haiquan opened the third chapter "Internet Public Welfare Construction," calling for "servers to be set up in the fields" to activate rural endogenous power with technology. title_en: Annual sales exceeded 50 million yuan, driving thousands of farmers to share the development dividends of Zhenfeng glutinous food: the "new taste" of intangible cultural heritage food.
body_en:
Guizhou Daily Tianyan News Reporter Huang Feihong
News Highlights
In Zhenfeng County, Qiannan Prefecture, shining grains of glutinous rice are writing a wonderful chapter of transformation in traditional industries. As the "Hometown of Chinese Glutinous Food," Zhenfeng adheres to traditional craftsmanship, innovates consumer scenes, upgrades traditional glutinous food to a wealth-generating industry, and establishes a complete chain system of planting, processing, and sales. By 2024, the annual sales of glutinous food products in the county exceeded 50 million yuan, with profits exceeding 10 million yuan, providing employment for over 1,500 people.
From family workshops to large-scale production
The core competitiveness of Zhenfeng's glutinous food lies in the adherence to and innovation of traditional craftsmanship. As a high-quality glutinous rice producing area, Zhenfeng has a long history of glutinous rice cultivation. In 2015, the "Buyi Glutinous Food Making Technique" was listed in the fourth batch of representative projects of intangible cultural heritage in Guizhou Province. Buyi grey zongzi, Zhenfeng glutinous rice, five-color cakes, and glutinous rice cakes, among other traditional glutinous foods, embody the dietary culture and wisdom of the local ethnic minorities.
"Our Xiong family has been engaged in zongzi making since our ancestors, and I am already the fifth generation." In the memory of Tang Guangzhou, head of Guizhou Laoxiongji Food Co., Ltd., Buyi grey zongzi uses ash from plants and trees as an ingredient, which not only retains the fragrance but also dissolves the greasiness. The production process strictly follows the ancient method, and the formula of ash and alkali water used by ancestors to wrap zongzi maintains a unique flavor.
"Xiong Family Zongzi," a time-honored brand that started from a family workshop, has now achieved large-scale production. "This year, we made more than 100,000 zongzi for the Dragon Boat Festival. Buyi grey zongzi is not only popular offline, but also allows more people to taste the flavor of Zhenfeng through e-commerce platforms," said Tang Guangzhou.
Inside the glutinous food processing factory of Guizhou Nuoxifang Food Co., Ltd., the fragrance of glutinous rice is also overflowing. Zhenfeng glutinous rice emphasizes the fragrance of rice and the tenderness of meat, requiring strict control from rice selection to meat frying. Huang Nian, the company's head, explained, "We have been doing this craft for 20 years, insisting on using high-quality local glutinous rice. You can smell the fragrance of rice before it is steamed; we use top-quality fatty pork to refine lard, ensuring that the glutinous rice is fried to be oily, tender, and sweet."
This year, in addition to producing glutinous rice, the company also launched four types of grey zongzi, such as spare ribs and chestnuts, during the Dragon Boat Festival. "During the zongzi-making process, we strictly control the freshness of the ingredients and the cleanliness of the workshop," said Huang Nian. Before and after the Dragon Boat Festival, the order volume for Buyi grey zongzi exceeded 100,000, and the oil glutinous rice and five-color glutinous rice sold with it were also bestsellers, with 30 workers working overtime every day.
From local flavors to national fragrance
To further help Zhenfeng's glutinous food spread its fragrance from local flavors to national levels, Zhenfeng County has intensified efforts to promote the construction of the glutinous food brand. Through the development model of "association leadership + enterprise collaboration," the development of glutinous food enterprises has been achieved through collaboration. In April of this year, the Glutinous Food Industry Association was established, uniting 30 member units to unify raw material procurement, production processes, and packaging design to ensure consistent product flavors. In addition, modern technologies such as vacuum sealing and sterilization cooking have been introduced to allow grey zongzi to break through geographical restrictions and supply the national market throughout the year.
"Before and after the Dragon Boat Festival, national orders continued to come in. Through platforms such as Tmall and Douyin, we ship around 2,000 orders per day, with Zhenfeng grey zongzi and five-color glutinous rice being popular items," said Li Kanghui, manager of Zhenfeng County Nongmemme E-commerce Co., Ltd.
While online sales are booming, Zhenfeng's glutinous food sales stores have also expanded to Guiyang, Xingyi, and other places, and plans are in place to connect with channels outside the province through the East-West Cooperation Investment Promotion Conference. At the East-West Cooperation and Assistance to Consumption and Glutinous Food Industry Investment Promotion Conference on May 28, Zhenfeng signed strategic agreements with multiple companies and was awarded the titles of "Hometown of Guizhou Grey Zongzi" and "Hometown of Guizhou Glutinous Rice," with the brand's influence continuing to rise.
Wang Hong, president of the Zhenfeng County Glutinous Food Industry Association, stated that they will adhere to standards, focus on extending the chain and increasing efficiency, rely on brand empowerment, continuously develop product diversification, meet the needs of different consumer groups, enhance market competitiveness, promote digital transformation, guide each merchant to establish online sales channels, sell products through social media, let the fragrance of Zhenfeng's glutinous food spread far and wide, and allow more companies to benefit from it.
From single products to chain development
The vitality of Zhenfeng's glutinous food industry is extending vigorously from a single delicious product to a complete industrial chain. Represented by Buyi grey zongzi and Zhenfeng glutinous rice, the glutinous food products renowned inside and outside the province have also driven the development of raw material industries such as glutinous rice, pigs, chestnuts, and zongzi leaves.
Currently, the county's glutinous food production enterprises are driving local glutinous rice planting orders, allowing farmers to increase their income through raw material supply and workshop labor, with zongzi wrappers earning over 3,000 yuan per month.
At the same time, the "Glutinous Food + Cultural Tourism" model has activated cultural value. Immersive projects such as glutinous rice sightseeing and traditional food making experiences attract tourists to experience the dietary wisdom of the Buyi people firsthand. Downstream, the improvement of supporting facilities such as cold chain logistics and e-commerce sales effectively ensures the efficient coverage of products in the national market.
Wang Xianjiang, deputy director of the Industrial and Scientific Bureau of Zhenfeng County, introduced that there are currently more than 50 glutinous food production and processing enterprises in the county, with 12 enterprises holding production licenses (SC) and over 20 small workshop registrations; there are also more than 50 glutinous food sales stores and vendors, forming a complete industrial chain from raw material planting, processing production to market sales. In terms of product development, ten major characteristic product systems have been formed, including Buyi grey zongzi and glutinous rice cakes.
"We want Zhenfeng's glutinous food to not only be a taste of homesickness but also a Zhenfeng business card on the guest's table," Wang Hong said. The Zhenfeng glutinous food industry will aim for higher goals, apply for geographical indications, create public brands, and enhance premium space. At the same time, deepen product innovation, develop instant and small-packaged glutinous foods that meet modern consumption needs.
From traditional workshops to modern factories, from festival delicacies to daily cuisine, Zhenfeng interprets the feasible path of high-quality development of traditional industries with a grain of glutinous rice - adhering to tradition, innovating, breaking through chains, and allowing traditional craftsmanship to rejuvenate in the tide of the times.

title_en: Create the Suzhou model of offline no-reason returns.
body_en:
Figure 1: In Suzhou, signs for no reason return are all over key commercial streets.
Figure 2: The "Wu You" trademark registered by the Suzhou Consumer Protection Commission.
Xue Jingjing
When the seven-day no reason return policy for offline shopping changed from an optional question to a mandatory one in the field of consumption, as a pilot city for the three-year action of optimizing the consumer environment by the State Administration for Market Regulation, Suzhou City in Jiangsu Province has taken new measures to optimize the consumer environment based on the foundation of full-area offline shopping with no reason return. By implementing the "Eight Ones" method to optimize the consumer environment in key commercial streets throughout the city, building a full-chain guarantee system for no reason return in offline shopping, creating a digital matrix for the "Wu You" brand, Suzhou has created a model for offline no reason return, allowing consumers to shop offline with peace of mind, better promoting consumption, and driving consumption.
From institutional innovation to micro-governance extension
The road of no reason return for offline shopping in Suzhou began in April 2020. At that time, the seven-day no reason return for online shopping had become a common practice, while offline physical stores still faced difficulties in safeguarding their rights. Suzhou took the lead in breaking the deadlock by offering no reason return services for offline shopping, establishing the "Wu You Jin" government prepayment mechanism and no reason return platform, achieving offline shopping with online returns, local consumption with remote returns, government prepayment for returns, and consumer dispute resolution for returns. The system covers all returned goods, all return methods, and operates around the clock. By the end of May this year, the number of merchants in Suzhou's offline physical stores promising no reason returns had exceeded 120,000, with a total of over 206,000 no reason return cases accepted in the city, equivalent to approximately 90 million yuan.
As the Suzhou model of full-area offline shopping with no reason return has become a national paradigm, the Suzhou Market Supervision Bureau has once again broken new ground by pushing consumer environment governance measures towards institutional innovation. In April this year, the Suzhou Market Supervision Bureau and the Gusu District government jointly launched an action to enhance the consumer environment in key historical streets, introducing the "Eight Ones" method in four major tourist consumption streets including Ten Quan Street, Shantang Street, Pingjiang Road, and Guanqian Street. This method includes an administrative guidance document, an information bulletin board, a trustful consumption display sign, a commitment to honest operation, a "Wu You" consumer QR code, a comprehensive service station, a volunteer supervision team, and a flag for high-quality merchants.
Wu Xiang, the Secretary-General of the Suzhou Consumer Rights Protection Committee, introduced that since the implementation of the "Eight Ones" method for over a month, the coverage of merchants in the four streets promising no reason returns has continued to expand, with merchants signing up and fulfilling their promises to return, achieving a coverage rate of nearly 100% in key streets, and a consumer satisfaction rate of 100%. On May 29, the Suzhou Market Supervision Bureau held a city-wide promotion meeting for enhancing the consumer environment in key commercial streets, fully promoting the "Eight Ones" method, requiring all market supervision departments in the city to further improve their positions, target their efforts, and consolidate their efforts, comprehensively building a trustworthy, fair, convenient, and safe consumer environment, and vigorously promoting the "Trustworthy Suzhou, Wu You Consumer" brand.
From policy support to consumer ecosystem reconstruction
The optimization of the consumer environment is not a single department's or single policy's lone advance, but rather the construction of a new consumer ecosystem through systematic reform. The full-chain guarantee system for no reason return in offline shopping is a typical epitome of this. According to Wu Xiang, "Wu You Jin" is funded by the government, and consumers can submit applications through the Suzhou Smart 315 No Reason Return platform on the Suzhou APP, Alipay, or WeChat mini-program. After verification by the platform, "Wu You Jin" can prepay within 24 hours, with the merchants subsequently supplementing the prepayment funds. This mechanism not only allows consumers to return goods with one click operation but also fundamentally solves the problem of merchants delaying returns and consumers having difficulty getting refunds.
The "Eight Ones" method is another vivid practice of multi-party governance in the consumer environment, focusing on the goals of safety, quality assurance, fair pricing, reliable services, and rights protection. By sending compliance guidelines to key street merchants, publicly displaying trustful consumption commitments, setting up comprehensive service stations that bring together various forces such as business, culture and tourism, urban management, public security, streets, and merchants, and establishing volunteer supervision teams such as "Suxiaohu," "Woodpecker," and "Gusu Ten Quan," it promotes the resolution of consumer disputes at the source, normalizes the supervision of merchant operations, and creates a new pattern of co-construction and sharing of a high-quality consumer environment.
"No need to worry about awkward face-to-face negotiations with merchants, you can really return if you want to, it's so convenient for consumers." Ms. Wei, who completed a return at a cheongsam store on Ten Quan Street in Suzhou, exclaimed. In May this year, Ms. Wei spent 4,980 yuan to customize a cheongsam in the store, but upon receiving it, she found issues such as exposed thread ends, asymmetrical collar, and rough stitching. The return dilemma, which was originally due to the special nature of customized goods, was resolved the same day after she reported it to the comprehensive service station of the Ten Quan Street Market Supervision. In the end, after deducting some material and tailoring costs, the store refunded 4,480 yuan to Ms. Wei and promised to enhance quality control. With a sound system support, convenient process design, and efficient processing efficiency, consumer worries have been effectively eliminated, making "daring to consume" a distinct symbol of offline shopping in Suzhou.
From experimental field to harvest land
In the commercial streets of Suzhou, signs of no reason return commitments can be seen everywhere, bringing convenience to consumers and benefits to honest operators.
Since 2024, Suzhou has created a digital matrix for the "Wu You" brand, covering scenarios such as payment, tourism, insurance, and credit. By applying digital RMB to the field of offline shopping with no reason return, the "Wu You Shu Gou" was launched; the "Wu You Shu Lu" safe consumption experience activities were carried out, jointly with the Suzhou Municipal Bureau of Culture, Radio, Television, and Tourism, the Municipal Bureau of Commerce, and other departments, launching 10 boutique consumption experience routes; the "Wu You Shu Xian" service was first introduced in the province, starting a new model of insurance coverage, with insurance institutions guaranteeing the costs incurred by participating merchants due to no reason returns, reducing the cost of no reason returns for companies; the "Wu You Shu Dai" project was first launched nationwide, providing exclusive digital RMB loans to honest enterprises promising no reason returns for offline shopping. "Only offline shopping no reason return commitment merchants who have opened a digital RMB account, have no violations or disputes for two years, and have a dispute resolution rate of 100% can apply," said Wu Xiang. The "Wu You Shu Dai" transforms the credit stock accumulated by merchants through compliant operations into development increments, with the current credit amount reaching 26.7 billion yuan.
It is worth noting that Suzhou has always promoted the quality and expansion of offline shopping with no reason return through differentiated strategies and precise thinking: extending to the field of service quality, introducing no reason return for rail transit tickets and no reason cancellation for homestays and rural guesthouses; expanding to the field of product quality, 27 city-level quality award-winning companies nationwide have taken the lead in implementing integrated no reason return for manufacturers, covering nearly 30,000 offline stores, establishing the Manufacturer Integrated No Reason Return Enterprise Integrity Operation Alliance; breaking through in key industry areas, more than 2,300 merchants in 61 3A-level or above scenic spots have introduced a 30-day no reason return policy for cultural and tourism products, and a no reason return commitment for health products in response to social concerns; continuing to expand in regional cooperation, in 2021, Shanghai and Suzhou implemented cross-regional no reason return for offline shopping in different stores, in 2022, Suzhou's Wujiang District, Shanghai's Qingpu District, and Zhejiang's Jiashan County jointly advocated cross-regional no reason return for offline shopping in different stores, and during the "3.15" period this year, they jointly launched a cross-river integration action with Nantong, achieving cross-regional no reason return for offline shopping in different stores for 61 brands and 4,139 stores in cities such as Shanghai and Nantong.
The growth effectiveness brought about by the optimization of the consumer environment is most directly felt by merchants. Chen Cheng, the owner of Hey Luo Bakery on Ten Quan Street, revealed that since hanging the trustful consumption display sign in the store, monthly sales have increased from 700,000 yuan to 1.5 million yuan, more than doubling. Shen Jiecheng, the person in charge of A Cheng Restaurant, also stated that since the implementation of the "Eight Ones" method, there has been a significant increase in pedestrian flow and turnover in the street, with the restaurant's monthly turnover increasing from 360,000 yuan to 600,000 yuan. These operating data confirm the sustainability of the Suzhou model of no reason return for offline shopping - by reducing consumer risks through institutional innovation, transforming consumer safety into market growth, and forming a virtuous cycle of environment optimization, consumption growth, and merchant benefits.
From Pingjiang Road's Pingtan Teahouse to the high-end commercial district of Jinji Lake, from digital return platforms to cross-regional cooperation in the Yangtze River Delta, Suzhou City continues to leverage the lever of no reason return to continuously promote the optimization of the consumer environment. The relevant person in charge of the Suzhou Market Supervision Bureau stated that the optimization of the consumer environment is "an ongoing process without a period." The market supervision departments in Suzhou will use the "Eight Ones" method as a starting point to promote the leap from local demonstration to full-area improvement in the consumer environment, injecting long-term energy into the creation of a more attractive consumer ecosystem.
