title_en: Various well-known companies are actively recruiting talents in the field of AI.
body_en:
This year, AI talents are in high demand at major job fairs nationwide.

Employment is closely linked to economic conditions and the well-being of countless families.

Since the beginning of this year, with the rapid development of new technologies, industries, and formats, a group of enterprises in key areas such as advanced manufacturing, information technology, and service consumption have released new job demands and expanded new employment opportunities as they accelerate their advancement towards the new and intelligent.

Enterprises are focusing on AI talents as they advance towards the new and intelligent.

In Beijing's Haidian District, at Baidu Tower, 120 new employees, including social recruitment employees, campus recruitment employees, and interns, recently gathered for Baidu's new employee training.

"We have opened up more than 3,000 summer internship opportunities for students. We hope to recruit talents in fields such as machine learning, natural language processing, large model algorithms, as well as front-end and back-end development, and AI product managers," said Liu Shuai, Baidu's campus recruitment manager, adding that they plan to open 21,000 internship positions for graduates in the next three years.

Since the beginning of this year, there has been a strong demand for recruitment in fields such as artificial intelligence and quantum technology, with companies competing to attract talents in algorithms, machine learning, and other areas.

Not long ago, Tencent announced the launch of a new employment plan - to add 28,000 internship positions within three years, including 10,000 campus recruitment interns by 2025, with an increased focus on conversion to full-time employment.

"As of early March, Tencent has more than 55,000 full-time employees, with over 40,000 in technology-related roles. The company's various businesses have fully embraced AI, hence we continue to strengthen our forward-looking talent reserves in recruitment," said Luo Haibo, Tencent's global recruitment manager, adding that over 60% of the open campus recruitment positions this year are in technology-related fields such as artificial intelligence, big data, cloud computing, and game engines, with an unprecedented expansion in recruitment efforts.

Alibaba has also increased its recruitment and training of AI talents. It is understood that Alibaba started its spring 2026 internship recruitment in February, opening up over 3,000 internship positions. Among them, AI-related positions account for nearly half, with some business sectors having even higher proportions, such as Gaode at around 65% and Alibaba Cloud at over 80%.

Meituan plans to provide over 15,000 positions to campuses by 2025, including recruiting over 6,000 graduates, offering internship opportunities with the chance of conversion to full-time employment for 4,000 interns, and having over 5,000 daily interns. Meituan has set up a special AI large model zone in its training to better stimulate talent vitality and drive innovative development.

Platform empowerment of the real economy is releasing a multiplier effect on employment.

The booming digital economy has not only brought about the emergence of digital and intelligent positions but also seen some platform companies empowering the real economy, releasing a cumulative multiplier effect and creating a broader employment space.

While creating a lively atmosphere, a live atmosphere engineer is responsible for equipment debugging, backstage operations, maintaining live order, data review, etc. As a live atmosphere engineer, post-2000s Wen Miao has been exploring carefully for half a year, helping sell tens of thousands of agricultural products to distant places.

In addition to live atmosphere engineers, many new professions such as online anchors, live recruitment specialists, life service experience staff, and user growth operation specialists come from the platform's "live track." Over the next three years, Kuaishou plans to conduct professional skills training for 10 million people online and offline around new professions.

In the face of complex and changing external environments with many uncertainties, in the past two months, many e-commerce platforms have optimized services to help foreign trade companies expand into the domestic market and stabilize their workforce.

From on-site coordination of purchasing and sales teams to providing rapid store opening, omni-channel marketing support, and launching an export-to-domestic support plan, JD.com has entered substantive procurement negotiations with over 10,000 companies since launching the plan in April. JD.com stated that it plans to purchase no less than 200 billion yuan worth of export-to-domestic goods in the coming year.

Meituan has opened a green channel to fully support the online operations of foreign trade goods; Pinduoduo plans to invest 100 billion yuan in supporting the high-quality development of merchants over the next three years, while increasing subsidies for small and medium-sized merchants; Didi has added 2 billion yuan in special funds, with 1 billion yuan used to subsidize drivers in regions heavily affected by tariffs, and the other 1 billion yuan to subsidize passengers to increase their travel frequency. Platform companies are making various efforts, and the role of the employment "reservoir" is becoming increasingly evident.

The "new wind" of industries is opening up new employment space.

As the pace of economic transformation and upgrading accelerates, the move towards high-end "new manufacturing" is continuously opening up new employment paths, with industries such as consumer electronics, new energy, and integrated circuits showing vibrant employment opportunities.

"In 2025, Midea Group will continue to increase campus recruitment, providing over 2,000 employment positions, and has already absorbed a group of research and development talents in areas such as smart appliances and robotics, new energy, medical, power electronics, algorithms, and intelligent manufacturing," said a relevant person from Midea Group's human resources department.

Huawei will open over 10,000 recruitment positions by 2025, covering over 60 types of positions such as AI engineers, software development engineers, hardware technology engineers, and will also launch internship programs in areas such as development, testing, and exploration of cutting-edge technologies, planning to train over 5,000 future talents throughout the year.

A group of advanced manufacturing enterprises are stimulating new talent demands as they optimize and upgrade, and lay out for the future.

Since the beginning of this year, Fuyao Group has successively put into operation new bases and intelligent transformation projects in Hefei, Anhui, and Fuqing, Fujian, creating 6,750 new jobs. Among them, nearly 5,000 frontline positions have been created in automated intelligent factories, giving rise to new job types such as intelligent equipment operators and AI quality inspectors.

"With the commissioning of new projects such as the ultra-high voltage Jiquan line power source and the establishment of new companies, technical research and development and project development-related positions have become new directions for recent recruitment," said a person in charge of Wanneng Group, adding that the company plans to recruit nearly a thousand people by 2025, mainly in energy and power, electrical engineering, and other specialties.

Stable employment not only requires attention to the quantity of positions but also a focus on the quality of employment.

By improving the training system and salary guarantee system, Transfar Group promotes the dual growth of employees' technical skills and income. In recent years, the group's business volume has increased fivefold, with the number of employees remaining at around 16,000, and the compound annual growth rate of per capita income exceeding 11%.

"Employees and companies need to work together to create sustainable employment positions," said Xu Guanju, chairman of Transfar Group.

(Reported by Xinhua News Agency, Beijing, June 10)

title_en: Notice on holding the 2024 Academic Annual Conference of the Pharmaceutical Excipients Professional Committee of the Chinese Pharmaceutical Association (Second Round)
body_en: To all relevant units: Pharmaceutical excipients are an important foundation in China's pharmaceutical industry, and are one of the key factors determining the quality of generic drugs and the high-quality development of innovative formulations. The supply chain security of pharmaceutical excipients used in high-end formulations in China urgently needs to strengthen the technological innovation and industrial support for domestic pharmaceutical excipients. At the same time, ensuring the quality of clinical medication, reducing drug costs, and alleviating the pressure on medical insurance to a large extent also depend on the quality improvement of domestic pharmaceutical excipients. In line with the principle of "promoting technological innovation in pharmaceutical excipients and enhancing the new quality productivity of the pharmaceutical industry," the "2024 Annual Academic Conference of the Pharmaceutical Excipients Professional Committee of the Chinese Pharmaceutical Association," hosted by the Pharmaceutical Excipients Professional Committee of the Chinese Pharmaceutical Association, is scheduled to be held in Hefei, Anhui Province from November 8th to 10th, 2024. This academic conference will feature conference reports in the fields of materials science related to pharmaceutical excipients, innovative drugs, and innovative formulations, analyzing the development difficulties and innovations of pharmaceutical excipients; inviting authoritative experts to deeply discuss the in vivo processes of pharmaceutical excipients and drug delivery carriers, as well as the improvement and innovation of excipient quality. The conference will set up expert venues and young scholar sub-venues with three themes: "Pharmaceutical Excipients, Packaging Materials, and Drug Delivery Devices," "New Materials, New Carriers, and Innovative Formulations," and "Pharmaceutical Excipients and Innovative Drugs," to promote the wide participation of enterprises, academia, and young scholars, and jointly focus on the technological innovation and industrial research and development of pharmaceutical excipients. The relevant matters are hereby notified as follows: 1. Conference theme: Promote technological innovation in pharmaceutical excipients and enhance the new quality productivity of the pharmaceutical industry. 2. Time and location: November 8th Registration location: New Ji Hotel, Hefei (2766 Wenzhong Road, Yaohai District, Hefei, Anhui Province) November 9-10 Main venue and sub-venues are both at the Shaoquan Lake Campus of Anhui University of Chinese Medicine in Hefei, Anhui Province (350 Longzihu Road, Yaohai District, Hefei, Anhui Province) 3. Conference arrangements: The conference will adopt a format of main venue and sub-venue reports for communication. The conference will invite well-known experts and scholars from domestic universities, research institutes, pharmaceutical companies, research units, medical institutions, regulatory agencies, etc., to give keynote speeches and special lectures. Please see the detailed schedule in Annex 1. 4. Participants: Researchers, managers, graduate students, etc., engaged in research and development related to pharmaceutical excipients, pharmaceutical packaging materials, drug delivery devices, formulation quality control, formulation equipment, pharmaceutical services, etc., from higher education institutions, research institutes, pharmaceutical companies, research units, medical institutions, drug regulatory agencies, and other related institutions. 5. Papers that have not been published in publicly distributed journals or presented at national academic conferences are the responsibility of the author; please ensure clear expression and accurate data. We welcome active submissions from researchers in the pharmaceutical field. 2. After the paper is reviewed by experts, the organizing committee will select several papers for further communication or publication in the "Drug Analysis" journal. 3. title_en: Maotai cultural tourism accelerates "breaking the circle"
body_en:
Recently, the Feitian Night · Huang Xiaoxi Music Festival and the 2025 Maoyou Carnival were staged at Maotai College in Renhuai City, Zunyi City, Guizhou Province. This music festival organized by China Guizhou Maotai Distillery (Group) Cultural Tourism Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as "Maotai Culture and Tourism") in conjunction with relevant units, combined with Guizhou intangible cultural heritage, Maotai cultural and creative elements, attracted many tourists.

In recent years, Maotai Culture and Tourism has explored new paths for the integration of wine and tourism through the development of cultural and creative products, the upgrading of industrial tourism, and innovative marketing and promotion.

To achieve a "good" integration of wine and tourism

The development of wine and tourism integration initially focused mainly on the tour mode: guided by staff from wine companies, tourists visited wine history museums, product display halls, etc. Later, some large wine companies began to focus on creating more experiential scenes by combining their own wine culture, and Maotai Culture and Tourism has made many attempts in immersive experiences.

As soon as you enter Maotai Town in Renhuai City, you can deeply feel the saying "the fragrance of wine does not fear the depth of the alley." Maotai Town is where the Maotai Distillery is located, and the air is filled with the aroma of soy sauce wine. Relying on the resources of the Maotai Distillery, the local area began promoting the integration of wine and tourism early on.

The China Wine Culture City, built from 1993 to 1997, covers an area of over 30,000 square meters and systematically showcases the origin of Chinese wine, brewing techniques, wine customs, and flavors. In 2014, the China Wine Culture City was established as a national 4A-level tourist attraction.

The person in charge of the China Wine Culture City introduced that there are seven exhibition halls in the park, including the China Wine Source Museum, China Wine Technology Museum, and Maotai · Famous Wine World Museum. In 2024, the China Wine Culture City received 320,000 visitors.

"I am from Shaanxi, and I didn't expect to see our hometown's Xifeng wine here. It was named one of the four famous wines in 1952." In the Maotai · Famous Wine World Museum, a visitor from Xi'an proudly said, "The content displayed here is very rich, and I have learned a lot."

Maotai Culture and Tourism also organizes tours of the Maotai Distillery for tourists, allowing them to experience the brewing process up close with the aroma of wine. In 2024, "Maotai Distillery: Wine and Tourism Integration Helps Industrial Heritage Revitalization" was selected as a typical case of industrial heritage protection and utilization by the National Cultural Relics Bureau and the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology.

"We will strive to enrich the experience of tourists, integrating wine culture into their lives through cultural influence, technological empowerment, tourism performances, etc." Maotai Culture and Tourism General Manager Chen Junrui introduced that Maotai Culture and Tourism is exploring ways to present the production and tasting scenes of Maotai wine in an immersive and dramatic way.

Currently, Maotai Culture and Tourism is also promoting the Maotai Historical and Cultural District project. This project will integrate rich Maotai culture into accommodation, dining, and other formats, allowing tourists to immerse themselves in Maotai culture and experience the poetic feeling of "wandering in a painting."

Creating "beautiful" cultural and creative products

Just as there are extreme requirements for the quality of white wine, Maotai Culture and Tourism also shows great ingenuity in the creation of tourism products, especially cultural and creative products.

At the scene of the Feitian Night · Huang Xiaoxi Music Festival and the 2025 Maoyou Carnival, Maotai Culture and Tourism set up cultural and creative booths displaying a variety of unique products such as small Maotai dolls, small Maotai blind boxes, Maotai tea sets, etc. The eye-catching design and exquisite workmanship attracted many tourists to make purchases.

"This small Maotai doll is very popular, and I finally managed to get one." Chongqing tourist Wang Yudi carried a small Maotai doll on her back and said with interest, "My doll is wearing a purple cloak and is called 'Zijin.' These dolls all have their own names, very cute."

"We entered the cultural and creative track in 2022 and have designed more than 120 products so far, with total revenue approaching nearly 2 billion yuan." The head of the cultural and creative business department of Maotai Culture and Tourism Company said.

Maotai · Forbidden City Cultural and Creative Wine, Maotai · West Lake Ten Sceneries, and other cultural and creative wines integrate Maotai culture and Chinese traditional culture. The "Traditional Chinese Festival · Season" series products and exquisite wine utensils have beautiful shapes, Maotai refrigerator stickers, blind boxes, and other products are trendy and fashionable... Currently, Maotai Culture and Tourism has built a product matrix consisting of four major products: wine cultural and creative products, cultural and creative wines, Maotai cultural and creative derivatives, and small Maotai IP peripheral products, covering materials such as ceramics, wood, fabric, metal, gradually achieving product serialization and refinement.

In addition, Maotai Culture and Tourism's offline stores and other cultural and creative spaces are blooming in various scenic spots, supermarkets, etc., achieving rapid access of products to tourists, and the image of the small Maotai IP is increasingly accepted and recognized by the market.

"The target audience of Maotai's alcoholic products tends to be business-oriented and mature, while Maotai's cultural and creative products need to be more youthful and fashionable." Chen Junrui said, "The primary task of developing cultural and creative products is to study the needs of young people, such as beautiful, with Eastern aesthetics, and emotional value, these are the common characteristics of cultural and creative products that young people love."

"Maotai's main business is brewing, adhering to the corporate philosophy of 'respecting heaven, respecting people, understanding reason, and being virtuous,' and has accumulated rich Maotai culture." Chen Junrui introduced, "As Maotai Culture and Tourism promotes the development of cultural and creative products, it must also continue the cultural genes of Maotai, connecting Maotai culture on one end and young customer groups on the other end, striving to achieve refinement, fashion, youth, and international development."

Creating a "real" digital world

Currently, many well-known wine companies across the country are extending their brands through the integration of wine and tourism. Maotai is accelerating the transformation from "selling wine to selling a way of life" to continuously enhance its influence.

In fact, Maotai Culture and Tourism is currently accelerating its "breaking boundaries" to continuously enhance its brand influence. In April of this year, initiated and guided by the Guizhou Provincial Department of Culture and Tourism, Maotai Culture and Tourism led the creation of the "Huang Xiaoxi" digital figure, named after the iconic landscapes of Guizhou - the "Huang"guoshu Waterfall, "Xiao"qikong, and "Xi"jiang Qianhu Miao Village. "Huang Xiaoxi" has appeared in many activities, and its lovely image is becoming more deeply rooted in people's hearts.

"We will continue to enrich the connotation of 'Huang Xiaoxi,' promoting characteristic tourism resources from aspects such as national culture, characteristic cuisine, intangible cultural heritage, and fashion." Chen Junrui said, Maotai Culture and Tourism will also provide more tourism supporting services and cultural creative products around "Huang Xiaoxi" to meet the needs of tourists.

At the same time, Maotai Culture and Tourism is also advancing its operations on e-commerce platforms such as Taobao, JD.com, and Douyin, strengthening brand exposure.

On May 12-13, Li Bingjun, Deputy Secretary of the Guizhou Provincial Party Committee and Governor, emphasized during his research in Renhuai City, Zunyi City, Xishui County, and Chishui City that leveraging comparative advantages to promote the integration of wine and tourism, leading the transformation from "selling wine to selling a way of life," and solidly promoting integrated development of industry, strong counties, and prosperous people. This year's Guizhou Provincial Government Work Report also mentioned accelerating the transformation from "selling wine to selling a way of life," which is also the development direction of Maotai Culture and Tourism.

"As a state-owned enterprise, Maotai Culture and Tourism should also shoulder the social responsibilities it should bear." Chen Junrui said, "In the process of integrating wine and tourism development, Maotai Culture and Tourism should provide direct or indirect employment opportunities for local residents. At the same time, it will also cooperate with surrounding scenic spots in Maotai Town to promote the overall tourism development of Maotai Town."

Looking ahead, Maotai Culture and Tourism will focus on the four core businesses of industrial tourism operation, cultural and creative product development, exhibition planning, and Xunfeng digital platform development and operation, to do a "refined" tourism industry chain, create "beautiful" Maotai cultural and creative products, conduct "deep" cultural dissemination, and build a "real" Xunfeng digital world, contributing Maotai strength to the innovative development of wine and tourism integration in Guizhou and even the whole country.

title_en: These hospitals in Jilin Province use mobile payment to achieve mobile medical insurance settlement (with detailed list attached)
body_en:
Are you still worried about the long queues at the payment window?
Have you ever missed valuable time due to cumbersome reimbursement processes?
Good news from the Jilin Provincial Medical Insurance Bureau: you can now handle medical insurance settlements using your mobile phone!
95 designated medical institutions in Jilin Province have opened mobile payment for medical insurance, which can facilitate patients to pay outpatient fees in the clinic, inpatient fees in the ward, and registration fees at home (see list for specific institutions, actual scenarios may vary).
Mobile payment for medical insurance refers to insured individuals completing medical insurance payments through mobile devices such as phones during the medical treatment process, without the need for a physical insurance card or waiting in line at the window to make payments, avoiding back and forth trips, making it more convenient for the public to seek medical treatment and purchase medication.
This service is available for insured individuals seeking medical treatment at hospitals in Jilin Province that have implemented mobile payment for medical insurance, including provincial employees (active and retired), residents, and insured individuals from other provinces who have completed the medical treatment record transfer.
Insured individuals can log in to the medical institution's mini-program or the "Jilin Smart Medical Insurance" APP, Alipay's "Jilin Province Medical Insurance Mobile Payment" mini-program, WeChat's "Jilin Medical Insurance Public Service" mini-program, etc., to access the mobile payment page and find the pending orders for payment.
Depending on the scenario, mobile phones can be used to pay registration fees, examination fees, medication costs, etc., with the medical insurance reimbursement portion deducted directly, and the self-payment amount paid online, with clear and detailed billing information.
Of course! The online payment deduction method is the same as the window settlement deduction method. Currently, apart from the medical insurance reimbursement portion (paid by the patient), the expenses are first deducted from the individual's personal account balance, followed by deductions from the linked family mutual aid account (or the individual's medical insurance wallet), with the remaining amount paid in cash.
For online appointments, patients should wait in the doctor's office according to the scheduled time. For in-clinic medication payments, patients can directly go to the pharmacy to collect medication by scanning the medical insurance code. For in-clinic examination fee payments, patients can wait in the examination area. For hospital deposit payments, patients can register for admission in the inpatient treatment area.
Mobile payment for medical insurance is a key measure to improve the public's medical experience and make it easier for the public to handle matters with fewer errands. The Jilin Provincial Medical Insurance Bureau will continue to expand the scope of mobile payment access, optimize the mobile payment process, broaden application scenarios, and allow insured individuals to enjoy the convenience brought by digital reforms!
The list of designated medical institutions implementing mobile payment for medical insurance will be dynamically updated in the "Jilin Medical Insurance Public Service" official account - "Service Hall" - "Mobile Payment".

title_en: Using roads as a medium, integrating and empowering.
body_en:
Reporter Li Chenghan
On the vast land of Yunling, the mileage of highways has exceeded ten thousand miles, and favorable policies continue to be released. The path of integrated development continues to expand, and economic and social benefits are accelerating. A reform centered around the integrated development of highways is vigorously advancing. From a single transportation artery to a comprehensive benefit network, Yunnan has introduced the "Several Policy Measures to Promote the Integrated Development of Highways (Trial)" to unveil the strategic blueprint of "Highway +", covering six major paths including "Highway + Industry" and "Highway + Culture and Tourism". This anchors the sustainable development goals of highways and empowers economic and social development with high quality.

Building a dense road network to create a new development pattern
Yunnan's mountainous terrain poses challenges to transportation construction, but the footsteps of progress have never stopped. In recent years, the construction of highways in our province has made remarkable progress. By 2024, the total mileage of highways in the province has reached 10,758 kilometers, ranking second in the country, covering 124 counties (cities, districts), providing strong support for economic and social development. However, due to the influence of terrain and topography, the bridges and tunnels of highways in Yunnan are high and costly, with a high average cost per kilometer, long payback periods, and some highway projects facing operational pressures. Influenced by the development model, the integration of highways with industries and resources along the route is insufficient, and there is still great potential to tap into economic benefits.

Challenges breed new opportunities. The Yunnan Provincial Party Committee and Provincial Government have implemented the "Several Policy Measures to Promote the Integrated Development of Highways in Yunnan (Trial)" this year. This set of 16 specific measures focuses on the dimensions of foundation, path, vitality, and guarantee, fully promoting the comprehensive transformation of highways from a single transportation function to comprehensive benefits.

In the view of Shang Zhongkai, Chief Accountant of Yunnan Construction Investment Group, Secretary of the Party Committee and Chairman of the Board of Directors of Jitou Company, the precise and powerful "policy measures" are a timely rain for enterprises. The company will actively seize policy opportunities, promote the deep integration of road networks, logistics networks, and energy networks, vigorously promote the development of industries such as "Highway + Industry, Culture and Tourism, Photovoltaics, Logistics, Stone Materials, and Smart Numbers", further increase project revenue, expand cash flow, achieve "revenue with profit, profit with cash flow", and explore a new path for the sustainable development of highways.

Industry insiders point out that the introduction of the "policy measures" is conducive to boosting the confidence of market entities, and will bring significant benefits to highway enterprises in anchoring high-quality development tasks and promoting market-oriented transformation. For example, supporting the "opening" projects of highways will greatly activate the operating potential of service facilities along highways, promote the integrated development of advantageous industries in our province such as industry, culture and tourism, and highland characteristic agriculture with highways, improve the cooperation efficiency of industrial parks along the route, accelerate the creation of "road-city integration" operating scenarios, create new opportunities for market entities along the route, and open up new space for the coordinated development of the primary, secondary, and tertiary industries.

"Tian Jingsong, a second-level inspector of the Yunnan Provincial Department of Transportation, said, "The Yunnan Provincial Department of Transportation actively cooperates with the Provincial Development and Reform Commission to comprehensively promote differentiated toll collection. Based on ensuring the sustainable operation capacity of highways and maintaining the stable order of national networked toll collection, adhering to the principle of government guidance and enterprise independent participation, using government toll pricing standards as the upper limit, guiding and supporting operating enterprises to independently choose differentiated toll collection methods and set preferential rates, steadily and orderly promoting the implementation of differentiated toll collection measures, and effectively exerting the policy effectiveness." According to statistics, from 2022 to March 31, 2025, the differentiated toll collection of highways in the province has reduced vehicle tolls by a total of 14.985 billion yuan, benefiting 2.323 billion vehicle trips, making a huge contribution to reducing the cost of social travel and optimizing the business environment.

Integrated development stimulates new economic growth in the region
Entering the Songming Service Area of the Xiaopu to Wulong Highway, photovoltaic panels are spread along the slope of the service area. As the first distributed photovoltaic power station on highways in the province, this project has become a vivid practice of the integration of "Highway + Photovoltaic" in Yunnan since it was connected to the grid in 2020.
From the construction of photovoltaics on highway slopes to photovoltaic road lighting, and charging stations in photovoltaic service areas, energy conservation and carbon reduction, the integration of photovoltaics and transportation scenes is deepening, and the application of photovoltaics in the transportation field is becoming increasingly diverse.
"The Provincial Energy Bureau will actively cooperate with relevant departments to promote the landing of the 'Energy-Transportation Integration' policy." Fu Hui, Chief Engineer of the Provincial Energy Bureau, said that in the future, they will adhere to planning first, understand the resource base, and formulate development plans; promote classified construction, advance distributed and centralized photovoltaic projects based on planning; actively seek support, and fully guarantee the steady progress of "Highway + Photovoltaic".
Along the highways, stories of industrial synergy development are unfolding one after another, and the integration of culture and tourism is also shining. On May 22, five sites including the Yunnan Post Service Area, Nake Li Service Area, Taoyuan Scenic Spot, Ganzhuang Service Area, Lujiangba Service Area, and Yunnan Highway Museum were selected as the "2025 Transportation and Tourism Integration Innovation Projects". These service stations integrate regional culture, link advantageous natural resources, deeply integrate highway services with tourism experiences, providing tourists with a richer and more diverse travel experience. At the same time, it drives the sales of local agricultural and specialty products, promotes cultural and creative products, forms a "highway + industry + culture + tourism" integrated development model, and provides valuable experience and models for the integrated development of transportation and tourism nationwide.
With the clarification of six major integration paths such as "Highway + Industry", "Highway + Culture and Tourism", and "Highway + Photovoltaic", the "Highway +" model will blossom in multiple points across the province. In terms of "Highway + Industry", the implementation of the "opening" projects list, interchanges, and transformation of connecting lines closely connect towns, parks, and enterprises, helping Yunnan's characteristic industries set sail; "Highway + Logistics" relies on ports and parks to build logistics hubs, use service areas and parking areas to build logistics bases, and ensure smooth flow of goods; "Highway + Stone Materials", the state (city) government revitalizes sand and stone resources in accordance with the law and regulations to fill the funding gap in highway construction; "Highway + Smart Numbers", operating units collect and analyze data in accordance with the law to provide strong support for development decisions.
In the future, the smooth highways will transform into the link of resource integration, the springboard for industrial ascension, and the corridor for green development, becoming the dynamic engine for high-quality development.

"Highway + Culture and Tourism"
Roadside economy connects "poetry and the distance"
"Welcome to Chengcheng Expressway. I am the anchor 'Lazy Sheep'. Chengcheng Expressway is 15 kilometers long, with famous attractions such as Fuxian Lake and Maotianshan World Natural Heritage along the route. It features local specialties such as Chengjiang lotus root powder, Chengjiang blueberries, and delicious Chengjiang anti-wave fish. Wishing you a pleasant journey." From 10:00 to 12:00 on May 23, at the toll booth of the Cheng (Gong) Cheng (Jiang) Expressway invested and constructed by Yunnan Construction Investment Group, toll collector Zou Yuchen was conducting a live broadcast on the internet, providing information on road conditions, traffic safety knowledge, and cultural and tourism resources along the route to passengers, transforming the small toll booth into a "traffic entrance" activating cultural and tourism resources along the route.
The recently completed Yongjin Expressway Jiayuan section connects the Xinping Chucheng Orange Base, Yuanjiang Mango Industrial Park, and Ailao Mountain Ecotourism Area, creating a "tropical fruit cold chain corridor" and a "nationality cultural experience corridor". This highway is not only the main transportation and commercial artery connecting Xinping County in Yuxi City to Yuanjiang County in the southern region of Yunnan, but also a golden tourist route integrating natural wonders, ethnic cultures, historical sites, and characteristic cuisine.
Combining cultural and tourism resources along the highway projects, Yunnan Construction Investment Group is committed to turning the projects themselves into attractions. Taking the Binhe Expressway as an example, its mainline coincides with the route of the Red Army's Second and Sixth Corps during the Long March in 1936 passing through Binchuan and Heqing, which was historically an important section of the Southern Silk Road and the Tea Horse Ancient Road, as well as an important route for various ethnic groups to enter Yunnan from the south. Yunnan Construction Investment Group has combined the rich historical relics and ethnic integration cultural resources left by the Red Army's Long March in Binchuan and Heqing to turn the Binhe Expressway into the country's first dual-cultural themed demonstration expressway.
"We have fully integrated cultural and tourism resources, relying on cross-line bridges, tunnel entrances, Long March themed service areas, corridors, Long March spirit themed squares, new era Long March themed exhibition halls, Jizhu tourist road themed squares, ethnic unity road themed squares, and Tea Horse Trade Road themed squares, among other diverse carriers, creating the 'Red Army Long March Road' from Binchuan to Heqing and the 'Ethnic Unity and Progress Road' from Heqing to Binchuan, making the Binhe Expressway a truly scenic avenue, cultural corridor, and tourist corridor." said Yang Zhihua, Chairman of the Board of Directors of Binhe Expressway Investment Company.
At the observation platform outside the Hutiaoxia Toll Station on the Xiangli Expressway, the Jinsha River, Lancang River, and Nu River rush between the folds of the Hengduan Mountains, attracting many photography enthusiasts; the Miyu Expressway connects the Mile Lake Spring Ecological Park with the Fuxian Lake in Yuxi, forming a cross-regional tourism route of "hot spring vacation - lake leisure"; the "fast travel and slow tourism" industrial closed loop built by the highway network is flourishing, bringing "poetry and the distance" into reality, and allowing the roadside economy to unfold infinite possibilities between the mountains and rivers.

"Highway + Smart Numbers"
Technological innovation forges new quality productivity
On the electronic screens of the data trading centers in Shanghai and Kunming, the names of the "Yun Tong Shuju" series of data products quietly light up. This seemingly simple step is actually a powerful practice of Yunnan Highway Network Toll Management Co., Ltd., which has been deeply cultivating for years and building the largest highway network data set in the province.
To revitalize the "digital wealth mine" of highways, the network company has meticulously worked on a large amount of networked toll data - cleaning, analyzing, and modeling, ultimately refining 20 "Yun Tong Shuju" series data products, which have successfully landed on the Shanghai Data Exchange and Kunming Data Exchange. This not only realizes the monetization of data assets but also opens up a key link in the market circulation of Yunnan's highway data elements.
The first batch of 10 products, such as cargo stability, vehicle activity, and industrial economic index, accurately serve multiple scenarios such as "transportation + industry integration, logistics optimization, credit risk control, and insurance anti-fraud". The second batch of 10 products, such as high-speed OD path insights and road section flow prediction models, deeply analyze travel behavior, providing strong support for scientifically formulating differentiated toll collection strategies and effectively enhancing the digital capabilities of operating enterprises.
In recent years, the network company has continued to deepen the construction of high-quality data sets. By vigorously promoting data standard formulation, data governance, and data aggregation and integration, it has borne fruitful results in the field of "Highway + Smart Numbers" construction - successfully building the largest highway network data set in the province based on networked toll business.
In December 2024, the network company achieved an important breakthrough: the annual data assets were officially accounted for, becoming the first enterprise in Yunnan to complete data asset registration at the Shanghai Data Exchange. Through professional evaluation, its comprehensive data asset value exceeded 55 million yuan. The company has deep cooperation with authoritative third-party rating agencies with legal qualifications, strictly following regulatory requirements, scientifically considering the company's operational risks, financial risks, and the economic value of data assets, innovating the rating methods moderately, and ultimately winning an "AA" rating, laying a solid foundation for exploring the securitization of data assets in the future.
"The blueprint for the integrated development of 'Highway + Smart Numbers' in Yunnan is accelerating due to the empowerment of data," said a relevant person in charge of Yunnan Highway Network Toll Management Co., Ltd. Faced with the newly introduced "Several Policy Measures to Promote the Integrated Development of Highways in Yunnan (Trial)", the company is ready to act and will actively implement the "technology and digital dual empowerment" action, establish data standards and full-chain control, deepen digital transformation; strengthen data applications, develop decision analysis, traffic operations, and other capabilities, drive efficient data utilization with practical scenarios; support precise measures, help highway units explore differentiated toll collection for specific periods, regions, sections, goods, and vehicles, forge new quality productivity through technological innovation.

"Highway + Logistics"
Smooth flow of goods serves regional economy
At the Dushupu Service Area of the Kunming-Chuxiong Expressway in the western suburbs of Kunming, there is a bustling scene with colorful flags flying. On May 23, the Kunming National Comprehensive Freight Hub Supplementary Chain Strengthening Project - Yunnan Highway (Dushupu) Central Warehouse was officially completed.
Standing at a high point of the project, three huge high-standard warehouses stand tall, the 3500-square-meter container freight yard is neatly planned, and the intelligent logistics information system, intelligent unmanned toll station, and rooftop distributed photovoltaic facilities are arranged in an orderly manner. This logistics "giant" covering 125 acres and a construction area of 57,700 square meters is ready to go.
"This is a leading demonstration project to solve the development challenges of the 'post-highway era' and build a green and beautiful channel economy of 'transportation + logistics'." Luo Xiangsheng, Chairman of the Board of Directors of Yunnan Jiaotou Group's Operating Company, said that the Dushupu Central Warehouse is a key logistics project in Yunnan's "14th Five-Year Plan" and the first batch of "emergency and dual-use" suburban large warehouse base projects in Kunming. The project focuses on the fast-moving consumer goods market of highway service areas, the intercity distribution market of Kunming Anning, and the province's green food distribution market. Through an intelligent and efficient warehousing and distribution system and multimodal transport service system, it will help Yunnan's logistics reach new heights.
Inside the exhibition hall of the central warehouse, the project plan attracted the attention of many corporate representatives. "We focus on warehousing and distribution services for fast-moving consumer goods such as food, beverages, and daily necessities, and also develop e-commerce business for green agricultural products such as fruits, nuts, and Chinese medicinal materials based on Yunnan's characteristics." The staff explained in detail, "For special products such as liquor, lubricating oil, and batteries, we also provide Class I warehousing services to ensure that all types of needs are met, creating a modern logistics distribution center integrating warehousing, transportation, distribution, trade, rail-road intermodal transport, and driver-passenger services."
The completion of the Dushupu Central Warehouse project is like a powerful magnet, attracting the attention of many industry-leading enterprises. Enterprises such as Sinopec, Alibaba, Yum China, Yuntianhua, and Huoban Niu have come to discuss entering the project, and are currently preparing for the early-stage operation. After the project officially starts operation, it will form a three-dimensional sales network through the "e-commerce direct sales + offline pilot store" model, pilot the development of "empty land intermodal" logistics distribution business, smooth the "last mile" of end distribution, help Yunnan build a national brand for export.
Currently, the Dushupu Central Warehouse project has completed all hardware facilities such as high-standard warehouses and comprehensive buildings, and is improving supporting software facilities. Yunnan Jiaotou Group will take the construction of the main channel as the lead, the Dushupu Central Warehouse project as the engine, continue to deepen the integrated development model of "transportation + logistics + industry", focus on building a "1+5+N" highway logistics network, focus on creating logistics trunk line services connected to industrial agglomeration areas, border trade ports, and multimodal transport hubs, accelerate the formation of a new pattern of integrated channel logistics development integrating warehousing, transportation, distribution, trade, and digitalization, accelerate the construction of the Kunming International Land Port, and help Yunnan build a center radiating to South Asia and Southeast Asia in China.

title_en: Learn skills, digital assistants are here to help.
body_en:
Reshaping artificial intelligence (AI) in thousands of industries is empowering more skilled talents.
Not long ago, at a training event called "AI First Lesson" held in Shenzhen, skilled talents from various industries such as automotive maintenance, numerical control technology, chefs, and housekeeping shared their experiences of using AI.
A Cantonese chef said he is trying to use AI to research recipes from different cuisines such as Sichuan cuisine, which helps in the development of fusion dishes. When foreign guests visit the restaurant where he works, the large model can help him summarize and refine the characteristics of a particular dish; a vice president of a housekeeping company said that new maternity matrons often have beginner questions, but through tools like AI knowledge bases, the training time can be greatly shortened from six months.
"With the popularity of AI products like DeepSeek, Yuanbao, and IMA, ordinary people can also use AI." Ling Yuanqiang, director of the Shenzhen Vocational Skills Training Guidance Center, who was also present at the event, said that the training aims to empower skilled talents through AI. In his view, AI is not just a tool, but when applied in thousands of industries, it will create a new ecosystem for skills.
Digital assistants boost skills improvement
With the development of AI and other digital technologies, the "vertical force" AI large model is increasingly becoming a digital assistant for skilled talents, becoming a "stable employment engine."
In the past week, Zhang Haiying from the Quality Management Department of the Chemical Manufacturing Center of Transfar Group has shared her AI learning achievements more than once: she has gradually mastered the application of AI tools in production and management scenarios, independently developing an intelligent recognition and analysis system for product quality assurance forms. The system can complete form sorting in a few seconds, increasing efficiency by more than 10 times, saving an estimated 1800 hours per year.
On May 26, Zhang Haiying and more than 20 colleagues participated in the group's "AI Intelligent Body Creation Camp" training. "The previous AI general training inspired me to use AI tools for work, and this time we will collaborate to explore more application scenarios." Including familiar quality inspection scenarios for this senior student, the AI training conducted by the group covers 58 scenarios in 12 areas including office, management, marketing, service, intelligent manufacturing, and supply chain.
"AI must be combined with the industry to create real value." According to Xu Guanjie, chairman of Transfar Group, compared to repetitive and simple job positions in the past, the working environment of intelligent factories has fundamentally changed, and organizational capabilities and team structures urgently need to be iteratively updated.
Regarding how to promote industrial workers to transition from "blue-collar" to engineers, Xu Guanjie believes that industrial workers need to be proficient in professional skills as well as modern technology tools and equipment. Currently, the group invests over 100 million yuan annually in employee skills training, with an average of 75 hours of learning per employee by 2024, doubling compared to before. In terms of business volume, the group's business volume has increased fivefold in the past decade. "This is the innovative contribution of improving the capabilities of technical and skilled talents." Xu Guanjie said.
Facing the structural changes in talent demand brought about by business transformation and intelligent upgrading, many traditional enterprises are exploring new paths for vocational training to address challenges, with a greater focus on stabilizing and expanding employment and improving employment quality.
At Fuyao Group, a supplier of integrated solutions for automotive glass and automotive accessories, special classes such as "Fuyao Industry Class" and "Order Class" have been established. The group also collaborates with multiple universities nationwide to build an integrated "industry-education-research-application" cooperation model, opening up internship positions in materials, research and development, machinery, intelligent manufacturing, and other fields.
An official from the Talent Configuration and Development Department of Fuyao Group introduced that this year, the group has created new project bases in Hefei, Anhui, and Fuqing, Fujian, as well as carried out intelligent transformations of existing projects, resulting in the addition of 6,750 new jobs. Among them, 4,963 frontline technical workers cover new positions such as intelligent equipment operation and quality AI testing; 1,787 professional technical positions cover roles such as product design, research and development technology, and equipment technology, including cutting-edge positions such as car communication research and development engineers and dual-carbon managers.
New opportunities for career development
In fact, including traditional manufacturing enterprises, various types of business entities are the main force in stabilizing employment. In terms of empowering employment with AI, companies such as Alibaba, Huawei, Baidu, and Tencent leverage their technological advantages to promote the "last mile" of youth employment, growth, and talent development through digital means.
"When cars were invented, no one chased cars with horse carriages, but instead transformed from carriage drivers to drivers themselves." At the aforementioned "AI First Lesson" for skilled talents, Liang Peng, an AI trainer from Tencent who exchanged ideas with many skilled talents, believes that on one hand, AI has become a "24-hour working partner," and people, in the process of using AI, also inadvertently evolve their cognitive patterns; on the other hand, AI is reshaping the traditional apprenticeship model of "masters teaching apprentices." "The efficiency improvement in maternity matron training is not achieved at the expense of quality, but through algorithm optimization to build a more scientific training system." Liang Peng said.
It is certain that under the wave of AI popularization promoted by many Internet companies, more ordinary workers will have the opportunity to acquire new skills for career development and more fully "be employed."
Lu Jian, head of the Corporate Social Responsibility Department of Baidu, recently stated in an interview with the media that in the future, Baidu will collaborate with universities based on the Baidu PaddlePaddle open-source deep learning platform to empower 5 million AI technical talents and promote the transformation of technology into industry. At the same time, based on the capabilities of Baidu Intelligent Cloud, combined with vocational skills assessment, 5 million applied talents such as industrial workers, digital professionals, and new employment groups will be empowered.
In 2024, Baidu will launch the "Second Skills Learning Platform for Workers" in collaboration with the Wuhan General Union of Labor, serving 3.08 million workers and 21,000 grassroots trade union organizations in Wuhan. So far, the platform has been opened in multiple provinces and cities such as Wuhan, Shanxi, Nanjing, and Shenzhen, empowering workers with second skills and effectively promoting the fair transformation of AI in society.
From being "replaced" to being "enhanced," the exploration of AI empowerment in employment by various parties makes technology more accessible and gives technology a warmer touch. In Lu Jian's words, AI technology should not be a barrier, but a bridge. "We hope to break down employment barriers and enable more people to obtain the 'entry ticket' for career development in the intelligent era through technology empowerment and ecosystem co-construction."

title_en: Women's sports events are becoming increasingly popular, and this Chinese couple who invested six years ago are now making a lot of money.
body_en:
At the end of May this year, defending champions New York Liberty narrowly defeated the Golden State Warriors 82-77 at home, maintaining a five-game winning streak and securing the top spot in the WNBA league. At the same time, the defending champions also made a major announcement in the sports trading market, selling shares of the New York Liberty for an estimated value of $450 million, setting a record for the highest valuation of a women's professional sports club.

The funds from this sale will mainly be used to build a new training facility. In March of this year, the Liberty announced plans to build a 75,000 square foot training facility in the Greenpoint area of Brooklyn, expected to be completed by 2027. This facility will be the WNBA's first training base "designed by players, for players," with a budget of $80 million.

In recent years, women's sports events have been on the rise and gaining high levels of attention, leading to a doubling of the value of some women's sports clubs. This has also allowed some early investors to make significant profits after selling their teams.

Chinese couple invest in women's sports
The Liberty had been up for sale since November 2017. Alibaba Group's board chairman Joe Tsai and his wife Clara Wu Tsai purchased a portion of the Liberty from New York Knicks owner James Dolan for a price ranging from $10-14 million in 2019.

Joe Tsai was a basketball enthusiast during his time at Yale University. He once said, "I believe that sports not only teach you discipline and hard work, but also teach you how to face failure. If you fall down, lose a game, you have to get back up. Many principles apply in business as well."

In terms of the management of the Liberty, Clara Wu Tsai is responsible for the specific daily operations and decision-making. After completing the acquisition, Wu moved the team's home games from a suburban venue to the Barclays Center where the Nets play, and systematically improved the team's infrastructure and operational level. "Everything we did to turn around this 'bad asset' after the acquisition - the first thing was to move the team back to the Barclays Center where the fan base is, and the second thing was to build a team that can win," she said.

The continued investment has paid off. By the end of last year, the Liberty had over 50 sponsors, a nearly 61% increase from the previous year, bringing the team a 68% increase in revenue. In the last season, the New York Liberty ranked second in home attendance in the WNBA, behind only the Indiana Fever. In the 2024 WNBA season, the New York Liberty defeated the Minnesota Lynx 67-62 in a comeback victory to win their first-ever championship.

Clara Wu Tsai celebrated with the team at the scene, saying, "We have proven that when you are willing to invest in women, you can build a championship team, and you can fill the arena to capacity."

At a recent Forbes Iconoclast summit in New York, Clara Wu Tsai confirmed the accuracy of the transaction figures mentioned above to the media, and admitted that the increase in valuation had even surprised herself. "Women's sports is a growth asset with huge long-term upside potential," she said.

Wu expressed her high expectations for the future of the Liberty, believing that by the mid-2030s, the team could become the "first women's sports franchise worth $1 billion."

It is worth mentioning that starting from the next season, the WNBA will launch a new media rights agreement worth about $200 million annually for 11 years.

Recently, there have been rumors on the internet that the Tsai couple made a huge profit from investing in the Liberty, with returns exceeding 30 times this year. However, in reality, after initially purchasing a portion of the basketball team in 2019, the couple continued to add investments. According to some foreign media estimates, the Tsai couple actually spent a total of $100 to $140 million to acquire the Liberty from Dolan.

Huge potential in the women's sports market
Deloitte once released a research report titled "The Rise of Women's Sports: Towards Commercialization," which showed that over the past decade, many cases have shown that women's sports will attract a large number of TV viewers, create value for sponsors, and attract tens of thousands of sports fans to watch a single event. In another report titled "Elite Women's Sports: Breaking the Billion Dollar Barrier," the organization estimated that by 2024, global women's sports event revenue would reach $1.28 billion, a 300% increase from the 2020 valuation. Specifically, revenue is mainly divided into three categories: commercial revenue (including club sponsorships, partnerships, and merchandise sales) accounts for the largest share of total revenue ($696 million, 55%), followed by broadcast revenue ($340 million, 27%) and match day revenue ($240 million, 18%).

"In recent years, we have seen remarkable growth in global women's sports, driving a significant increase in its commercial value, which in turn has attracted more and more interest from investors around the world," said Jennifer Haskel, head of Deloitte's sports business insights. "The surge in fan and investor engagement has brought new and better opportunities for clubs and leagues, including larger commercial partnerships, more engagement, and bigger match days. To ensure that this growth remains consistent and sustainable, sports organizations must ensure that investments are directed in the right places, such as encouraging fan loyalty, player welfare, and maintaining cross-league competition."

The expansion of women's sports events is reflected in various aspects such as event scale, influence, and commercial value. At the same time, women's sports events are gaining more and more commercial opportunities and social media influence. In the field of sponsorship marketing, women's sports events have evolved from cooperation with traditional sports brands like Nike and Adidas to partnerships with diverse brands such as mineral water Cool Ridge Water and office equipment (Epson), greatly expanding the boundaries of the future women's sports business landscape.

As women's sports events expand, the commercial value of female athletes is rapidly increasing. In 2024, the top 20 highest-earning female athletes increased by 15% compared to 2023, reaching $226 million. Taking tennis as an example, the high viewership of WTA events and the influence of star players have directly driven the growth of personal commercial sponsorships.

Sarah Goff-Frederickson, founder of the women's sports business cooperation marketing company Trailblazing Group, said, "Many studies have shown that from the perspective of return on investment (ROI), the engagement of social media posts when working with female athletes is twice that of working with male athletes, which is what advertisers and brands care about."

title_en: First year "free"! Ma'anshan introduces new policy
body_en: Starting from June 1st, this new policy will be implemented through full government financial subsidies to achieve the goal of "born insured, zero threshold for protection" for newborns, providing the warmest "health gift" to thousands of families and effectively reducing the medical burden on newborn families. According to the detailed implementation rules of the policy, newborns can enjoy medical insurance benefits retroactively from the day of birth until the end of the year; those beyond this period can enjoy medical insurance benefits from the day of registration until the end of the year, without the benefit of cross-year insurance premium payment. In order to ensure the accurate implementation of the policy, the Municipal Medical Insurance Bureau, in conjunction with the departments of finance, health, and taxation, has established a collaborative working mechanism with the goal of "making data run more and people run less," building an "online + offline" service system, optimizing the joint processing process of "birth registration" to achieve simultaneous processing of insurance registration, issuance of "birth medical certificates," household registration, and other matters. Insurance registration can be completed through the "Efficiently Completing One Thing" platform on the Anhui Affairs App for instant enjoyment, or through the WeChat and Alipay "Anhui Medical Insurance Public Service" mini program for registration, special population identity verification, and "paperless handling." Insurance registration can also be done at the windows of various levels of medical insurance collection and handling agencies, or at village (community) service centers to enjoy the first year of free insurance for newborns. This reform is an important measure taken by Ma'anshan to implement the national policy of optimizing childbirth, solving the problem of the "coverage gap" in newborn medical insurance benefits through institutional arrangements. The person in charge of the Municipal Medical Insurance Bureau stated that they will continue to track the implementation effects of the policy, continuously improve the children's medical security system, and provide strong support for promoting long-term balanced population development.

title_en: New technology is right around us.
body_en:
The new technology in the Shanghai International Film Festival, in the interactive experience of future cinemas, in the speeches of forum guests, in the fresh ideas of young filmmakers, is also around you and me.
