title_en: The "free" moxibustion clinic is digging a hole again.
body_en:
Recently, this newspaper exposed the behavior of multiple community group buying "supermarkets" using the name "1 yuan to receive eggs" to attract elderly people into the group, and then sell health products to them (see page 11 of May 12). After the article was published, the company involved was interviewed. Several readers subsequently reported that some moxibustion clinics also used the same tactics, first attracting elderly people into the store with "free trials," and ultimately selling "miraculous" health products. The reporter conducted an investigation on this matter.

On-site visits: Moxibustion clinics crowded with elderly people early in the morning

"My mother used to go to the morning market to buy vegetables as soon as she got up. Now, she doesn't make breakfast anymore, but instead goes for moxibustion early in the morning with an alarm set for around 6 o'clock!" Ms. Sun from Baosheng West Lane in Haidian District said that since a community opened a moxibustion clinic claiming to be "public welfare and free," her mother's habits have changed - no longer leisurely strolling in the morning market, but rushing to do moxibustion every day.

Ms. Sun said that her mother had been doing moxibustion for over a month, praising it as "comfortable," and indeed had not spent any money. However, one day while cleaning the house, she found a pile of royal jelly health products in the cupboard. Upon asking, she found out that the old lady had quietly spent over a thousand yuan. "What kind of moxibustion clinic is this? Why are they also selling royal jelly?" Ms. Sun was puzzled.

Based on the clues provided by Ms. Sun, the reporter visited the brand's store in Dongcheng District. At 2:30 pm, more than twenty elderly people were lined up in front of the "Tianmi xx" moxibustion clinic on Donghuashi Street in Dongcheng District. "Free 40-minute moxibustion, with noodles and flour provided!" an auntie enthusiastically introduced. The reporter tried to enter the store for inquiries but was stopped by the front desk staff: "The free moxibustion activity has ended, and there are no more prizes." However, when the reporter left, he saw two elderly people entering the store for free moxibustion. In the following month, the reporter visited this store twice and saw elderly people lining up in front of the store each time.

The reporter's investigation found that there are quite a few "free" moxibustion clinics like this.

At 7:30 am on May 19, near Zhouzhuangzi Community in Fengtai District, the "Aishang xx" moxibustion clinic was bustling with elderly people coming in and out.

"It's always crowded early in the morning." An elderly person told the reporter that moxibustion is done for free in the store every day starting at 6:30 am, with each session lasting 40 minutes, five sessions in the morning and two in the afternoon. "They don't charge, and they even have several staff members serving us. Those who attend all the sessions receive material rewards every month!"

However, when the reporter entered the store at 10:30 am to inquire about moxibustion, the store staff seemed particularly vigilant. "We are busy now, it's not convenient, please come back later." Despite there being no elderly people inside, the staff hurriedly escorted the reporter out. 

At 8:30 am on May 28, near Han Zhuangzi Erlu in Fengtai District, there were also more than a dozen elderly people waiting in line outside the "Qi Ai xx" moxibustion clinic. "We do moxibustion every day for free, the last session hasn't ended yet." an elderly person said.

Taking advantage of the break between sessions, the reporter entered the moxibustion clinic and saw a schedule of moxibustion services posted on the left side of the entrance. Starting from 6:10 am, there are 8 sessions every day, lasting until 3:10 pm. Inside the moxibustion room, there were about forty to fifty moxibustion stools, which were quickly filled by the elderly people entering the store. The front desk staff were busy stamping the attendance cards for the elderly people, with two stacks of cards piled up to almost half a meter high, estimated to be around a hundred cards.

The front desk of the moxibustion clinic displayed multiple price lists for moxibustion services, but when the reporter expressed interest in experiencing it, the staff said, "It's easy to get overheated in hot weather, so these services are temporarily suspended. Currently, we only offer electronic smokeless moxibustion for the elderly." When the reporter requested to sign up, they were still refused: "We only serve the elderly."

The same routine reappears: as long as you come to listen to the class, you can receive something

Are moxibustion clinics that are only free for the elderly really doing charity work? The investigation by the reporter found that these moxibustion clinics are very similar in their tactics to the previously exposed community group buying "supermarkets": they both use free services as bait to attract the elderly into the store, but if the elderly want to receive the free benefits, they must attend classes at the store throughout.

Ms. Li, a resident, recounted her first experience at the "Tianmi xx" moxibustion clinic. "The staff asked me how old I was, if I was retired, and where I lived, then gave me a VIP monthly card." On the monthly card shown by Ms. Li, there were dots from 1 to 31, with a hole on the number "21." "It was the 21st that day, so they punched it and said that every time I come, they would punch the card, and then I would receive a small gift. If I could come continuously for 31 days, I could even receive a special reward."

After Ms. Li obtained the monthly card, she was led into a long and narrow room. The room was set up like a classroom, with 10 rows of 40 moxibustion stools, and a television at the front. "The staff said that if you want to do moxibustion for free, you have to watch the class on TV in the room. Everyone watches, so should you." The 40-minute class on TV covered a lot of topics, and Ms. Li remembered one sentence: "The best nutritional supplement in the world is royal jelly, the ingredients inside have effects on the brain and heart, and people who consume it long-term react quickly."

After the class, Ms. Li also received a free trial pack of "Royal Jelly Perilla Oil Vitamin E Soft Capsules," "They said it's okay if you don't buy anything, as long as you come to class, you will receive something."

According to elderly people who have experienced it, at the "Aishang xx" moxibustion clinic, they also attend classes while doing moxibustion. However, unlike the "Tianmi xx" moxibustion clinic, here they have a 3-day trial system - new elderly people must complete the 3-day course before they can apply for the monthly card. The membership system is further divided into levels: starting with the basic monthly card, attending classes for two months can upgrade to the green card, and after four months, they will be issued the yellow card. "They say the longer you attend classes, the higher your membership level, and the more discounts you will enjoy in the future," said an elderly person who had experienced it.

During the interview, some elderly people who had attended classes for a long time told the reporter that over time, they would be added to WeChat groups, and classes would also transition from offline to online.

"I have several groups here." Aunt Ma has been attending classes at the "Qi Ai xx" moxibustion clinic for 3 years. She showed the reporter multiple WeChat groups on her phone: some groups specifically send course notifications and occasionally share photos of certain leaders or associations inspecting the moxa grass base; some groups regularly post live broadcast links for online classes, promoting health products. "You need to be approved by the staff to enter these groups," Aunt Ma said, indicating that membership in the group represents a form of identity recognition.

Numerous loopholes: a 5000 yuan moxibustion stool without registration

Of course, attending free classes is just a lure. The reporter summarized the experiences of several elderly people and found that as the courses progressed, the stores began to promote daily items such as moxa grass essential oil and honey for less than a hundred yuan; after the elderly people persisted in attending offline classes every day for 3 months, they would start selling high-priced health products such as royal jelly, anti-aging capsules, and ginseng paste priced at over a thousand yuan.

"Going for free moxibustion every day, with such warm hospitality, it's hard not to buy something." Aunt Bai, who lives in Donghuashi, expressed the sentiments of many elderly people. Initially, Aunt Bai could resist not making purchases, but gradually she went from buying royal jelly toothpaste and soap to high-selenium, high-calcium goat milk powder. A piece of royal jelly pearl soap priced at 76.8 yuan is not cheap. Over the course of a month, the elderly people spent three to four hundred yuan in total.

Some elderly people couldn't stop buying. Some children reflected that since their parents started going to the free moxibustion clinic, various health products began to flood into their homes: wild honey, corn paste, camel milk powder, caterpillar fungus capsules... One time, an elderly person insisted on buying a moxibustion stool for over 5000 yuan, "They said this stool is special, it can lower blood sugar, blood pressure, regulate spleen deficiency, kidney deficiency, promote digestion, and both the elderly and children can sit on it."

However, the reporter found that this "miraculous" moxibustion stool is not registered on the official website of the National Medical Products Administration and is just an ordinary product. "This kind of moxibustion stool can be found on Taobao for only two to three hundred yuan." Dr. Wang, who has been practicing moxibustion for nearly 20 years, told the reporter that moxibustion requires finding the right acupoints, controlling the temperature, and timing, it is not as simple as sitting down and getting smoked. There is no medication, equipment, or therapy that can cure all diseases, and moxibustion is no exception.

Over the course of 3 years, Aunt Ma, under the recommendation of the "Qi Ai xx" moxibustion clinic, bought a lot of things, from cheap items like toothpaste and black sesame pills to expensive items like small molecule protein peptide nutritional powder, spending about 50,000 yuan. "The products I buy in the group have a 'small blue cap,' they are regular products, and they are special, cheap, and not available outside."

However, the "small blue cap" products mentioned by Aunt Ma are neither special nor cheap. Taking the example of a certain kind of "Sanqi ginseng capsule" claimed to be specially customized for the elderly in the group, priced at 199 yuan. On e-commerce platforms, the reporter easily found the same product with identical packaging, approval number, and specifications, priced at only 88 yuan, less than half of the group's price.

Analyzing the traps: similar courses harvesting the same group of elderly people

During the investigation, the reporter also found that the live classes in the "free moxibustion clinic" groups and the live classes in the previously exposed community group buying "supermarket" groups were surprisingly similar in terms of lecturers, content, and products being promoted.

For example, many elderly people in different WeChat groups saw a teacher named Mr. Huang, who claimed to be a descendant of a royal physician, promoting so-called limited health products such as "Shuanglu dilong protein ganoderma powder," "Lu Jiao mao powder," and "Wulu ginseng concentrate paste." In 2024, an elderly person who had watched his live broadcast was puzzled: "At that time, he said the course was only 60 days precious, how many periods have passed, why hasn't he finished yet? Even the group members online are the same group of people?"

Not only the content of the live broadcasts but even the elderly people joining the groups were overlapping. The reporter found that many elderly people were active in both the "free moxibustion clinic" member group and the community group buying "supermarket" shopping group of the same community. Some elderly people said they were often pulled from one group to another, with one group selling Ganoderma spore powder today and another promoting an infrared therapy device tomorrow, "I can't remember how I got into these groups."

Behind being added to multiple groups, it reflects that the elderly people's information is repeatedly sold. An industry insider revealed that once an elderly person receives eggs from a certain offline store and watches a live broadcast, their information may be leaked to more health product salespeople. "Whether it's free moxibustion or distributing eggs, the key is to make sure that the elderly people around can repeatedly come to the offline store." The above-mentioned person admitted that once trust is established, the store can gradually progress - from cheap gifts to selling affordable daily necessities, and then to promoting high-priced health products, with profits reaching several times higher.

Reporter Cui Xi, Song Xi Illustration

title_en: DeepSeek runs fast.
body_en:
China Economic News reporter Li Kun-kun Li Zhenghao Beijing reported
Against the backdrop of the industry's anticipation of the reemergence of DeepSeek R2, DeepSeek recently only announced to the user group that "the DeepSeek-R1 model has completed a minor version upgrade." On the second day after the announcement was made, DeepSeek open-sourced DeepSeek RI (0528). Although there was no press conference, the new version of DeepSeek-R1, which reduced the model's illusion by half and performed on par with OpenAI o3 and Gemini2.5Pro, still impressed overseas developers with its evolution in mathematical and programming capabilities. The "open-source" gesture once again made the industry marvel at its status as a "true OpenAI."
Prior to this, the DeepSeek V3 model also underwent a minor version upgrade, which was also announced to the public through official communication groups without much fanfare. Some industry insiders, in an interview with China Business News, likened this "minor version upgrade" to DeepSeek quietly taking small steps forward. Financial columnist Ma Jipeng also told reporters, "If we were to compare, from different perspectives, DeepSeek is more powerful in terms of basic capabilities (compared to mainstream large models in China), but other large models in China perform better in applications and are closer to users."
Where are the updates
According to DeepSeek, DeepSeek-R1 (0528) still uses the DeepSeekV3Base model released in December 2024 as its foundation, but more computing power was invested in the post-training process, significantly enhancing the model's depth of thought and reasoning ability. The updated R1 model achieved outstanding results in various benchmark evaluations in mathematics, programming, and general logic, surpassing all domestic models and approaching other top international models in overall performance, such as the new models o3 and Gemini-2.5-Pro released by OpenAI on April 17th of this year.
On the code testing platform Live Code-Bench, DeepSeek-R1 (0528) performed comparably to OpenAI's o3 in terms of performance, scoring close to OpenAI's o3 (75.8 points) and o4-mini (80.2 points) with a score of 73.1, ranking fourth.
DeepSeek stated that compared to the old version of R1, the new model showed significant improvement in performance in complex reasoning tasks. For example, in the AIME2025 test, the accuracy of the new model increased from 70% in the old version to 87.5%. This improvement was attributed to the enhanced depth of thought during the reasoning process: in the AIME2025 test set, the old model used an average of 12K tokens per question, while the new model used an average of 23K tokens per question, indicating a more thorough and in-depth thought process in solving problems.
Additionally, DeepSeek mentioned that after distilling DeepSeek-R1 (0528), they trained the Qwen3-8BBase model, resulting in Deep-Seek-R1-0528-Qwen3-8B. This model ranked second in the AIME2024 math test, surpassing Qwen3-8B by 10.0% and being on par with Qwen3-235B. DeepSeek believes that the thought chain of DeepSeek-R1-0528 will have significant implications for research on reasoning models in academia and the development of small models in the industry.
"After DeepSeek gained popularity, Dou Bao and Kimi also made some upgrades and added reasoning functions, so at this stage, it is actually difficult to determine which one is better or worse," Ma Jipeng said. Dou Bao, a mixed-element large model, can answer questions and provide users with more accurate answers by combining their existing data. For example, the mixed-element large model combines unique data from WeChat official accounts to provide users with more comprehensive and insightful answers.
It is understood that the new version of DeepSeek R1 has been optimized for improving the model's illusions. Compared to the old version, the updated model reduced the illusion rate by 45%-50% in scenarios such as rewriting, summarizing, and reading comprehension, providing more accurate and reliable results.
In terms of creative writing, the updated R1 model, based on the old version of R1, has been further optimized for different styles of writing such as essays, novels, and prose, enabling it to output longer works with more complete structures and a writing style closer to human preferences.
Fierce competition
After DeepSeek announced the update of R1, Tencent immediately announced that products such as Tencent Yuanbao, Sogou Input Method, and QQ Browser were the first to integrate DeepSeek-R1-0528.
The latest news reveals that two representatives from OpenAI announced at the AI Summit in Mexico that the company is developing the next-generation base model GPT-5 and plans to engage in more intense competition with competitors through this model. They also explicitly stated that GPT-5 is about to be released, with some reports suggesting it may be in July of this year.
Alibaba Cloud also announced the official launch of the Tongyi Lingma AI IDE, which users can download for free from the Tongyi Lingma official website. Tongyi Lingma now has two product forms: plugins and IDE. As a native AI development environment tool, Tongyi Lingma AI IDE is deeply integrated with the latest Qwen3 large models and fully integrates the capabilities of Tongyi Lingma plugins, providing programming intelligence, inter-line suggestion prediction, inter-line conversation, and other functions.
Yang Zhilin, the founder of Kimi, mentioned at the end of last year that the development of AI is like swinging on a swing, switching between two states: "Sometimes, the algorithm and data are ready, but the computing power is insufficient, so what we need to do is increase the computing power; but today we find that continuously expanding the scale of computing power may not directly solve the problem, so we need to break through this bottleneck by changing the algorithm."
The competitive analysis report of the Chinese AIGC (Artificial Intelligence Generated Content) application market in the first quarter of 2025 released by the business intelligence data service provider Quest-Mobile shows that as of the end of February 2025, the monthly active users of native AI apps exceeded 240 million, an increase of 115 million from January, representing an 88.9% increase. The average monthly usage time and frequency of use of native AI apps in March reached 113.7 minutes and 52.4 times, respectively. The top three in terms of monthly active users of native AI apps in March changed from Dou Bao, Kimi Intelligent Assistant, and Wen Xiaoyan to Deep-Seek, Dou Bao, and Tencent Yuanbao, with user bases of 194 million, 116 million, and 42 million, respectively.
In terms of user sources, in March, Deep-Seek users came from Dou Bao, Kimi Intelligent Assistant, and Tencent Yuanbao, accounting for 22.2%, 3.8%, and 3.3%, respectively; Dou Bao users came from DeepSeek, Tencent Yuanbao, and Kimi Intelligent Assistant, accounting for 37.6%, 5.7%, and 5.6%, respectively; Tencent Yuanbao users came from DeepSeek, Dou Bao, and Kimi Intelligent Assistant, accounting for 52.3%, 32.9%, and 9.6%, respectively.
DeepSeek founder Liang Wenfeng once said, "In the long run, we hope to establish an ecosystem where the industry can directly use our technology and achievements, other companies can develop B2B/B2C services based on our models, and we focus on basic research. If the industrial chain is complete, we don't need to develop applications ourselves. Of course, if necessary, we are fully capable of doing so, but research and innovation will always be our top priority."
"Whether a large model is good or not depends on two aspects of its capabilities: one is its technical capabilities, such as reasoning and analytical abilities, but more importantly, its data capabilities," Ma Jipeng said. For DeepSeek, it should definitely still be a base for general large models, as its capabilities are currently unmatched by other large models in a short period of time, so it may continue to strengthen this advantage in the future.

title_en: 240-hour visa-free transit plus "buy now, return now" shopping in China. Foreigners flock to Shenzhen for shopping. Huaqiangbei welcomes 7,000 customers a day.
body_en:
Hong Kong Wen Wei Po News (Reporter Li Changhong Shenzhen Report) China has launched a 240-hour transit visa-free and "buy now, refund upon departure" tax refund policy, "travel in China, shop in China" has become a new choice for more and more international tourists. As the first street of electronic products in the mainland, the density of foreign tourists in Huaqiangbei, Shenzhen is increasing, and high-performance electronic products are favored. A reporter from Hong Kong Wen Wei Po recently visited Huaqiangbei and found that many tourists from the UK, France, Russia, West Asia, the Middle East, Africa, and Southeast Asia enter as tourists and can apply for tax refunds upon departure after shopping. Some tourists come with empty suitcases and return with full loads, either for personal use or as gifts for family and friends; some foreign businessmen are looking for sources of goods and purchase goods in Huaqiangbei for the long term.
Data shows that since the beginning of this year, the number of foreign tourists in Huaqiangbei has increased by more than 50% year-on-year, with over 7,000 foreign tourists coming to shop every day. According to tax refund agencies, Chinese-made mobile phones and drones have outstanding sales, accounting for nearly 40% of all tax refund applications.
African customer bargains for multilingual surveillance cameras
At a market on the fourth floor, a merchant selling surveillance equipment is testing the surveillance cameras for a tourist from Nigeria. After some bargaining, the tourist decided to purchase three surveillance cameras, one priced at 170 yuan each, saving a total of 60 yuan through bargaining. He said he would take them back to his country for personal use and recommend them to friends, and would purchase more in the future. The merchant said that this product supports multiple languages such as Chinese and English, attracting many customers from the Middle East, Europe, and Africa.
Foreigners looking for sources of goods: If it works well, they will purchase
At the corner of the elevator on the fifth floor of the market, a reporter from Hong Kong Wen Wei Po saw two young tourists from Thailand and the UK, both carrying a large 28-inch empty suitcase, purchasing camera tripods together. The British tourist, when interviewed, said that he and the Thai boss transited from Hong Kong to Shenzhen and came to Huaqiangbei for purchases, bringing a large empty suitcase for goods. "I have already made a shopping list, including lightweight selfie sticks, camera tripods, etc., the requirement is cheap and lightweight, used for live broadcasting of sports football matches. If they work well when I try them out later, I will purchase them in large quantities to sell to my peers."
The reporter from Hong Kong Wen Wei Po saw that the tourists purchased a three-meter retractable selfie stick and camera tripod totaling more than 1,000 yuan, and the Thai tourist paid with Alipay. The British tourist beside him sighed, "It's so convenient." According to Mr. Li, the owner of the store, many foreign customers come to purchase their products, including Europe, the Middle East, and Southeast Asia. Many customers enter as tourists from Hong Kong, can apply for tax refunds upon departure, which is equivalent to a 10% discount on the goods sold.
Businesses attract customers by offering free product repairs
Later, the reporter from Hong Kong Wen Wei Po saw three tourists from Zimbabwe in Africa coming to purchase toy drones, water speedboats, and other toys on the fourth floor. One of the tourists told the reporter that the three of them each purchased toys worth nearly a thousand yuan, to take back home for their children to play with. "Chinese products are very innovative, the drone toy costs 200 yuan, and the water speedboat toy is about 80 yuan, very cost-effective." The reporter saw each of them carrying a large black plastic bag, filled with various toys. An employee of the store even issued them a receipt and told customers that if the products were faulty, they could be sent back to China for free repairs. "This service is one of our ways to attract foreign tourists," the employee said.
The staff at the DJI Huaqiangbei store said that recently, many foreign customers have come to shop, including Europe, the Middle East, Indonesia, Singapore, and other places in Southeast Asia, purchasing mostly the DJI FLIP all-purpose VLOG aerial drone, priced between 2,700 yuan and 3,900 yuan, but also purchasing higher-priced drones with better shooting quality, including the DJI Mini 4PRO, with the cheapest priced at 4,300 yuan, the highest configuration at over 6,600 yuan, and the DJI AIR 3S, with the lowest price of nearly 7,000 yuan, and the highest price close to ten thousand yuan.
