title_en: Robam Electric as the sole representative of the kitchen appliance industry participating in the 5th China Home Appliance Development Summit Forum
body_en:
On March 11th, the 5th China Home Appliance Development Summit Forum was grandly held in Shanghai. As an important supporting event for the China Home Appliance Expo, this event was hosted by the authoritative institution in the home appliance industry, the China Household Electrical Appliances Association, and jointly promoted by CCTV. Entering its fifth year, the China Home Appliance Development Summit Forum focused on the most heated keywords in the home appliance industry and even the entire Chinese economy – "New Normal." As the sole representative of the kitchen appliance industry, Mr. Zhao Jihong, President of Robam Group, discussed the new normal of China's home appliance development with Mr. Fang Hongbo, Chairman of Midea Group, Mr. Lan Ye, CMO of JD.com, Mr. Sun Jingyan, Vice President of Haier Home Appliance Industry Group, and Mr. Xie Hui, Vice President of Samsung China CE Division.

The forum was themed "Embracing the New Normal and Unlocking a New Era," and engaged in heated discussions around two high-interest topics: "Channel Transformation and Product Value-Added: Which is the Breakthrough Point for Creating New Demand?" and "Home Appliance Enterprises and Internet Enterprises: Who Will Lead the Future of Smart Home Appliances?" Industry leaders such as Robam Appliances, JD.com, Midea, Haier, Skyworth, LeTV, and AVC (All View Cloud) spoke freely and shared their views, pushing the atmosphere at the venue to a climax.

"New Normal" has undoubtedly been one of the hottest buzzwords of 2014. In recent years, with the accelerated deep transformation of the home appliance industry, significant achievements in various model innovations, and rapid development in channel construction, more and more traditional home appliance companies are breaking away from traditional thinking and seeking new development models. Meanwhile, numerous internet companies have also entered the home appliance industry, bringing a zero-distance and networked approach, making innovation, intelligence, and high-end gradually become mainstream terms in the industry. Under this new normal, how to better create consumer demand has triggered a new round of reshuffling and integration for major enterprises in China's home appliance industry. In terms of brand positioning, it is necessary to achieve related diversification, resource synergy, and strengthen specialization. Mr. Fang Hongbo, Chairman and President of Midea Group, believes that any Chinese home appliance enterprise, especially in white goods, still has a certain gap with the global industry. To cultivate new competitiveness and business models, it is necessary to further integrate into the internet era, using its own innovative brand power, value capabilities, and core technological advantages to compete.

The future of smart living, building smart homes, and creating a better life are the directions for the home appliance industry's development going forward. Mr. Sun Jingyan, Vice President of Haier Home Appliance Industry Group, in his keynote speech themed "Customizing Smart Home Solutions and Creating the Best User Living Experience," stated that smart homes are facing a critical turning point from "implementation" to "popularization." Haier will form an Internet of Things between user needs and production factories through smart connectivity, from both smart homes externally and interconnected factories internally.

Kitchen appliances have always been an important part of the home appliance industry. As a leading brand in the kitchen appliance sector, Robam Appliances has always been at the forefront in terms of both brand and technology. Mr. Zhao Jihong, President of Robam Group, discussed channels and brands, believing that Robam Appliances, focusing on the kitchen appliance field, fully understands consumer needs and market changes, and therefore places greater emphasis on innovation in specialized areas. However, in the face of the development of the internet industry today, whether in the kitchen appliance sector or the entire home appliance industry, it is about shortening the distance between the internet, products, and consumers, thereby dominating the market. Therefore, thoroughly understanding consumer needs and serving them with innovative business models, providing consumers with good value and products is the most important thing.

Intelligence was ignited multiple times at the forum. Robam Appliances, a pioneer in the intelligent direction within the industry, officially launched the pre-sale of the world's first smart range hood with a powerful suction and equipped with the ROKI system on the first day of the Home Appliance Expo. Robam Appliances comprehensively showcased the ROKI intelligent cooking system to consumers, recreating the ideal smart kitchen lifestyle scenario of the internet era. This received high recognition from internet companies such as 360, Alibaba, JD.com, and Baidu present, and also demonstrated Robam Appliances' strong capabilities in the field of smart home appliances.

Smart kitchen appliances are closely related to our lives. Their development will greatly promote the informatization process of our families and provide people with a more relaxed, comfortable, efficient, and safe modern kitchen lifestyle. As an important component of the home appliance industry, it will further integrate with the internet in the near future, just like smartphones today, becoming within reach. The resulting consumer trends will become increasingly prominent. High-end, intelligent innovative products will also inject new vitality into the market, inevitably unlocking a new era.

title_en: Robam Electric: Traditional Enterprises Can Explore More New Business Models in the Internet Era
body_en:
In 2014, Robam Appliances' Double Eleven sales exceeded 124 million yuan, securing the top spot on the kitchen appliance leaderboard. Currently, e-commerce sales account for 22% of Robam Appliances' total volume, with a year-on-year growth rate of as high as 150%. High growth is expected to continue in 2015. Mobile terminal sales represent over 30% of this, growing rapidly and becoming an important battleground for future e-commerce. Jiang Lingwei, General Manager of Robam Appliances' E-commerce, stated in an interview with Entrepreneur Plus that all traditional enterprises should embrace the internet, and mobile internet is a major trend.

Drivers of Scale Growth

Three years ago, people said, "Not doing internet is waiting to die, doing internet is seeking death." Today, three years later, everyone should embrace the internet. Online and offline are now integrated and inseparable, with more and more traditional brands moving online, and online brands moving offline.

The concern that online sales are impacting offline channel dealers is no longer present. I believe the two are not in conflict, mainly because the consumer groups for online and offline are completely different. Taking kitchen appliances as an example, online buyers are between 25 and 35 years old, younger than offline buyers. Young consumers have fully adapted to and are accustomed to the online shopping lifestyle.

The internet is no longer mysterious, and all enterprises are willing to integrate online and offline, and are willing to attempt so-called O2O. Moreover, there is now a very good logic for doing internet business, with a complete ecosystem. This e-commerce ecosystem includes specialized e-commerce talent training bases, logistics and shipping bases, visual design bases, and e-commerce universities, all of which jointly support e-commerce operations. Once a traditional enterprise decides to embark on the internet path, subsequent work can be integrated. Currently, online sales are growing rapidly and have become a driver of brand sales growth.

Defender of High-End Brands

Of course, for Robam Appliances, we also bear the responsibility of operating as a high-end brand in the e-commerce channel. We have summarized a high-end brand model: one foundation, one core, and three characteristics. The foundation is the necessity to focus on one industry and conduct in-depth research. The core is high value. The three characteristics refer to continuous innovation and leadership in product technology, strengthening brand cultural value in brand connotation, and comprehensively exceeding consumer expectations in consumption experience.

As a high-end brand, we must achieve industry leadership in products, services, and technology. In the past, when buying large home appliances, we would call customer service for range hood installation. Nowadays, consumers can easily achieve this through their mobile WeChat. Each of our installers is equipped with a mobile terminal, and an installer can complete all after-sales problem recording work with a smartphone.

Through intelligent services and intelligent hardware, we are transforming the consumer service end. Previously, brands couldn't find consumers, but now we can proactively find and interact with consumers. Therefore, the core of the internet's future transformation for traditional enterprises will undoubtedly be the reengineering of internal processes, making a series of innovations centered around the consumer. This is the lifeline for future development. I believe this is what traditional enterprises must do next. Therefore, when traditional enterprises transform, in addition to considering their offline foundations, the more critical aspect is to seize the current internet dividends. This is a core point.

Explorer of New Business Models

The internet is one of the carriers of new business models. In the internet era, new business models must be continuously explored. From C2B, crowdfunding, to WeChat commerce, the emergence of new business models is constantly accelerating. We have also been making new attempts. This year, we have explored four new business models:

First, rebuilding the official shopping platform. In July of this year, we explored and established our own vertical portal website. Without any promotion, it has already achieved a certain scale of sales. We are exploring whether this model is effective, and after trying it, we believe it is a trend to follow. This is because the official website is not just a shopping platform; it is a carrier for all Robam Appliances consumers and a platform for consumer interaction. It has online customer service, an interactive platform, and an after-sales platform, where consumer questions can be answered, service needs can be met, and DIY interactions can occur, allowing us to express the functions we want to convey. Of course, this is not to compete with various platforms but to provide a final carrier for consumers, where they can find us with any issues.

We have transitioned from product lifecycle management to user lifecycle management, especially for large home appliances like ours. Because our repurchase rate is very low, unless people are buying a new home, the chance of buying a range hood is very low. The typical lifespan of a range hood is 7 years. We are considering how to maintain customer relationships after purchasing a range hood, ensuring consumers continue to love and trust our brand after the "seven-year itch."

Second, we provide value-added services beyond products. Value-added services include disposable filters, oil cups, and safety inspection services. We ensure users have no worries. In addition to warranty services, we also provide one free safety inspection and maintenance service annually, giving consumers peace of mind.

Third, the intelligent ROKI system will be launched next year. ROKI, the Robam Appliances Kitchen Intelligent System, not only has intelligent cooking navigation but also maximizes user experience through internet applications. The ROKI intelligent cooking navigation system makes cooking easier for beginners. The range hood interface can display each cooking step and link with smart stoves to automatically adjust heat and cooking time, enabling zero-basis gourmet cooking and making recipes smarter.

Fourth, mobile terminal development. The mobile terminal is very important to us. We must seize the major trend of the current internet wave and keep pace with the mobile terminal layouts of Alibaba, JD.com, and Suning. At the same time, we are also using mobile terminals to connect backend systems and interact closely with consumers. As more and more consumers shop on mobile terminals, they also communicate and connect with brands on mobile terminals. Therefore, we are doing more front-end and back-end matching on mobile terminals.

First, we are conducting personalized design and development for mobile terminals, considering the small screen size and consumer reading habits.

Second, we are building a WeChat mall, allowing consumers to have their own entry point on the mobile terminal and access it anytime. We are also leveraging many platforms and apps for our official shopping website.

Third, we are connecting the backend systems of the mobile terminal. We have many WeChat and Weibo service functions, and we may try developing an app in the future.

During this year's Double Eleven, we innovated on multiple levels and promoted brand influence through event marketing. Before Double Eleven, we launched a "Stormy Chef" event marketing campaign, which was very effective. It was the only kitchen appliance brand to win a silver award at the China E-commerce Marketing Award - the Golden Peanut Award, and also received the Best Internet Experience Award from Analysys International.

New Channel for Consumer Interaction

Robam Appliances was among the first home appliance brands to venture into e-commerce in 2008. At that time, traditional brands were offline, and the internet was online. Today, deeply influenced by the internet, Robam Appliances has undergone tremendous changes from the backend to the frontend. In the past, when we developed a product, we would decide to make it and then ask consumers to buy it! Now, when we develop products, the first question we ask is: Do consumers think the same way? Do they want to use such a product? Current product development is consumer-centric, which is a significant change brought about by internet thinking. The key for traditional enterprises to engage in the internet is: they must clearly see that the internet is not just a sales channel, but also a disruptor that influences internal management and processes. Our biggest challenge now is how to interact with consumers through the internet.

Consumers are no longer just concerned with sales; they are more concerned with the benefits that kitchen appliances can bring them. Therefore, targeting young women, we launched the "Stormy Chef" event. Young women want to cook a sumptuous dinner for their families on weekends but are particularly resistant to oily fumes. In the "Stormy Chef" event, we told consumers that our range hoods can avoid these problems. Robam Appliances can help many women and office workers enjoy the pleasure of cooking.

At the same time, we are also the only user to do a Showcase on Alibaba Mama. We set up a reception at the Robam Appliances flagship store and launched an interactive mini-game. Over 200,000 people participated in half a month, with very good results. After the event, we firmly occupied the top position in the Taobao Index. "Stormy Chef" and "Showcase" have been very helpful for our brand communication because they are both close to consumers.

As a leading brand in the kitchen appliance industry, Robam Appliances has consistently focused on high-end products for 36 years, achieving 17 years of sales leadership. Robam Appliances has achieved comprehensive leadership in both online and offline channels. This is precisely due to Robam Appliances' adherence to the "product differentiation, brand high-end, channel diversification" strategy.

title_en: Robam Appliances once again selected for Asia's Top 500 Brands, exclusively honored for the industry for 9 consecutive years.
body_en:
On September 24th, at the 2014 "World Executive Summit," the "Asia's Top 500 Brands" ranking was grandly unveiled in Hong Kong. Robam Appliances, due to its outstanding market leadership, product innovation capabilities, excellent performance growth, and its original high-end brand model, was once again selected as one of "Asia's Top 500 Brands" by the World Brand Laboratory, led by Robert Mondavi. This makes Robam the only enterprise in China's kitchen appliance industry to be consecutively shortlisted for nine years.

Distinguished experts and scholars from around the world, including Professor Ziv Carmon, a senior professor at INSEAD (European Institute of Business Administration) and a master of marketing, and Professor Ravi Dhar, a senior professor at the Yale School of Management and director of the Yale Consumer Monitoring Center, delivered insightful speeches at the summit. In addition to Robam Appliances, other leading Asian brands such as Alibaba, Lenovo, Toshiba, and Panasonic were also listed.

It is understood that the evaluation system for "Asia's Top 500 Brands" comprehensively assesses and scores strong Asian enterprises based on four major dimensions: market performance, development potential, quality level, and operational efficiency. After rigorous evaluation, Robam Appliances received recognition from the Asian Brand Assessment System (ABAS) expert committee in areas such as brand age, internationalization level, marketing mix, brand awareness, total asset growth rate, innovation capability, after-sales service, quality, operating revenue, and net profit, ultimately ranking on the list for nine consecutive years.

Robam Appliances Tops Top 500 for Nine Consecutive Years, Remaining the Industry's Only One

As a leading brand in China's kitchen appliance industry, Robam Appliances has focused on the high-end market for 35 years, achieving 16 years of leading sales and firmly holding the top position in the industry. This has become the most important factor for Robam's consecutive nine-year inclusion in "Asia's Top 500 Brands."

According to data from Zhongyikang, a reputable third-party research institution in China, from January to August this year, the overall retail volume of the range hood market saw a year-on-year cumulative decrease of 1.13%, while the retail sales saw a year-on-year cumulative increase of 10.09%. In contrast, the sales of Robam Appliances' high-suction range hoods showed exceptional growth, increasing by 9.28% against the trend, with a year-on-year cumulative retail sales increase of 22.57%, far exceeding the industry average. The data also indicates that in the first eight months of this year, both the retail volume and sales of non-high-suction range hoods experienced negative growth to varying degrees, while the retail volume and sales of high-suction range hoods grew by 35.21% and 47.16% respectively, fully demonstrating the dominant position of high suction in the market.

At the summit, Zhang Xuan, Brand Director of Robam Appliances, spoke on behalf of the award-winning companies, explaining Robam Appliances' high-end brand model to the guests. The attendees expressed their affirmation and praise for Robam Appliances' original high-end brand model.

Robam Appliances' High-End Brand Model Receives International Recognition, Highlighting Its Leading Position

At the summit, Professor Ravi Dhar of the Yale School of Management witnessed Robam Appliances' growth, transformation, and brilliant achievements. The organizing committee of "Asia's Top 500 Brands" also stated that over the years, Robam Appliances has consistently maintained a high-end brand positioning in its market competition with foreign brands and comprehensive home appliance brands, successfully defending its market leadership and achieving nine consecutive years of inclusion, creating a brand miracle.

Professor Ravi Dhar and Professor Ziv Carmon Jointly Endorse Robam Appliances' High-End Brand Model

Looking at the Top 500 rankings over the years, many of the included foreign brands are industry leaders, occupying significant market share and holding industry influence. Robam Appliances, as the only brand in China's kitchen appliance industry to be included in "Asia's Top 500 Brands" for nine years, not only reflects the international community's affirmation of Robam's industry leadership but also its recognition of Robam's "high-end brand model."

Through 35 years of exploration and innovation, Robam Appliances has built an R&D team with the highest technical level, strongest innovation capabilities, and fastest market response speed in the industry. It has also pioneered a high-end business model consisting of "one foundation, one core, and three characteristics": the foundation is to focus on one industry and conduct in-depth research; the core is high value; and the three characteristics are continuous innovation and leadership in product technology, enhancement of brand cultural value in brand connotation, and exceeding consumer expectations in consumer experience. The high-quality team and unique business model have made Robam Appliances' path to a high-end brand increasingly stable.

Currently, Robam Appliances, with its high-end brand model, has gained recognition from the world's top three brand valuation institutions: "Asia's Top 500 Brands" by World Brand Lab; the Outstanding Brand Building Case Award selected by Interbrand; and "Top 100 Most Valuable Chinese Brands" by BrandZ. While the high-end brand model has garnered international recognition, it has also become a model for many foreign companies to learn from. Robam Appliances was also named one of the "2014 China TOP 100 Best Employers." This award was jointly organized by the world-leading management magazine "World Executive" in collaboration with World HR Lab, "World Entrepreneur" magazine, and "President" magazine.

In the future, Robam Appliances will continue to adhere to the concept of "Exquisite Technology, Easy Cooking," deeply understand consumer needs, lead industry development with innovation and technology, and enable more families to enjoy the convenience of cooking brought by technology.

title_en: Suning, Gome, Tmall, and JD.com: Four Major Platforms Join Forces to Jointly Promote Robam's High-Suction Range Hoods
body_en:
Not long ago, Zhejiang Gome and Robam Appliances (Zhejiang region) jointly held a super sales event themed "Private Kitchen Fun, Noble Enjoyment." Robam's high-suction range hoods, gas stoves, disinfection cabinets, and other high-end kitchen appliances set off the first wave of purchase storms in Zhejiang province in 2014. It is understood that this is an innovative marketing activity where Robam Appliances (Zhejiang region) and Zhejiang Gome joined forces to jointly promote high-suction range hoods.

And during the Spring Festival, a Suning advertisement warmed many people. The slogan, "You inhale more than this every day, let's get a new one!" resonated with many people's hearts and inspired many consumers to consider replacing their range hoods with high-suction models for their loved ones.

In addition, JD.com, a leading comprehensive online retailer in China, also reached a strategic partnership with Robam Appliances at the end of 2013. JD.com will leverage its own resources and platform advantages to engage in deeper, all-round brand cooperation with Robam Appliances in 2014, while vigorously promoting high-suction range hoods.

In the kitchen appliance sales section of Tmall Mall, Robam Appliances, after dominating sales on Double Eleven, once again took the lead in sales in the kitchen appliance industry on Tmall Mall in 2013. Through the promotion of high-suction range hoods, Tmall Mall and Robam Appliances have brought a distinctive high-end consumption experience to consumers, leading to the sustained popularity of high-suction range hoods in the online market.

Gome, Suning, Tmall, and JD.com, the four major home appliance sales platforms, are all working together to jointly promote Robam's high-suction range hoods. On the one hand, this indicates that the range hood industry has entered the era of high suction, with high suction becoming the main battlefield for kitchen appliance brands to compete. On the other hand, it also demonstrates the recognition of Robam's high-suction range hoods by major platforms.

Industry Giants Flock In, High Suction Becomes the Main Battlefield

Reporters visited several Gome and Suning stores in Beijing, and browsed the kitchen appliance sections of Gome Online, Suning.com, Tmall Mall, and JD.com. It was found that high-suction range hoods are selling briskly both online and offline. A relevant person in charge of Gome told reporters, "Robam's high-suction range hoods are very popular with consumers and have always maintained sales leadership. In addition, Siemens and Haier's high-suction range hoods are also selling well. Currently, the entire range hood market is leaning towards high suction."

It is understood that Robam Appliances launched its first high-suction range hood, model 8210, as early as 2008, creating a "high suction" trend in the market. Subsequently, Robam Appliances successively launched several other high-suction range hoods, such as models 8216 and 8212, and they quickly climbed the industry's best-selling range hood rankings. In 2013, Robam's 8218 high-suction range hood was launched, redefining the industry standards for "high-suction range hoods" in terms of "collection, strong filtration, rapid exhaust, and energy saving," providing consumers with new standards for purchasing high-suction range hoods.

title_en: New Marketing Play for Youthful Kitchen Appliances: Check Out Robam Appliances' "Full-Screen Range Hood" Black Technology
body_en:
When we talk about "full screen," what comes to mind? vivo? OPPO? Or iPhone?
In the parlance of the tech industry, full screen refers to a smartphone design with an ultra-high screen-to-body ratio. Since the iPhone X debuted in 2017, the smartphone industry has been swept by a frenzy for the "full screen" concept, with "screen-to-body ratio" and "screen size" becoming important selling points pursued by major smartphone manufacturers and consumers. To date, 6.4 inches is the largest full screen on a smartphone, and the limit for smartphone screen-to-body ratio is 93.8%.

Recently, the tech community has been discussing the topics of #FullScreenGoneWild and #40InchFullScreen, which have sparked heated debate among netizens, with the Weibo topic reaching a popularity of 200,000. Even more astonishing is that the initiator of this topic is none other than Robam, a home appliance brand.

"40-inch full screen," "100% screen-to-body ratio," and "Robam" – these keywords alone can ignite one's imagination. Many are wondering what Robam has done this time. Have they ventured into the smartphone industry? Is it a breakthrough technology? Or something else entirely?

"The one who tied the bell to the tiger must untie it." Robam has finally unraveled this series of questions by launching its first full-screen range hood, the 27X6, once again igniting discussions in the industry.

Robam's new range hood has become a sensation even before its official launch. One must admit that Robam has executed this marketing campaign brilliantly, earning admiration from both the tech and home appliance circles. So, what exactly did Robam do in this successful marketing campaign?

Collaboration: Matching optimal marketing resources to maintain new product exposure
When launching a new product, some companies are too eager to get it to market and pay little attention to marketing, which is a taboo in new product marketing.
What marketing goals to set, what channels and strategies to use, and where to connect and interact with the target consumer group are all questions that businesses need to consider when launching a new product. In terms of the promotion path for new products, Robam's full-screen range hood has done an excellent job.

Step 1: Collaborated with GeekPark to create a suspenseful concept of "40-inch full screen" through posters and by pushing Weibo trending topics.
GeekPark is China's largest community for innovators, characterized by its focus on internet products and technology trends, gathering China's top internet entrepreneurs and product professionals, and serving as a platform for geeks to learn and interact. This step accurately conveyed the new concept of "40-inch full screen" to the target audience, shaping the product's technological image and attracting the attention of the tech community.
(GeekPark Communication)

Step 2: Bombarded various media outlets in the industry with a large number of PR articles to ensure consumers could browse and search for relevant information, thereby increasing consumer attention.

Step 3: Created a Weibo topic to interact with consumers, officially answering their questions, and inviting influential Weibo users to participate in the interaction to amplify the buzz and build anticipation for the new product launch.

Step 4: The full-screen new product was exhibited and pre-sold at the Tmall flagship store. During the new product promotion period, through coupons, price protection, video sharing, and gifts, consumers were able to experience the product firsthand, fostering a positive market reputation.

Step 5: Collected customer feedback for product improvement and service enhancement. Robam's after-sales service has always had a good reputation in the industry. Building on this, it is easier to obtain, analyze, and address issues from consumers during the new product promotion phase.

This series of marketing plans encompasses the pre-launch, mid-launch, and post-launch phases, ensuring new product exposure while enabling the product to quickly gain market recognition and win over consumers.

Innovation: Thinking what others dare not, doing what others cannot
In this internet era, technological iteration in products is rapid. To make a product stand out and gain a competitive edge in the market, the most fundamental approach is a company's own creativity.

Many companies promote innovation, but few truly understand it because the cost of innovation is too high, thus, truly innovative companies are rare. Innovation in the market relies on two forms of technology: first, product technological innovation; and second, understanding unmet user needs and providing solutions. Both are forms of innovation.

Taking Robam's full-screen range hood as an example, the combination of "full screen" and "range hood" has no precedent in the home appliance industry, and no company would even consider linking the two. In other words, it sounds like an "absurd" idea.

From the perspective of technological innovation, to be fair, Robam has always been one of the top experts in the home appliance industry, and its range hood update speed is unparalleled. Unlike before, the newly released full-screen range hood utilizes new full-screen technology to enhance the consumer "experience," allowing consumers to feel the technological experience brought by the full screen through operation, ushering in a new era of full-screen range hoods. This seemingly absurd idea has become a reality, making Robam the "first person to eat crab" in the home appliance industry.

From the consumer's perspective, both in terms of consumption concepts and purchasing power, the post-80s and post-90s generation are the absolute main consumer groups.
Like humans, brands have their own life cycles, going through birth-growth-maturity-aging. To capture the core consumer group of the era, "brand youthfulness" has become the most discussed topic among many brands. Every company talks about brand youthfulness, but only those that truly think from the perspective of young people can win consumer recognition.

Robam has been established for 39 years, making it a "veteran" in the home appliance industry. Through this new product marketing event, it is evident that Robam's brand youthfulness strategy has been very successful. By matching a kitchen appliance like a "range hood," which has a low presence in the eyes of young people, with the cutting-edge technology that young people are interested in, this approach has deeply resonated with young consumers. Robam's full-screen range hood is undoubtedly a classic case of "counter-attack product design" in marketing.

Full-Screen Range Hood: The Inevitable Victory of a "Blockbuster" Product
"Talk is cheap, action speaks louder than words." Good promotional ideas must exist within the context of consumers' real lives. The closer it is to consumers' real lives, the greater its communicability and topic potential. The creation of "blockbuster" home appliances is inseparable from consumers' cooking experience.

Robam is targeting the post-80s and post-90s generations who grew up with the internet. "Pursuit of novelty, admiration for brands, emphasis on individuality, and attention to emotion and intuition" are the distinct characteristics of this group's consumer psychology and behavior.

Currently, high-definition large screens on range hoods on the market are generally within 10 inches, and the screen is on the same plane as the fan. For young consumers, these range hood products are simply "not cool." Robam's 27X6 range hood breaks tradition by innovating with a 40-inch full screen and a 100% screen-to-body ratio. In actual operation, through infrared sensing, the full screen automatically rises and falls without buttons, is oil-resistant, and offers gesture control, making it more novel.

In addition to the full-screen technology, this range hood also features an infrared sensing function. Consumers can wave their hand towards the center of the full screen display, and upon approach, it will turn on. A second wave instantly activates the "stir-fry" mode, and a third wave turns it off. The entire process does not require touching the panel, thus humanely preventing oil stains from soiling the range hood.

"Appearance" is an important factor for young people when choosing a product. The Robam 27X6 range hood features an all-black mirror surface, exuding minimalist European aesthetics, sophisticated and elegant yet trendy, perfectly matching various Chinese kitchen styles and delivering a strong visual impact with a modern artistic sense, which is sure to resonate with the "new middle class."

The Robam 27X6 range hood perfectly integrates modern elements such as life aesthetics, leading technology, and trendy fashion, upgrading intelligent technology to an unprecedented level. With its distinctive product features, it wins the favor of young consumers, and it is believed that this range hood will lead the range hood industry into a new era of full screens.

From Robam, we can see that to create a "blockbuster" product, the essence of its marketing lies in: first, actively embracing internet technology and boldly experimenting with rich and diverse marketing and promotional expressions to enhance affinity, evoke customer resonance, and achieve organic dissemination; second, adhering to a customer-centric approach, starting from consumer needs to create products that are most suitable for Chinese consumers to use, allowing consumers to enjoy the pleasure of cooking; third, constantly maintaining corporate innovation, which is key to sustaining corporate vitality and achieving brand youthfulness. In this process, companies must observe everything about young people, discover what they like, what they talk about, what their habits are, and what their troubles are... only then can they infuse fresh vitality into the brand and restore the brand's "youth."

title_en: "People's Daily" Reports on Robam Again, Central Range Hood Receives Attention
body_en:
Chinese cuisine is renowned for its profound and extensive culture, but the issue of kitchen grease fumes is also particularly prominent. For a long time, kitchen fume extraction has faced three major persistent problems: inefficient extraction, backflow of fumes, and odor permeation. Simultaneously, the direct external discharge of residents' kitchen grease fumes without treatment further pollutes the air. After extensive research into fume issues and extraction technologies, the high-end kitchen appliance brand Robam Appliances invented a product that can revolutionarily solve these problems – the Central Range Hood. This year, Robam Appliances has fully pushed this product onto the market, gaining attention from national-level media such as *People's Daily* and CCTV.

On May 3rd, *People's Daily* published a comprehensive report titled "Robam Appliances' Central Range Hood Favored by the Market, Whole Building Installation of Main Unit, No Noise in the Kitchen." The report stated that the product "transformed a household range hood product into a solution related to urban air purification."

(Robam Appliances Central Range Hood)

The product has been installed in multiple branded real estate enterprises.

According to *People's Daily*, a high-end residential complex in Hangzhou had persistently prominent issues with fume backflow and odor permeation in its kitchens, leading to significant complaints from residents. Despite various attempts such as installing additional fans on the rooftop to assist with fume extraction and purchasing well-known international brands of range hoods, the results remained unsatisfactory. Robam Appliances undertook this renovation project. After an actual site survey, they discovered that the root cause of the problem lay in excessively long fume pipes, severe leakage in the exhaust ducts, and a non-return valve for fume backflow that had become ineffective due to years of use.

They provided a specific solution using the Central Range Hood, installing the main unit on the rooftop and an intelligent power distribution valve at the fume duct outlet of each kitchen. This resulted in an over 45% increase in the exhaust efficiency of the entire building and a more than 59% increase in airflow.

From the birth of the first distributed Central Range Hood in 2014 to the appearance of the centralized Central Range Hood in 2016, the iterated and upgraded Central Range Hood has comprehensively solved the challenges of kitchen grease fumes.

To enhance extraction efficiency, the Central Range Hood treats the fume extraction power unit and exhaust duct as an entire extraction system, employing intelligent variable frequency IoT technology, intelligent power distribution technology, and intelligent cloud platform technology developed in collaboration with Alibaba Group to address the issue of fume extraction. To reduce the pollution of air by grease fumes, the Central Range Hood is designed with a centralized fume purification and treatment stage. All grease fumes from the entire building must undergo purification and treatment by the main unit before being uniformly discharged outside the building.

(Diagram of the Central Range Hood)

Testing has shown that the Central Range Hood can improve fume extraction efficiency on lower floors by over 40%, effectively resolving fume backflow and odor permeation. Its composite fume purification rate reaches as high as 99.5%, and operating noise is reduced by 10 decibels.

Even before gaining attention from national media, the Central Range Hood, in collaboration with Shou Chuang Properties in 2015, was selected for the Beijing Municipal Science and Technology Commission's "Capital Blue Sky Action" project. Subsequently, the Beijing Municipal Commission of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, the Beijing Municipal Development and Reform Commission, and the Beijing Municipal Science and Technology Commission successively issued consultative documents regarding the promotion of Robam Appliances' Central Range Hood in Beijing. Currently, Robam Appliances' Central Range Hood has been introduced to over 20 cities in China and has established strategic partnerships with numerous branded real estate enterprises such as Vanke, Country Garden, Sunac, Greentown, Lanhai, and Binjiang, and has been implemented in over 30 residential projects.

Central media has praised national enterprises multiple times.

2017 marked the third consecutive year that Robam Appliances' range hoods achieved the global sales championship. In January of this year, *People's Daily*, under the title "National Kitchen Appliances Enter Global Kitchens," reported on Robam Appliances' achievements and strategic layout in the global kitchen appliance market. CCTV also awarded Robam Appliances the title of "CCTV Global Leading National Brand." On May 10th, "China Brand Day," Robam Appliances was also invited to appear on CCTV's prime-time program "Great Nation Brands."

(Robam Appliances awarded the title of "CCTV Global Leading National Brand")

The Central Range Hood represents another self-disruption by Robam Appliances in the field of kitchen appliances. Liu Buchen, a seasoned analyst in the home appliance industry, believes that the advent of the Central Range Hood is a mark of range hoods transitioning from the "era of traditional range hoods" to the "era of clean range hoods" / "era of central range hoods." He states, "The emergence and promotion of the Central Range Hood are of great significance to Robam Appliances, not only further defending its dominant position in the range hood field but also opening up an entirely new product category, representing an incremental market for Robam Appliances."

Through 39 years of innovation and development, Robam Appliances has become a representative of high-end Chinese kitchen appliance brands and has firmly occupied a core position among high-end brands in the global kitchen appliance market. Since the beginning of this year, Robam Appliances has proposed to base its operations on technological innovation, combining in-depth insights into traditional Chinese culinary culture and contemporary Chinese life, and manufacturing high-end kitchen appliance products with users at the center to create new Chinese kitchens. The favor shown by Chinese users towards the Central Range Hood marks a solid step towards creating new Chinese kitchens.

title_en: Heavy exposure! The Taiwan authorities' "cyber army" once attempted to steal information about our military exercise plans.
body_en:
Original title: Heavy exposure! Taiwan authorities' "Information and Electronic Warfare" once attempted to steal intelligence on our military exercise plans
On the 5th, the National Computer Virus Emergency Response Center and other departments released a latest report showing that, against the background of the PLA Eastern Theater Command's implementation of the "Joint Sword" series of exercises, hacker organizations supported by the Taiwan Democratic Progressive Party's "Information and Electronic Warfare" specifically targeted maritime-related units in our coastal areas with phishing email attacks, attempting to steal maritime-related intelligence to predict the PLA's exercise action plans.
On the 5th, the National Computer Virus Emergency Response Center, the National Engineering Laboratory for Computer Virus Prevention and Control Technology, and 360 Security Group jointly released the "David and Goliath - Investigation Report on the Network Attack Activities of the Taiwan Democratic Progressive Party's 'Information and Electronic Warfare' Hacker Organization," which deeply exposed the historical background, organizational structure, personnel composition, work locations, work tasks, and insider information on network attack cases of the Taiwan Democratic Progressive Party's "Information and Electronic Warfare."
The report revealed that the Taiwan "Information and Electronic Warfare," formally known as the "Ministry of National Defense Information and Electronic Warfare Command," is a "fourth branch" created with the support of the US military after Tsai Ing-wen took office. Its predecessor belonged to the Taiwan authorities' "Ministry of National Defense Tiger Team" network force, responsible for coordinating the Taiwan authorities, the Taiwan military, and civilian network technology forces, specifically conducting network attacks and penetration against the mainland and Hong Kong and Macao regions, massively stealing sensitive data and important intelligence information, coordinating with anti-China forces in the US to conduct public opinion and cognitive warfare against us, secretly plotting "color revolutions," attempting to disrupt our social order, create ethnic divisions, amplify social contradictions, and obstruct national reunification, being referred to as the "most mysterious force in Taiwan." The "Information and Electronic Warfare" is divided into four internal institutions: Information and Communication Department, Network Operations Department, Electronic Warfare Department, and Logistics Department, as well as a training and testing center with a training nature. Its technical strength is mainly concentrated in the Information and Communication Department's Information and Communication Brigade, the Network Operations Department's Network Warfare Brigade, and the Electronic Warfare Department's Electronic Warfare Center.
The report also exposed five hacker organizations supported by the Taiwan Democratic Progressive Party and commanded by the Taiwan authorities' "Information and Electronic Warfare" forces: APT-C-01 (Toxic Cloud Vine), APT-C-62 (Tricolor Violet), APT-C-64 (Anonymous 64), APT-C-65 (Golden Leaf Ivy), and APT-C-67 (Ursula). These hacker organizations have systematically and plannedly conducted numerous large-scale network attacks on key departments and areas such as national defense military industry, aerospace, government departments, energy transportation, maritime affairs, scientific research and technology enterprises in the mainland and Hong Kong and Macao regions, attempting to bypass target system security measures, obtain internal network control permissions, steal sensitive data and important intelligence information, disrupt normal business operations of enterprises, with extremely malicious nature.
Among them, APT-C-67 (Ursula) is the hacker organization that was previously officially reported to have attacked a technology company in Guangzhou. On May 20th, the Tianhe District Branch of the Guangzhou Public Security Bureau issued a "Police Report" stating that a technology company in Guangzhou was attacked by overseas hackers, and the public security organs immediately launched an investigation, extracted relevant attack program samples, comprehensively fixed relevant evidence, and organized a professional technical team to conduct technical tracing. On May 27th, the Tianhe District Branch issued another "Police Report" stating that the investigation into the network attack on a technology company in Guangzhou by overseas hackers had made important progress: the network attack suffered by the company was carried out by a hacker organization related to the Taiwan Democratic Progressive Party authorities.
The report stated that APT-C-67 (Ursula) bypassed the victim company's network protection devices, illegally entered the backend system of autonomous devices, and controlled multiple internal network devices of the company through lateral movement penetration, further uploading multiple malicious attack programs to the backend systems of these devices, causing the company's official website and some business systems to be affected, with network services interrupted for several hours, causing disruption to the company's normal production and operation.
According to sources, the activities of APT-C-67 (Ursula) have been active for a long time. Compared with other organizations, this organization's attack targets are relatively scattered. They often use public network asset mapping platforms or batch network address scanning to detect network addresses of known vulnerabilities in network security systems, network cameras, and other Internet of Things systems exposed on the public Internet in our territory, and use vulnerabilities to gain control of monitoring system backends, further deploying remote control tools or Trojans, obtaining database information, infiltrating internal networks of relevant units, and ultimately gaining full control and data access permissions of security systems, using real-time video and historical video information of security systems to collect intelligence on target areas.
The report also disclosed the characteristics of four other hacker organizations and specific cases of network attacks against us. In 2024, the Taiwan authorities colluded with external forces to continuously provoke "independence," seriously endangering cross-strait relations and peace and stability in the Taiwan Strait. Starting in May 2024, the PLA Eastern Theater Command conducted multiple "Joint Sword" series of exercises around Taiwan Province, punishing the "Taiwan independence" separatist forces and issuing a severe warning to external forces interfering and provoking. Against this background, APT-C-01 further extended its attack targets to the maritime field and specifically targeted maritime-related units in our coastal areas with phishing email attacks, attempting to predict our Navy's exercise action plans by stealing maritime-related intelligence.
In addition, in the first half of 2024, the US State Department approved the sale of weapons worth over 600 million US dollars to Taiwan, including 720 sets of Spring Knife 300 cruise missiles, 100 sets of ALTIUS600M-V cruise missiles, and other advanced offensive weapons, and held the "Taiwan-US Defense Industry Forum" in Taiwan in June 2024. During the same period, the APT-C-62 organization timely strengthened its network penetration attacks on key information infrastructure such as national defense military industry, transportation, energy infrastructure, in response to the "US aid," attempting to sell sensitive intelligence information related to our national defense, military, and energy reserves to the US.
During the 19th Hangzhou Asian Games in September 2023, the APT-C-64 organization remained active, repeatedly using web system vulnerabilities to penetrate attacks on mainland China and Hong Kong and Macao units' portal websites, outdoor electronic screens, network TVs, etc., attempting to manipulate social opinions by gaining control and posting illegal content after obtaining control permissions, disrupting social order.
The report stated that the activities of the APT-C-65 organization have a very clear pattern, closely related to the so-called "foreign affairs activities" of the Taiwan authorities' leaders. The APT-C-65 organization conducted intensive attack and espionage activities against key information infrastructure units in the fields of national defense military industry, government agencies, energy, transportation, scientific research, and education in our country, especially in the aerospace, ports, maritime, and other related scientific research, production, and management units, during the visits of then-US House Speaker Nancy Pelosi to China's Taiwan Province in August 2022 and then-Taiwan Province Democratic Progressive Party representative Lai Ching-te's visit to the US in August 2023 under the guise of "transit," aiming to make "tributes" during the Taiwan authorities' close contact with anti-China forces abroad.
The report stated that although the Taiwan APT organizations have their own characteristics in terms of attack targets, tactics, and activity cycles, there is a clear coordination and consistency in their attack intentions, purposes, and the frequent "Taiwan independence" and treasonous actions taken by the Taiwan Province Democratic Progressive Party authorities, fully exposing the ugly face of the Taiwan Province Democratic Progressive Party authorities' attempt to "rely on foreign support" for political gain, at the expense of national and ethnic interests.
According to sources, the Taiwan Democratic Progressive Party authorities have long colluded with the US National Security Agency (NSA), the Central Intelligence Agency (CIA), and other intelligence agencies, relying on the "Information and Electronic Warfare" to carry out network attack and sabotage activities against the mainland and Hong Kong and Macao regions, in coordination with the US "Indo-Pacific strategy," acting as a "running dog" for the US, attempting to "rely on the US for independence." The US intelligence agencies have long provided personnel training and technical equipment support to the Taiwan "Information and Electronic Warfare," repeatedly sending so-called "hunting" teams to Taiwan (under separate investigation) to conduct network attacks against us. For example, the wanted individuals such as Shen Yuxuan, who went to the US for training in July 2018, have repeatedly participated in network attacks against the mainland and Hong Kong and Macao regions, and specifically carried out network attacks against the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of China in the summer of 2019, committing numerous crimes.
Nevertheless, the network attack methods of the Taiwan "Information and Electronic Warfare" are clearly "unskilled." Du Zhenhua, a senior engineer at the National Computer Virus Emergency Response Center, told the Global Times reporter that the reason the report is called "David and Goliath" is to mock the arrogance of the Taiwan authorities, "David and Goliath, ridiculous arrogance." Du Zhenhua stated that when the Taiwan "Information and Electronic Warfare" conducts network attacks, it exposes a large amount of attack source information, making it not difficult to trace and track, providing favorable conditions for us to quickly identify the attackers. In addition, the methods of the Taiwan "Information and Electronic Warfare" are despicable and dirty. When they cannot penetrate the target system or obtain valuable data from the network platform, they often become impatient and maliciously disrupt the target system, delete system and user data, maliciously tamper with data or add false information, format system storage devices, severely disrupting normal business operations of enterprises.
In response, Zhou Hongyi, founder of 360 Group, stated that the technical level of the network attack personnel of the Taiwan "Information and Electronic Warfare" is generally low, the attack methods are simple and crude, and there is not much concealment, belonging to a third-rate level. Xiao Xinguang, founder of Ant Group, stated that the network attack personnel of the Taiwan "Information and Electronic Warfare" mostly use open-source tools, rarely using "zero-day" vulnerabilities, which to some extent indicates that they lack the ability to develop their own tools and related technical reserves.

title_en: Concept stocks clarify the industry heat without concealing it, and unmanned logistics vehicles enter the commercial "fast lane".
body_en:
Recently, the concept of "unmanned logistics vehicles" has caused a stir in the capital market.
On May 27, Jiu Shi Intelligent officially launched the new E series unmanned logistics vehicle platform and the first model E6, priced at 19,800 yuan. Yu Enyuan, founder and CEO of Xinshiqi unmanned vehicle, also revealed in public recently that the development speed of unmanned delivery vehicles in the industry this year is ten times that of last year. These signals have ignited market enthusiasm.
On June 3, Deppon Logistics (603056.SH) hit the limit up again, with the latest price at 22.88 yuan/share, achieving 5 consecutive boards. In addition, Xin Ning Logistics (300013.SZ), Tongda Electric (603390.SH), Bao Shui Technology (600794.SH), and other logistics sector stocks have shown active performance.
Image source: Xinhua News Agency
However, beneath the revelry lies the embarrassing "wrong payment". Many companies whose stock prices have soared have quickly clarified that they have no actual connection with "unmanned logistics vehicles".
In response to the announcement of the "5 consecutive boards", Deppon Logistics stated that the company's stock price had risen by 72.16% from May 26, 2025 to June 3, with a turnover rate of 24.27%, both far exceeding the industry average for the same period.
It also clarified that the company has not yet actually applied unmanned driving logistics vehicles.
On May 29, Tongda Electric issued an announcement that the closing price of the company's stock had deviated by more than 20% for two consecutive trading days, which was considered abnormal stock trading volatility. The company noted that recent market information had linked the company to the concept of "unmanned logistics vehicles" and "unmanned driving", but after verification, the company currently has no business income from "unmanned logistics vehicles" or "unmanned driving" products.
Wan Tong Technology (002331.SZ) also stated on the investor interaction platform that the company's products currently do not involve unmanned logistics vehicles.
On the 4th, the A-share logistics sector opened with a downward trend. Deppon Logistics fell by more than 5%, Xin Ning Logistics fell by more than 4%, Sanyangma (001317.SZ), Huaguangyuanhai (872351.BJ), Bao Shui Technology, and Changjiang Investment (600119.SH) all followed suit.
This wave of speculative concepts deviates significantly from the company's fundamentals and actual business operations, highlighting short-term speculative market sentiment. However, behind the noise, an undeniable fact is that the real demand for unmanned logistics vehicles is growing, and the huge market enthusiasm is not unfounded.
Yu Enyuan, founder and CEO of Xinshiqi unmanned vehicle, recently revealed in public that the development speed of the unmanned delivery vehicle industry this year is ten times that of last year, with Xinshiqi delivering over 1,000 vehicles per month, and it is expected that the monthly delivery volume from the second quarter to the third quarter will exceed 2,000 vehicles, with the April monthly delivery volume already surpassing the total for the entire year of 2024.
"Since the New Year, we have received unmanned vehicle procurement demands from more than 40 counties nationwide, with over half coming from express delivery outlets at the county and township levels," a person in charge of Cainiao unmanned vehicles previously told reporters. Currently, Cainiao is also innovating delivery models to increase the delivery speed of unmanned vehicles through remote delivery and other methods, accelerating the application of unmanned vehicles in rural areas.
In fact, the core driving force behind the surge in demand for unmanned logistics vehicles is the significant reduction in costs and increased efficiency. Taking Jiu Shi Intelligent E6 as an example, the comprehensive cost of the entire vehicle plus FSD subscription is actually lower than that of traditional trucks and driver wages.
Huatai Securities' research report believes that three factors, including the cost, technology, and downstream demand for cost reduction, are promoting the commercialization of unmanned logistics vehicles in the market.
With upstream suppliers in the passenger car intelligent driving industry gradually achieving economies of scale in the past two years, the rapid decline in core components costs such as lidar, chips, and batteries has brought the manufacturing cost of unmanned logistics vehicles down to the tens of thousands of yuan level. In terms of technology, currently, with the rapid application of end-to-end large models in the intelligent driving field, many manufacturers have overcome the limitations of high-precision maps, reducing the time and cost required for road collection, allowing unmanned logistics vehicles to be quickly delivered and operate without fixed road operation restrictions, facilitating scheduling management and improving efficiency.
In fact, the logistics industry has always been a delicate balance between costs and ticket prices, and the downstream demand for cost reduction remains the catalyst for the unmanned transformation of logistics.
Taking the express delivery industry as an example, the industry is fiercely competitive in terms of pricing, with labor costs dominating end transportation. Without breakthroughs in technology and operational models, it is difficult to achieve a significant reduction in the cost per ticket. Unmanned logistics vehicles have already come to the "eve" of commercialization, becoming a sharp blade that pierces the trillion-dollar traditional logistics cost structure.
However, one major obstacle facing unmanned logistics vehicles at present is the lack of unified road rights and regulations.
Huatai Securities' research report points out that the current restrictions on the volume of unmanned logistics vehicle fleets are twofold. First, the vehicles produced need to continuously apply for and obtain test licenses; second, the industry lacks unified regulatory standards.
"At present, low-speed operation within 40km/h is the main focus of the fleet of medium and small-sized vehicles, so the scenarios being developed mainly involve low-speed terminal delivery, and have not yet extensively entered the high-speed delivery areas such as inter-city and inter-city," the agency analysis believes.
However, the related policy environment continues to improve. In July 2024, five departments jointly issued a pilot notification allowing 20 cities to carry out multi-scenario applications of intelligent connected vehicles. As of June 2025, leading companies such as Xinshiqi have obtained public road rights in over 100 cities nationwide. According to data from the Ministry of Public Security, as of August 2024, more than 32,000 kilometers of test roads have been opened nationwide, and the barriers to road rights are gradually being broken down.
(Author: Fei Xinyi Editor: Zhang Weixian)
